ayah_ar: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayah_en: Then he ˹and the others˺ will look and spot him in the midst of the Hellfire.
Tafseer: Then he that speaker will take a look through one of the apertures in Paradise and he will catch sight of him that is he will see his comrade in the centre of Hell in the middle of the Fire.

ayah_ar: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
ayah_en: He will ˹then˺ say, “By Allah! You nearly ruined me.
Tafseer: He will say to him acknowledging that he the latter deserves his fate ‘By God! You very nearly destroyed me you almost ruined me through your misguidance in this has been softened from the hardened form inna.

ayah_ar: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
ayah_en: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I ˹too˺ would have certainly been among those brought ˹to Hell˺.”
Tafseer: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord His grace to me in giving me faith I too would have been of those arraigned’ with you in the Fire. The inhabitants of Paradise will say

ayah_ar: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
ayah_en: ˹Then he will ask his fellow believers,˺ “Can you imagine that we will never die,
Tafseer: Do we then not die anymore

ayah_ar: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayah_en: except our first death, nor be punished ˹like the others˺?”
Tafseer: aside from our first death that is the one which we suffered in this world and are we not to be chastised?’ — this interrogative statement is one made out of sheer delight and in order to speak at length of the graces of God exalted be He in His granting of everlasting life and refraining from inflicting any punishment.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayah_en: This is truly the ultimate triumph.
Tafseer: Truly this that has mentioned as being the reward for the inhabitants of Paradise is indeed the mighty success.

ayah_ar: لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَٰمِلُونَ
ayah_en: For such ˹honour˺ all should strive.
Tafseer: For the like of this let all the workers work — it is said that this is said to them or it is what they say themselves.

ayah_ar: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayah_en: Is this ˹bliss˺ a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqûm?
Tafseer: Is that which is mentioned to them a better hospitality nuzul denotes what is prepared for one who is being received as a guest and so forth or the Zaqqūm tree that is prepared for the inhabitants of the Fire — it is the vilest and most bitter tree of the Tihāma region which God causes to grow in the Fire as will be stated shortly.

ayah_ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayah_en: We have surely made it a test for the wrongdoers.
Tafseer: We have indeed made it for that reason sc. its being a tree in the Fire a trial for the wrongdoers? namely for the disbelievers of Mecca for they said ‘Fire consumes trees so how can it make them grow forth?’

ayah_ar: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayah_en: Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell,
Tafseer: Indeed it is a tree that comes forth from the very source of Hell in other words from the depths of Hell with its branches extending up through all its different levels.

ayah_ar: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
ayah_en: bearing fruit like devils’ heads.
Tafseer: Its spathes likened to the spathes of a date-palm are like the heads of devils as vile-looking snakes.

ayah_ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
ayah_en: The evildoers will certainly ˹be left to˺ eat from it, filling up their bellies with it.
Tafseer: And indeed they the disbelievers will eat of it despite its vileness because of the severity of their hunger and will fill their bellies from it.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: Then on top of that they will be given a blend of boiling drink.
Tafseer: Then lo! on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water which they drink and which mixes with what they have eaten and becomes a brew thereof.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayah_en: Then they will ultimately return to ˹their place in˺ Hell.
Tafseer: Then indeed their return shall be to Hell-fire — this suggests that they exit from it only to drink the boiling water which is located outside it.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
ayah_en: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray,
Tafseer: Lo! they found their fathers to be astray

ayah_ar: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
ayah_en: so they rushed in their footsteps!
Tafseer: and so they are also now hurrying in their footsteps they shall be prodded to follow them and they end up hurrying towards it Hell-fire.

ayah_ar: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayah_en: And surely most of the earlier generations had strayed before them,
Tafseer: And verily most of the ancients of past communities went astray before them

ayah_ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
ayah_en: although We had certainly sent warners among them.
Tafseer: and We certainly had sent among them warners in the way of messengers to threaten them.

ayah_ar: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
ayah_en: See then what was the end of those who had been warned.
Tafseer: So behold how was the consequence for them who were warned namely the disbelievers in other words the sequel for them was that they ended up in the chastisement;

ayah_ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayah_en: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
Tafseer: all except God’s sincere servants namely the believers who are saved from chastisement because they were sincere in their worship mukhlisīna; or if one reads mukhlasīna because God has made them sincerely devoted to such worship.

ayah_ar: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌۭ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
ayah_en: Indeed, Noah cried out to Us, and how excellent are We in responding!
Tafseer: And verily Noah called to Us when he said ‘My Lord I have been overcome so help me Q. 5410 and how excellent were the Hearers of the prayer for him were We in other words he invoked Us against his people so We destroyed them by drowning them.

ayah_ar: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayah_en: We delivered him and his family from the great distress,
Tafseer: And We delivered him and his family from the great distress which was the drowning

ayah_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
ayah_en: and made his descendants the sole survivors.
Tafseer: and made his descendants the survivors thus all human beings are descended from him peace be upon him. He had three sons Shem Sām the ancestor of the Arabs the Persians and the Byzantines; Ham Hām the ancestor of the Negroes; and Japheth Yāfith the ancestor of the Turks the Khazar and the peoples of Gog and Magog and the inhabitants of such regions.

ayah_ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayah_en: And We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations:
Tafseer: And We left We preserved for him fair praise among posterity among the prophets and communities after him until the Day of Resurrection which is

ayah_ar: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayah_en: “Peace be upon Noah among all peoples.”
Tafseer: ‘Peace from Us be to Noah among the worlds!’

ayah_ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayah_en: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers.
Tafseer: Thus indeed in the way that We requited them We requite the virtuous.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayah_en: ˹For˺ he was truly one of Our faithful servants.
Tafseer: He was indeed one of Our faithful servants.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
ayah_en: Then We drowned the others.
Tafseer: Then We did drown the others the disbelievers from among his folk.

ayah_ar: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayah_en: And indeed, one of those who followed his way was Abraham.
Tafseer: And truly of his adherents that is of those who agreed with him on the fundaments of religion was Abraham despite the fact that there was a long interval between them 2640 years and between them came the prophets Hūd and Sālih.

ayah_ar: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍ
ayah_en: ˹Remember˺ when he came to his Lord with a pure heart,
Tafseer: When he came to his Lord in other words he continued to follow Him upon coming to Him with a heart that was pure of any doubt or the like

ayah_ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayah_en: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshipping?
Tafseer: when he said while still in this continuous state of his to his father and his folk in reproach ‘What do — what is it that — you worship?

ayah_ar: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةًۭ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
ayah_en: Is it false gods that you desire instead of Allah?
Tafseer: Is it a calumny a-ifkan as regards the two hamzas the same applies as mentioned before — gods other than God — that you desire? ifkan is an object denoting reason; ālihatan is the direct object of turīdūna ‘you desire’; ifk denotes the worst kind of lie. In other words do you worship any other than God?

ayah_ar: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayah_en: What then do you expect from the Lord of all worlds?”
Tafseer: What then is your supposition regarding the Lord of the Worlds?’ having worshipped other than Him do you think that He will leave you without punishment? No! They were a people of astrologers. On one occasion they went out to celebrate a festival of theirs and left their food behind with their idols claiming that they were securing thereby blessings for it and that they would eat it upon their return. They had said to the lord Abraham ‘Come out with us’.

ayah_ar: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةًۭ فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayah_en: He later looked up to the stars ˹in contemplation˺,
Tafseer: And he cast a glance at the stars — to delude them into thinking that he relies on them so that they would then trust him —

ayah_ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌۭ
ayah_en: then said, “I am really sick.”
Tafseer: and said ‘Indeed I feel I will be sick’ that is I will fall ill.

ayah_ar: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
ayah_en: So they turned their backs on him and went away.
Tafseer: So they went away to their festival leaving him behind.

ayah_ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayah_en: Then he ˹stealthily˺ advanced towards their gods, and said ˹mockingly˺, “Will you not eat ˹your offerings˺?
Tafseer: Then he turned he stole away to their gods the idols in front of which the food had been placed and said mockingly ‘Will you not eat? — but they failed to utter a word.

ayah_ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
ayah_en: What is wrong with you that you cannot speak?”
Tafseer: He then said What is wrong with you that you do not speak?’ — but still he received no response.

ayah_ar: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
ayah_en: Then he swiftly turned on them, striking ˹them˺ with his right hand.
Tafseer: He then turned on them striking them with his right hand with might smashing them. Those who saw him reported this to the rest of his people.

ayah_ar: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
ayah_en: Later, his people came rushing towards him ˹furiously˺.
Tafseer: So they came running towards him walking hurriedly and they said to him ‘We worship them while you smash them?!’

ayah_ar: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
ayah_en: He argued, “How can you worship what you carve ˹with your own hands˺,
Tafseer: He said to them in reproach ‘Do you worship what you yourselves have carved out of stone and other materials idols

ayah_ar: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayah_en: when it is Allah Who created you and whatever you do?”
Tafseer: when God created you and whatever you make?’ whether it be your act of carving and that which you have carved? So worship Him alone! the mā in wa-mā ta‘malūna ‘and whatever you make’ is that of the verbal noun; but it is also said to introduce a relative clause or it is adjectivally qualified.

ayah_ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayah_en: They said ˹to one another˺, “Build him a furnace and cast him into the blazing fire.”
Tafseer: They said amongst themselves ‘Build for him a structure then fill it with firewood and set it on fire and when it is ablaze then cast him into the fierce fire’.

ayah_ar: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
ayah_en: And so they sought to harm him, but We made them inferior.
Tafseer: So they sought to outwit him by flinging him into the fire so that it may destroy him but We made them the lowermost the vanquished as he came out of the fire unharmed.

ayah_ar: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
ayah_en: He later said, “I am leaving ˹in obedience˺ to my Lord. He will guide me.
Tafseer: And he said ‘I shall indeed depart to my Lord I shall emigrating to Him from the abode of disbelief — He will guide me to the place to which My Lord has commanded that I end up in and this was Syria. When he reached the Holy Land he said

ayah_ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayah_en: My Lord! Bless me with righteous offspring.”
Tafseer: My Lord! Grant me a child of the righteous’.

ayah_ar: فَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: So We gave him good news of a forbearing son.
Tafseer: So We gave him the good tidings of a forbearing son.

ayah_ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
ayah_en: Then when the boy reached the age to work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son! I have seen in a dream that I ˹must˺ sacrifice you. So tell me what you think.” He replied, “O my dear father! Do as you are commanded. Allah willing, you will find me steadfast.”
Tafseer: And when he was old enough to walk with him that is to go about with him and help him out — this is said to have been either at the age of seven or at the age of thirteen — he said ‘O my dear son I see that is I have seen in a dream that I shall sacrifice you — and the visions of prophets are always true and their actions are inspired by the command of God exalted be He. So see what you think’ of this dream. He consulted him so that he his son might accept the idea of being sacrificed and comply with the command for it. He said ‘O my father the final tā’ in abati replaces the yā’ of the genitive possessive annexation yā abī do whatever you have been commanded to do. You shall find me God willing of the steadfast’ in this affair.

ayah_ar: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
ayah_en: Then when they submitted ˹to Allah’s Will˺, and Abraham laid him on the side of his forehead ˹for sacrifice˺,
Tafseer: And when they had both submitted when they had submitted to and were prepared to comply with God’s command exalted be He and he had laid him down on his forehead when he had pushed him down to the ground thereon — every human being has two brows jabīn between which is the forehead jabha; this was at Minā. Abraham passed the knife across his son’s throat but it did not do anything by some impediment of the Divine Power

ayah_ar: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
ayah_en: We called out to him, “O Abraham!
Tafseer: We called to him ‘O Abraham!

ayah_ar: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayah_en: You have already fulfilled the vision.” Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers.
Tafseer: Verily you have fulfilled the vision’ by what you have done in that you were able to go through with the act of sacrifice. In other words that which you have done suffices for you as redemption the statement nādaynāhu ‘We called to him’ is the response to the lammā ‘when’ so that the wāw in wa-nādaynāhu ‘We called to him’ is extra. So in the same way that We have rewarded you do We reward those who are virtuous to their own souls in obeying the Command of God by removing from them their distress.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayah_en: That was truly a revealing test.
Tafseer: Truly this sacrifice to which he was commanded was indeed a clear test’ that is to say the ultimate test of faith.

ayah_ar: وَفَدَيْنَٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: And We ransomed his son with a great sacrifice,
Tafseer: Then We ransomed him the one whom he had been commanded to sacrifice namely Ishmael or Isaac — two different opinions — with a mighty sacrifice a mighty ram from Paradise the same one that Abel had offered as as sacrifice Gabriel peace be upon him brought it and the lord Abraham sacrificed it as he cried Allāhu akbar ‘God is Great’.

ayah_ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayah_en: and blessed Abraham ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations:
Tafseer: And We left We preserved for him among posterity fair praise namely

ayah_ar: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayah_en: “Peace be upon Abraham.”
Tafseer: ‘Peace from Us be to Abraham!’

ayah_ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayah_en: This is how We reward the good-doers.
Tafseer: So in way that We rewarded him do We reward those who are virtuous to their own souls.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayah_en: He was truly one of Our faithful servants.
Tafseer: Indeed he is one of Our faithful servants.

ayah_ar: وَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِإِسْحَٰقَ نَبِيًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayah_en: We ˹later˺ gave him good news of Isaac—a prophet, and one of the righteous.
Tafseer: And We gave him the good tidings of the birth of Isaac — some have argued that this proves that the one who was sacrificed was not him Isaac — a prophet nabiyyan is a future circumstantial qualifier that is to say ‘he will come to be with his prophethood decreed one of the righteous.

ayah_ar: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ
ayah_en: We blessed him and Isaac as well. Some of their descendants did good, while others clearly wronged themselves.
Tafseer: And We blessed him by multiplying his descendants and Isaac his son We also blessed by appointing the majority of prophets from among his progeny. And among their descendants is he who is virtuous he who is a believer and he who plainly wrongs his soul he who is a disbeliever whose disbelief is manifest.

ayah_ar: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
ayah_en: And We certainly showed favour to Moses and Aaron,
Tafseer: And verily We favoured Moses and Aaron with prophethood

ayah_ar: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayah_en: and delivered them and their people from the great distress.
Tafseer: and We delivered them and their people the Children of Israel from the great distress namely Pharaoh’s enslavement of them.

ayah_ar: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
ayah_en: We helped them so it was they who prevailed.
Tafseer: And We helped them against the Egyptians so that they became the victors.

ayah_ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
ayah_en: We gave them the clear Scripture,
Tafseer: And We gave them the enlightening scripture the one whose statements concerning prescribed punishments and rulings and otherwise are excellently expressed — this is the Torah.

ayah_ar: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
ayah_en: and guided them to the Straight Path.
Tafseer: And We guided them to the straight path the straight way

ayah_ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayah_en: And We blessed them ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations:
Tafseer: and We left We preserved for them among posterity fair praise namely

ayah_ar: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
ayah_en: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”
Tafseer: ‘Peace from Us be to Moses and Aaron!’

ayah_ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayah_en: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers.
Tafseer: So just as We rewarded them both do We reward the virtuous.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayah_en: They were truly ˹two˺ of Our faithful servants.
Tafseer: Indeed both were among Our faithful servants.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayah_en: And Elias was indeed one of the messengers.
Tafseer: And truly Elias read wa-inna Ilyās with the initial hamza or without wa-inna’l-yāsa was also one of the messengers. Some think that this Elias was the son of Aaron’s brother — Aaron the brother of Moses; but some say that this Elias was some other person who was sent to the people living in and around Baalbak.

ayah_ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayah_en: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his people, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺?
Tafseer: When idh is dependent because of an implicit verb udhkur ‘mention’ he said to his people ‘Will you not fear God?

ayah_ar: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًۭا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
ayah_en: Do you call upon ˹the idol of˺ Ba’l and abandon the Best of Creators—
Tafseer: Do you call on Baal — this was the name of an idol of theirs which was made of gold from which the name of their city derives with the addition of the suffix bak — that is to say do you worship him and abandon the Best of Creators and not worship Him

ayah_ar: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayah_en: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”
Tafseer: God your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’ read as predicates allāhu rabbukum and rabbu in the nominative because of the implicit omitted huwa being the subject; or read allāha rabbakum and rabba in the accusative as supplements to ahsana ‘the best of’.

ayah_ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
ayah_en: But they rejected him, so they will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺.
Tafseer: But they denied him. So they will indeed be arraigned in the Fire

ayah_ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayah_en: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
Tafseer: — all except God’s delivered servants namely the believers who will be saved from it

ayah_ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayah_en: We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations:
Tafseer: and We left for him among posterity fair praise namely

ayah_ar: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
ayah_en: “Peace be upon Elias.”
Tafseer: ‘Peace from Us be to Elias!’. It is said that this ilyāsīn is the same Elias mentioned above; but it is also said that this denotes him together with all those who were believers with him and so they have been coupled under the same term with him being the predominant as when one might say al-Muhallabūn ‘the Muhallabids’ to mean al-Muhallab and his folk; a variant reading has āl yāsīn by which is meant his family as well as Elias himself.

ayah_ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayah_en: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers.
Tafseer: Indeed so — just as We rewarded him — do We reward the virtuous.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayah_en: He was truly one of Our faithful servants.
Tafseer: Truly he is one of Our faithful servants.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّ لُوطًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayah_en: And Lot was indeed one of the messengers.
Tafseer: And indeed Lot was one of the messengers;

ayah_ar: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayah_en: ˹Remember˺ when We delivered him and all of his family,
Tafseer: mention when We delivered him together with all his family

ayah_ar: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
ayah_en: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed.
Tafseer: except an old woman who was among those who stayed behind in other words those who stayed behind in the chastisement.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
ayah_en: Then We ˹utterly˺ destroyed the rest.
Tafseer: Then We destroyed all the others the disbelievers from among his people.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
ayah_en: You ˹Meccans˺ certainly pass by their ruins day
Tafseer: And indeed you pass by them by their remains and the remains of their dwellings during your travels both in the morning that is during the daytime

ayah_ar: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayah_en: and night. Will you not then understand?
Tafseer: and at night will you O people of Mecca not then understand? what befell them and so take heed therefrom?

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayah_en: And Jonah was indeed one of the messengers.
Tafseer: And indeed Jonah was one of the messengers;

ayah_ar: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
ayah_en: ˹Remember˺ when he fled to the overloaded ship.
Tafseer: when he fled to the laden ship — after he became furious with his people as the chastisement which he had promised them did not come down on them; so he boarded the ship which then stopped out in the deep sea. The seamen said ‘There is a runaway slave here upon this ship who has fled from his master a casting of lots should expose him!’

ayah_ar: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
ayah_en: Then ˹to save it from sinking,˺ he drew straws ˹with other passengers˺. He lost ˹and was thrown overboard˺.
Tafseer: Then he drew lots with the passengers on the ship and was of those rejected of the losers in the draw and so they threw him into the sea.

ayah_ar: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
ayah_en: Then the whale engulfed him while he was blameworthy.
Tafseer: Then the whale swallowed him while he was blameworthy that is while he was guilty of a blameworthy thing having gone to sea and embarked the ship without his Lord’s permission.

ayah_ar: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
ayah_en: Had he not ˹constantly˺ glorified ˹Allah˺,
Tafseer: And had he not been one of those who glorify God that is to say those who make remembrance of God for inside the whale’s belly he was repeatedly saying the words ‘There is no god except You. Glory be to You! I have indeed been one of the wrongdoers’ Q. 2187

ayah_ar: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayah_en: he would have certainly remained in its belly until the Day of Resurrection.
Tafseer: he would have tarried in its belly until the day when they are raised in other words the whale’s belly would have been his tomb until the Day of Resurrection.

ayah_ar: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌۭ
ayah_en: But We cast him onto the open ˹shore˺, ˹totally˺ worn out,
Tafseer: Then We cast him We flung him out of the belly of the whale onto the barren land onto the face of the earth that is onto the shore on that same day — or three or seven or twenty or forty days later — and he was sick ailing like a newly-born featherless chick.

ayah_ar: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةًۭ مِّن يَقْطِينٍۢ
ayah_en: and caused a squash plant to grow over him.
Tafseer: And We made a gourd plant to grow above him to provide shade for him with its stem which is not the case usually with gourds as a miracle for him; a mountain goat would come to him in the morning and in the evening and he would drink its milk until he finally regained his strength.

ayah_ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
ayah_en: We ˹later˺ sent him ˹back˺ to ˹his city of˺ at least one hundred thousand people,
Tafseer: And We sent him afterwards — as We had done before to a people in Nineveh in the region of Mosul — to a community of a hundred thousand or in fact more — a community of twenty thirty or seventy thousand.

ayah_ar: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayah_en: who then believed ˹in him˺, so We allowed them enjoyment for a while.
Tafseer: And they believed after they saw with their own eyes the chastisement which they had been promised. So We gave them comfort We kept them alive to enjoy their wealth for a while until their terms of life would be concluded while they took comfort therein.

ayah_ar: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
ayah_en: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ if your Lord has daughters, while the pagans ˹prefer to˺ have sons.
Tafseer: So ask them inquire of the Meccan disbelievers by way of reproach are daughters to be for your Lord after their claim that the angels were God’s daughters while sons are to be for them? so that the best becomes exclusively theirs?

ayah_ar: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
ayah_en: Or ˹ask them˺ if We created the angels as females right before their eyes.
Tafseer: Or did We create the angels females while they were witnesses? to Our act of creation that they might then say such a thing?

ayah_ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayah_en: Indeed, it is one of their ˹outrageous˺ fabrications to say,
Tafseer: Lo! it is indeed out of their own mendacity their own lies that they say

ayah_ar: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
ayah_en: “Allah has children.” They are simply liars.
Tafseer: ‘God has begotten’ when they say that the angels are God’s daughters. And verily they are liars in this respect.

ayah_ar: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
ayah_en: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
Tafseer: Has He preferred daughters to sons? read a’stafā ‘has He preferred’ indicating an interrogative hamza which stands in place of the omitted conjunctive hamza.

ayah_ar: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
ayah_en: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
Tafseer: What is wrong with you? How do you judge? how do you make such a depraved judgement?

ayah_ar: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayah_en: Will you not then be mindful?
Tafseer: Will you not then remember? tadhakkarūna the tā’ of tatadhakkarūna has been assimilated with the dhāl that He glory be to Him is exalted above having a child?

ayah_ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَٰنٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayah_en: Or do you have ˹any˺ compelling proof?
Tafseer: Or do you have a clear warrant? plain definitive proof that God has a child?

ayah_ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayah_en: Then bring ˹us˺ your scripture, if what you say is true!
Tafseer: Then produce your scripture the Torah and show Me this as it is mentioned in it if you are being truthful about this statement of yours.

ayah_ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
ayah_en: They have also established a ˹marital˺ relationship between Him and the jinn. Yet the jinn ˹themselves˺ know well that such people will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺.
Tafseer: And they namely the idolaters have set up between Him exalted be He and the jinn namely the angels jinna they are so called because they are hidden ijtinān from vision a kinship by saying that they are God’s daughters while the jinn certainly know that they that is those who say this shall indeed be arraigned into the Fire to be chastised therein.

ayah_ar: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayah_en: Glorified is Allah far above what they claim!
Tafseer: Glory be to God affirming that He is exalted above what they attribute to Him in the way of His having a child

ayah_ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayah_en: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
Tafseer: — all except God’s devoted servants namely believers the exceptive clause here is discontinuous in other words that is because they declare that God transcends what such individuals attribute to Him.

ayah_ar: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayah_en: Surely you ˹pagans˺ and whatever ˹idols˺ you worship
Tafseer: For indeed you and what you worship of idols

ayah_ar: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
ayah_en: can never lure ˹anyone˺ away from Him
Tafseer: — you cannot tempt anyone thereto that is to incline to your worshipped idols ‘alayhi ‘thereto’ is semantically connected to His saying bi-fātinīna ‘you cannot tempt’

ayah_ar: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayah_en: except those ˹destined˺ to burn in Hell.
Tafseer: except him who will burn in Hell in God’s knowledge exalted be He.

ayah_ar: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
ayah_en: ˹The angels respond,˺ “There is not one of us without an assigned station ˹of worship˺.
Tafseer: Gabriel said to the Prophet s And there is not one of us us the company of angels but has a known station in the heavens in which he worships God and which he does not transgress.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
ayah_en: We are indeed the ones lined up in ranks ˹for Allah˺.
Tafseer: And indeed it is we who are the rangers of our feet in prayer.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
ayah_en: And we are indeed the ones ˹constantly˺ glorifying ˹His praise˺.”
Tafseer: And indeed it is we who give glory it is we who declare that God transcends what does not befit Him.

ayah_ar: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayah_en: They certainly used to say,
Tafseer: And indeed in is softened in place of the hardened one they the Meccan disbelievers used to say

ayah_ar: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayah_en: “If only we had a Reminder like ˹those of˺ earlier peoples,
Tafseer: ‘If we had but a reminder a scripture from the ancients that is from among the scriptures of past communities

ayah_ar: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayah_en: we would have truly been Allah’s devoted servants.”
Tafseer: we would have surely been God’s devoted servants’ devoting worship purely to Him.

ayah_ar: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayah_en: But ˹now˺ they reject it, so they will soon know.
Tafseer: God exalted be He says Yet they disbelieved in it in other words in the Book that came to them namely the Qur’ān more glorious than all those other scriptures; but they will come to know the consequences of their disbelief.

ayah_ar: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayah_en: Our Word has already gone forth to Our servants, the messengers,
Tafseer: And verily Our Word containing the promise of victory has gone beforehand in favour of Our servants the messengers and that Word is I shall assuredly prevail I and My messengers Q. 5821 —

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
ayah_en: that they would surely be helped,
Tafseer: or it is His following saying — assuredly they shall be helped

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
ayah_en: and that Our forces will certainly prevail.
Tafseer: and assuredly Our hosts namely the believers they will indeed be the victors over the disbelievers by their being given the definitive proofs and assistance against them in this world. And if some of these believers are not victorious over them in this world then assuredly in the Hereafter they will be so.

ayah_ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayah_en: So turn away from the deniers for a while ˹O Prophet˺.
Tafseer: So leave them in other words shun the Meccan disbelievers for a while until such time as you are commanded to fight them;

ayah_ar: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
ayah_en: You will see ˹what will happen to˺ them, and they too will see!
Tafseer: and watch them when the chastisement is sent down on them; for they will soon see the consequences of their disbelief.

ayah_ar: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ayah_en: Do they ˹really˺ wish to hasten Our punishment?
Tafseer: They then said in mockery ‘When will this chastisement be sent down?’ God exalted be He threatens them by saying Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
ayah_en: Yet when it descends upon them: how evil will that morning be for those who had been warned!
Tafseer: But when it descends in their courtyard — al-Farrā’ said that the Arabs find it sufficient to refer to a people by referring to ‘their courtyard’ — how awful how terrible a morning will be the morning for those who were warned the overt noun al-mundharīn has replaced the third person pronominalisation in sāhatihim.

ayah_ar: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayah_en: And turn away from them for a while.
Tafseer: So leave them for a while

ayah_ar: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
ayah_en: You will see, and they too will see!
Tafseer: and watch; for they will soon see — this statement is repeated in order to emphasise the threat made to them and to reassure the Prophet s.

ayah_ar: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayah_en: Glorified is your Lord—the Lord of Honour and Power—above what they claim!
Tafseer: Glory be to your Lord the Lord of Might of Triumph exalted is He above what they allege! in the way of His having a child.

ayah_ar: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayah_en: Peace be upon the messengers.
Tafseer: And peace be to the messengers who convey from God the Message of the Oneness of God and His Laws.

ayah_ar: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayah_en: And praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds.
Tafseer: And praise be to God Lord of the Worlds for granting these messengers victory and destroying the disbelievers.

ayah_ar: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
ayah_en: sãd. By the Quran, full of reminders!
Tafseer: Sād God knows best what He means by this letter. By the Qur’ān bearing the Remembrance that is bearing the Pronouncement; or what is meant is that the Qur’ān is a Book of renown the response to this oath has been omitted in other words ‘It is not as the Meccan disbelievers say that there are many gods’.

ayah_ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ
ayah_en: ˹This is the truth,˺ yet the disbelievers are ˹entrenched˺ in arrogance and opposition.
Tafseer: Nay but those who disbelieve from among the people of Mecca dwell in conceit in self-glory and in disdain of faith and defiance disagreement with and enmity towards the Prophet s.

ayah_ar: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ
ayah_en: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late to escape.
Tafseer: How many — in other words many — a generation a community of past communities We have destroyed before them and they cried out when the chastisement was sent down on them when it was no longer the time for escape that is to say the time was not one for fleeing the suffixed tā’ of wa-lāta is extra; the sentence is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb nādaw ‘they cried out’ in other words they called for help but the situation was such that there could be no escape or deliverance; but still the Meccan disbelievers have not taken heed from their example.

ayah_ar: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ
ayah_en: Now, the pagans are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a total liar!
Tafseer: And they marvel that a warner has come to them from among themselves a messenger from among their number to warn them and to threaten them with the punishment of the Fire after resurrection — and this warner is the Prophet s. And those who disbelieve the overt noun al-kāfirūnā has replaced the third person pronominalisation say ‘This is a sorcerer a liar.

ayah_ar: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ
ayah_en: Has he reduced ˹all˺ the gods to One God? Indeed, this is something totally astonishing.”
Tafseer: Has he made the gods One God? — for he had said to them ‘Say there is no god except God’ — in other words they objected how could one god suffice for all of creation? Lo! that is indeed a curious thing’.

ayah_ar: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ
ayah_en: The chiefs among them went forth saying, “Carry on, and stand firm in devotion to your gods. Certainly this is just a scheme ˹for power˺.
Tafseer: And the council from among them go about from the place of their assembly at the house of Abū Tālib and the place where they heard the Prophet s say ‘Say there is no god except God’ saying ‘Go! they say to one another go and stand by your gods adhere firmly to worship of them; lo! this that has been mentioned concerning the Oneness of God is indeed a thing sought from us.

ayah_ar: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
ayah_en: We have never heard of this in the previous faith. This is nothing but a fabrication.
Tafseer: We never heard of this in the latter-day creed namely the creed of Jesus. This is surely nothing but an invention mere lies.

ayah_ar: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
ayah_en: Has the Reminder been revealed ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us?” In fact, they are ˹only˺ in doubt of My ˹revealed˺ Reminder. In fact, ˹they do so because˺ they have not yet tasted My punishment.
Tafseer: Has the Remembrance the Qur’ān been revealed to him Muhammad (s) out of all of us’ when he is neither the elder nor the noblest among us? In other words it could not have been revealed to him read a-unzila pronouncing both hamzas or not pronouncing the second one but in both cases inserting an intervening alif or without this insertion. God exalted be He says Nay but they are in doubt concerning My Remembrance My revelation that is the Qur’ān for they deny the one who has brought it. Nay but they have not yet tasted My chastisement and if they were to taste it they would certainly believe the Prophet s in what he has brought — but then in such a case their belief in the Prophet would be of no benefit to them.

ayah_ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
ayah_en: Or ˹is it because˺ they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Almighty, the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.
Tafseer: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord’s mercy the Mighty the Victor the Bestower? treasuries such as prophethood and otherwise so that they might give it to whomever they want?

ayah_ar: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
ayah_en: Or ˹is it because˺ the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between belongs to them? Let them then climb their way ˹to heaven, if their claim is true˺.
Tafseer: Or do they possess the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them? If this is what they claim Then let them ascend by the means of ascension that lead to the heaven and bring down some revelation wahy and then assign it exclusively to whomever they wish am in both verses represents the rhetorical hamza of denial.

ayah_ar: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
ayah_en: This is just another ˹enemy˺ force bound for defeat out there.
Tafseer: A routed mahzūmun is an adjectival qualification of jundun ‘host’ host is all that they are in other words they are nothing but a despicable host nothing more — in their denial of you — from among the factions mina’l-ahzābi also an adjectival qualification of jundun in other words they are like those hosts of factions who were in confederation against prophets before you these were defeated and destroyed and likewise We shall destroy these people.

ayah_ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
ayah_en: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ’ad, Pharaoh of the mighty structures,
Tafseer: Before them the people of Noah denied the inflection of the verb kadhdabat ‘denied’ that is governed by qawmu ‘people’ is in the feminine person because of the implicit sense and so did those of ‘Ād and Pharaoh he of the stakes — he used to fix four stakes for the person who incurred his wrath and tie to these stakes that person’s hands and feet and then torture him —

ayah_ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
ayah_en: Thamûd, the people of Lot, and the residents of the Forest. These were ˹all˺ enemy forces.
Tafseer: and Thamūd and the people of Lot and the dwellers in the wood a small forest namely the people of Shu‘ayb peace be upon him — those were the factions.

ayah_ar: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
ayah_en: Each rejected their messenger, so My punishment was justified.
Tafseer: Each one of the factions did not but deny the messengers for when they deny one they have in effect denied them all since their call to God is the same one namely the call to affirmation of His Oneness. So My retribution was justified it was necessary.

ayah_ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ
ayah_en: These ˹pagans˺ are awaiting nothing but a single Blast that cannot be stopped.
Tafseer: And these that is the disbelievers of Mecca do not await but a single Cry namely the Blast of the Resurrection that will herald chastisement for them for which there will be no revoking read fawāq or fuwāq.

ayah_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayah_en: They say ˹mockingly˺, “Our Lord! Hasten for us our share ˹of the punishment˺ before the Day of Reckoning.”
Tafseer: And they said — after the following verse was revealed As for him who is given his book in his right hand … to the end of the verse Q. 6919 — ‘Our Lord hasten on for us the record of our deeds before the Day of Reckoning’ — they said this mockingly.

ayah_ar: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayah_en: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And remember Our servant, David, the man of strength. Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺.
Tafseer: God exalted be He says Bear patiently what they say and remember Our servant David the one of fortitude that is to say the one of fortitude in worship he used to fast every other day and keep vigil for half the night sleep for a third and then keep vigil for the last sixth. Indeed he was a penitent soul always returning to what pleases God.

ayah_ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
ayah_en: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise.
Tafseer: Truly We disposed the mountains to glorify God with him with the same glorification at evening at the time of the night prayer and at sunrise at the time of the morning prayer which is when the sun has fully risen with its light extending everywhere.

ayah_ar: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
ayah_en: And ˹We subjected˺ the birds, flocking together. All turned to him ˹echoing his hymns˺.
Tafseer: And We disposed the birds mustered in flocks gathered before him glorifying with him; each of the mountains and birds turning to him reverting to obedience of him by glorifying God with him.

ayah_ar: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
ayah_en: We strengthened his kingship, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment.
Tafseer: And We strengthened his Kingdom We reinforced it with guards and hosts every night there thirty thousand men would be standing guard at his sanctuary; and gave him wisdom prophethood and sound judgement in all matters and decisive speech the ability to formulate a satisfactory statement for a decision in any endeavour.

ayah_ar: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
ayah_en: Has the story of the two plaintiffs, who scaled the ˹wall of David’s˺ sanctuary, reached you ˹O Prophet˺?
Tafseer: And has there come to you O Muhammad (s) the purpose of the interrogative indicated by hal here is to provoke curiosity and a desire to listen to what will follow the tale of the disputants when they scaled the sanctuary? David’s sanctuary that is his place of prayer for they had been prohibited from entering by the front gates because of his being engaged in worship in other words has it come to you their tale and their account?

ayah_ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
ayah_en: When they came into David’s presence, he was startled by them. They said, “Have no fear. ˹We are merely˺ two in a dispute: one of us has wronged the other. So judge between us with truth—do not go beyond ˹it˺—and guide us to the right way.
Tafseer: When they entered upon David and he was frightened by them. And they said ‘Do not fear; we are two disputants some say that this means ‘two groups’ in order to agree with the plural person of the verb dakhalū ‘they entered’; others say ‘two individuals’ with the plural person actually denoting these two; al-khasm may refer to a one or more individuals. These two were angels who had come in the form of two disputants between whom there was supposed to have occurred the situation mentioned — but only hypothetically — in order to alert David peace be upon him to what he had done he had ninety nine women but desired the woman of a man who had only her and no other. He David had married her and consummated the marriage. One of us has infringed upon the rights of the other so judge justly between us and do not transgress do not be unjust and guide us direct us to the right path’ the correct way.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
ayah_en: This is my brother. He has ninety-nine sheep while I have ˹only˺ one. ˹Still˺ he asked me to give it up to him, overwhelming me with ˹his˺ argument.”
Tafseer: ‘Behold this brother of mine in other words my fellow co-religionist has ninety-nine ewes — here used to represent the women — while I have a single ewe; yet he said “Entrust it to me” in other words make me in charge of it and he overcame me in speech’ in other words in the argument; so the latter conceded charge of it to him.

ayah_ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩
ayah_en: David ˹eventually˺ ruled, “He has definitely wronged you in demanding ˹to add˺ your sheep to his. And certainly many partners wrong each other, except those who believe and do good—but how few are they!” Then David realized that We had tested him so he asked for his Lord’s forgiveness, fell down in prostration, and turned ˹to Him in repentance˺.
Tafseer: He said ‘He has certainly wronged you by asking for your ewe that he may add it to his sheep. And indeed many associates infringe upon the rights of one another except such as believe and perform righteous deeds but few are they!’ mā emphasises the ‘fewness’. As the two angels were ascending to the heaven one said to the other ‘He has certainly passed judgement on himself!’ David was thus alerted to his deed. God exalted be He says And David thought in other words he became certain that We had indeed tried him that We had caused him to fall into a trial that is a test through his love for that woman. So he sought forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing in other words prostrate and repented.

ayah_ar: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
ayah_en: So We forgave that for him. And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination!
Tafseer: So We forgave him that and indeed he has a station of nearness with Us that is even more good things in this world and a fair return in the Hereafter.

ayah_ar: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayah_en: ˹We instructed him:˺ “O David! We have surely made you an authority in the land, so judge between people with truth. And do not follow ˹your˺ desires or they will lead you astray from Allah’s Way. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s Way will suffer a severe punishment for neglecting the Day of Reckoning.”
Tafseer: ‘O David! We have indeed made you a vicegerent on the earth managing the affairs of people; so judge justly between people and do not follow desire that is the desires of the soul that it then lead you astray from the way of God that is to say from the proofs that indicate the truth of His Oneness. Truly those who go astray from the way of God in other words from belief in God — for them there will be a severe chastisement because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning’ as a result of their having neglected faith. For had they been certain of the truth of the Day of Reckoning they would have first been believers in this world.

ayah_ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
ayah_en: We have not created the heavens and earth and everything in between without purpose—as the disbelievers think. So woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire!
Tafseer: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in vain frivolously. That namely the creation of what has been mentioned as being for no particular purpose is the supposition of those who disbelieve from among the people of Mecca. So woe — a valley in hell-fire — to the disbelievers from the Fire!

ayah_ar: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
ayah_en: Or should We treat those who believe and do good like those who make mischief throughout the land? Or should We treat the righteous like the wicked?
Tafseer: Or shall We treat those who believe and perform righteous deeds like those who cause corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the God-fearing like the profligate? This was revealed when the Meccan disbelievers said to the believers ‘In the Hereafter we will receive the same reward as that which you will receive’ am ‘or’ contains the rhetorical hamza of denial.

ayah_ar: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
ayah_en: ˹This is˺ a blessed Book which We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ so that they may contemplate its verses, and people of reason may be mindful.
Tafseer: A Book kitābun the predicate of a missing subject namely hādhā ‘this is’ that We have revealed to you full of blessing that they may contemplate yaddabbarū is actually yatadabbarū but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dāl its signs that they may reflect upon its meanings and become believers and that they may remember that they may be admonished — those people of pith those possessors of intellect.

ayah_ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayah_en: And We blessed David with Solomon—what an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺.
Tafseer: And We bestowed on David Solomon his son — what an excellent servant! that is Solomon. Truly he was a penitent soul always returning to God with glorification and remembrance at all times.

ayah_ar: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
ayah_en: ˹Remember˺ when the well-trained, swift horses were paraded before him in the evening.
Tafseer: When one evening — which is the period after midday — there were displayed before him the prancing steeds al-sāfināt ‘horses’ is the plural of sāfina which denotes a horse standing on three legs with the fourth supported on the edge of the hoof and derives from the verb safana yasfinu sufūnan; al-jiyād is the plural of jawād which is a ‘racer’; the meaning is that these horses are such that when they are halted they stand still and when they run they surpass others in speed. One thousand horses were displayed before him after he had performed the midday prayer for he had wanted to use them in a holy struggle jihād against an enemy. But when the display reached the nine-hundredth horse the sun set and he had not performed the afternoon prayer. So he was greatly distressed.

ayah_ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
ayah_en: He then proclaimed, “I am truly in love with ˹these˺ fine things out of remembrance for Allah,” until they went out of sight.
Tafseer: He said ‘Lo! I have loved I have desired the love of worldly good things that is of horses over the remembrance of my Lord’ that is over the afternoon prayer until it that is the sun disappeared behind the night’s veil until it was concealed by that which veils it from sight.

ayah_ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
ayah_en: ˹He ordered,˺ “Bring them back to me!” Then he began to rub down their legs and necks.
Tafseer: Bring them back to me! that is the horses that were displayed; and they so brought them back. Then he set about slashing with his sword their legs al-sūq is the plural of sāq and necks in other words he slaughtered them and cut off their legs as an offering of atonement to God exalted be He for having been distracted by them from the prayer. He gave all the meat thereof as voluntary alms and so God compensated him what was better and faster that these horses and this was the wind which blew at his command as he wished.

ayah_ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
ayah_en: And indeed, We tested Solomon, placing a ˹deformed˺ body on his throne, then he turned ˹to Allah in repentance˺.
Tafseer: And We certainly tried Solomon We tested him by wresting his kingdom from him because he had married a woman solely out of his desire for her. She used to worship idols in his own home without his knowledge. Now control of his kingdom lay in his ring. On one occasion needing to withdraw to relieve himself he took it off and left it with this woman of his whose name was al-Amīna as was his custom; but a jinn disguised in the form of Solomon came to her and seized it from her. And We cast upon his throne a lifeless body which was that very jinn and he was the one known as Sakhr — or it was some other jinn; he sat upon Solomon’s throne and so as was the case with Solomon the birds and other creatures devoted themselves to him in service. When Solomon came out of his palace having seen him the jinn upon his throne he said to the people ‘I am Solomon not him!’ But they did not recognise him. Then he repented — Solomon returned to his kingdom many days later after he had managed to acquire the ring. He wore it and sat upon his throne again.

ayah_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
ayah_en: He prayed, “My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me an authority that will never be matched by anyone after me. You are indeed the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.”
Tafseer: He said ‘My Lord! Forgive me and grant me a kingdom that shall not belong to anyone after me in other words other than me this use of min ba‘dī to mean ‘other than me’ is similar to Q. 4523 fa-man yahdīh min ba‘di’Llāh ‘who will guide him other than God?’. Truly You are the Bestower’.

ayah_ar: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
ayah_en: So We subjected to him the wind, blowing gently at his command to wherever he pleased.
Tafseer: So We disposed for him the wind which blew softly gently at his command wherever he intended.

ayah_ar: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ
ayah_en: And ˹We subjected to him˺ every builder and diver of the jinn,
Tafseer: And the devils also We disposed every builder building marvellous edifices and diver in the sea bringing up pearls

ayah_ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
ayah_en: and others bound together in chains.
Tafseer: and others too from among them bounded together in fetters in shackles with their hands tied to their necks.

ayah_ar: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
ayah_en: ˹Allah said,˺ “This is Our gift, so give or withhold ˹as you wish˺, never to be called to account.”
Tafseer: And We said to him ‘This is Our gift. So bestow grant thereof to whomever you wish or withhold from giving without any reckoning’ in other words without your being called to account for any of this.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
ayah_en: And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination!
Tafseer: And indeed he has a station of nearness with Us and a fair resort — a similar statement has already appeared in another verse above.

ayah_ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
ayah_en: And remember Our servant Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with distress and suffering.”
Tafseer: And mention also Our servant Job when he called out to his Lord saying ‘Lo! Satan has afflicted me with hardship harm and suffering’ pain he attributes all this to Satan even though all things are from God to show reverence in his call to Him exalted be He.

ayah_ar: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
ayah_en: ˹We responded,˺ “Stomp your foot: ˹now˺ here is a cool ˹and refreshing˺ spring for washing and drinking.”
Tafseer: And it was said to him ‘Stamp your foot on the ground — and he stamped it and a spring of water gushed forth and it was said This is a cool bath cool water for you to wash with and a drink’ for you to drink of. So he washed himself and drank from it whereat every ailment that had affected him internally and externally disappeared.

ayah_ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
ayah_en: And We gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for people of reason.
Tafseer: And We gave him back his family along with others like them that is God brought back to life all the children of his that had died and provided him with as many in addition to them as a mercy a grace from us and a reminder an admonition to people of pith possessors of intellect.

ayah_ar: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
ayah_en: ˹And We said to him,˺ “Take in your hand a bundle of grass, and strike ˹your wife˺ with it, and do not break your oath.” We truly found him patient. What an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺.
Tafseer: And We said to him ‘Take in your hand a bunch of twigs or some blades of grass and smite therewith your wife — for he had sworn to smite her a hundred times on one occasion when she was late in coming to him — and do not break your oath’ by not smiting her so he took a hundred rushes and smote her with them once and that sufficed to fulfil his oath. Truly We found him to be steadfast. What an excellent servant! was Job. Indeed he was a penitent soul always returning to God exalted be He.

ayah_ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
ayah_en: And remember Our servants: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the men of strength and insight.
Tafseer: And mention also Our servants Abraham and Isaac and Jacob — men of fortitude vigorous in their worship and insight deep understanding of religion a variant reading for ‘ibādanā ‘Our servants’ has singular ‘abdanā ‘Our servant’ with Ibrāhīma as the explication thereof and what follows as being a supplement to ‘abdanā ‘Our servant’.

ayah_ar: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
ayah_en: We truly chose them for the honour of proclaiming the Hereafter.
Tafseer: Assuredly We purified them with an exclusive thought namely the remembrance of the Abode of the Hereafter in other words to always remember it and to work for it a variant reading for bi-khālisatin dhikrā’l-dār has the genitive construction bi-khālisati dhikrā’l-dār making this dhikrā al-dār ‘remembrance of the Abode’ the explicative thereof.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
ayah_en: And in Our sight they are truly among the chosen and the finest.
Tafseer: And indeed in Our sight they are of the elect the excellent akhyār is the plural of khayyir.

ayah_ar: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
ayah_en: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Ⱬul-Kifl. All are among the best.
Tafseer: And mention also Our servants Ishmael and Elisha who was a prophet the lām here in al-Yasa‘ is extra and Dhū’l-Kifl — there is disagreement over whether he was a prophet; it is said that he was so called because he looked after kafala a hundred prophets who had sought refuge with him from being killed. Each that is every one of them was among the excellent akhyār is the plural of khayyir.

ayah_ar: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
ayah_en: This is ˹all˺ a reminder. And the righteous will certainly have an honourable destination:
Tafseer: This is a remembrance of them made by the mention of fair praise of them here; and indeed for the God-fearing who comprise them there will truly be a fair return in the Hereafter —

ayah_ar: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
ayah_en: the Gardens of Eternity, whose gates will be open for them.
Tafseer: Gardens of Eden jannāti ‘Adnin is either a substitution for or an explicative supplement to husna ma’ābin ‘a fair return’ whose gates are flung open for them;

ayah_ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ
ayah_en: There they will recline, calling for abundant fruit and drink.
Tafseer: reclining therein on couches; therein they call for plenteous fruit and drink.

ayah_ar: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
ayah_en: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and equal age.
Tafseer: And with them there will be maidens of restrained glances restricting their eyes to their spouses of a like age of the same age girls who are thirty three years of age atrāb is the plural of tirb.

ayah_ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayah_en: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning.
Tafseer: ‘This that is mentioned is what you are promised by way of the unseen there is a shift in the address away from the third to the second person for the Day of Reckoning.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
ayah_en: This is indeed Our provision that will never end.
Tafseer: This is indeed Our provision which will never be exhausted’ in other words one which will never cease this last sentence mā lahu min nafādin is a circumstantial qualifier referring to rizqunā ‘Our provision’; or it is a second predicate of inna ‘indeed’ meaning that it will be ‘everlasting’.

ayah_ar: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ
ayah_en: That is that. And the transgressors will certainly have the worst destination:
Tafseer: That which is mentioned will be the reward for the believers is so; but for the insolent this is a new sentence there will surely be an evil place of return —

ayah_ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
ayah_en: Hell, where they will burn. What an evil place to rest!
Tafseer: Hell which they will enter — an evil resting place!

ayah_ar: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ
ayah_en: Let them then taste this: boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus,
Tafseer: This chastisement — inferred as so by what follows — let them then taste it burning hot water and pus read ghasāq or ghassāq the festering matter excreted by the inhabitants of the Fire;

ayah_ar: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
ayah_en: and other torments of the same sort!
Tafseer: and other ākhar may be plural or singular kinds of torment resembling it in other words like the boiling water and pus mentioned in pairs of all sorts in other words their chastisement will consist of various kinds.

ayah_ar: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
ayah_en: ˹The misleaders will say to one another,˺ “Here is a crowd ˹of followers˺ being thrown in with us. They are not welcome, ˹for˺ they ˹too˺ will burn in the Fire.”
Tafseer: And it will be said to them as they enter the Fire with their followers ‘This is a horde about to plunge to enter with you into the Fire violently — at which point those who used to be followed say no welcome is there for them here! in other words they will find no comfort for them here. They will indeed roast in the Fire’.

ayah_ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
ayah_en: The followers will respond, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this upon us. What an evil place for settlement!”
Tafseer: They the followers say ‘Nay but for you there is no welcome! You prepared this that is disbelief for us. So what an evil abode!’ for us and for you is the Fire.

ayah_ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
ayah_en: Adding, “Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, double their punishment in the Fire.”
Tafseer: They also say ‘Our Lord whoever prepared this for us give him double his chastisement that is give him in addition the like of his chastisement for his disbelief in the Fire!’

ayah_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
ayah_en: The tyrants will ask ˹one another˺, “But why do we not see those we considered to be lowly?
Tafseer: And they the disbelievers of Mecca say while they are in the Fire ‘What is the matter with us that we do not see here men whom we used to count in the world among the wicked?

ayah_ar: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
ayah_en: Were we wrong in mocking them ˹in the world˺? Or do our eyes ˹just˺ fail to see them ˹in the Fire˺?”
Tafseer: Did we treat them mockingly? read sukhriyyan or sikhriyyan did we use to deride them in the life of the world the final yā’ in sikhriyyā is attributive. In other words are they missing? Or have our eyes missed them here?’ so that we have not caught sight of them. Such men were the poor among the Muslims like ‘Ammār b. Yāsir Bilāl al-Habashī Suhayb al-Rūmī and Salmān al-Fārisī.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
ayah_en: This dispute between the residents of the Fire will certainly come to pass.
Tafseer: Assuredly that is true such a scene will necessarily take place which is the wrangling of the inhabitants of the Fire — as shown above.

ayah_ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
ayah_en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a warner. And there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah—the One, the Supreme.
Tafseer: Say O Muhammad (s) to the disbelievers of Mecca ‘I am only a warner to threaten disbelievers with punishment in the Fire. And there is no god except God the One the All-Compelling of all His creatures;

ayah_ar: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
ayah_en: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between—the Almighty, Most Forgiving.”
Tafseer: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them the Mighty Whose way always prevails the ever Forgiving’ of His friends.

ayah_ar: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
ayah_en: Say, “This ˹Quran˺ is momentous news,
Tafseer: Say to them ‘It is a tremendous tiding

ayah_ar: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
ayah_en: from which you ˹pagans˺ are turning away.”
Tafseer: from which you are turning away namely the Qur’ān of which I have informed you and in which I have brought you what can only be known by revelation and that is God’s saying

ayah_ar: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
ayah_en: ˹And say,˺ “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly ˹in heaven˺ when they differed ˹concerning Adam˺.
Tafseer: I had no knowledge of the High Council that is to say of the angels when they disputed in the matter of Adam when God exalted be He said to them ‘I am appointing on earth a vicegerent’ to the end of the verse Q. 230.

ayah_ar: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
ayah_en: What is revealed to me is that I am only sent with a clear warning.”
Tafseer: All that is revealed to me is that I am just a plain warner’ one whose warning is clear.

ayah_ar: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ
ayah_en: ˹Remember, O  Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay.
Tafseer: Mention when your Lord said to the angels ‘Indeed I am about to create a human being out of clay and this was Adam.

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayah_en: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”
Tafseer: So when I have proportioned him completed him and breathed in him when I have caused to flow therein My spirit so that he becomes a living being — the addition of ‘the spirit’ to Adam is an honour for him; the ‘spirit’ is a subtle body that gives life to a human being by permeating him — then fall down in prostration before him!’ — a prostration of salutation that is actually a bow.

ayah_ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
ayah_en: So the angels prostrated all together—
Tafseer: Thereat the angels prostrated all of them together there are two emphases here kulluhum and ajma‘ūn;

ayah_ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayah_en: but not Iblis, becoming unfaithful.
Tafseer: except Iblīs the father of the jinn who was among the audience of angels; he was disdainful and he was one of the disbelievers according to God’s knowledge exalted be He.

ayah_ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
ayah_en: Allah asked, “O Iblis! What prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My Own Hands? Did you ˹just˺ become proud? Or have you always been arrogant?”
Tafseer: He said ‘O Iblīs! What prevents you from prostrating before that which I have created with My own hands? in other words whose creation I Myself have undertaken. This in itself is an honour for Adam as God has Himself undertaken the unmediated creation of all creatures. Are you being arrogant now in refraining from prostrating an interrogative meant as a rebuke; or are you of the exalted?’ of the proud and have therefore disdained to prostrate yourself because you are one of them?

ayah_ar: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ
ayah_en: He replied, “I am better than he is: You created me from fire and him from clay.”
Tafseer: He said ‘I am better than him. You created me from fire and You created him from clay’.

ayah_ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
ayah_en: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed.
Tafseer: He said ‘Then begone hence that is from Paradise — or it is said begone from the heavens — for you are indeed accursed outcast.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayah_en: And surely upon you is My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”
Tafseer: And indeed My curse shall be on you until the Day of Judgement’ the Day of Requital.

ayah_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayah_en: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”
Tafseer: He said ‘My Lord then reprieve me until the day when they mankind will be raised’.

ayah_ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
ayah_en: Allah said, “You will be delayed
Tafseer: He said ‘Then you will indeed be among the reprieved

ayah_ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
ayah_en: until the appointed Day.”
Tafseer: until the day of the known time’ the time of the First Blast.

ayah_ar: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayah_en: Satan said, “By Your Glory! I will certainly mislead them all,
Tafseer: He said ‘Now by Your might I shall surely pervert them all

ayah_ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayah_en: except Your chosen servants among them.”
Tafseer: except those servants of Yours among them who will be saved’ namely the believers.

ayah_ar: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
ayah_en: Allah concluded, “The truth is—and I ˹only˺ say the truth—:
Tafseer: He said ‘So the truth is — and the truth I always speak read both words in the accusative fa’l-haqqa wa’l-haqqa; or with the first in the nominative and the second in the accusative because of the verb aqūlu ‘I speak’ that follows. As for reading the first one in the accusative this would be on account of the mentioned verb qāla ‘he said’; but it is also said to be on account of its being a verbal noun the sense being uhiqqu l-haqqa ‘I establish the truth’; or it is in the accusative by implication if the particle for the oath fa is removed. It the first haqq could also be in the nominative because of its being the subject of a missing predicate as in fa’l-haqqu minnī ‘truth comes from Me’. It is also said that the sentence means fa’l-haqqu qasamī ‘the truth is this oath from Me’ the response to which is the following la-amla’anna … —

ayah_ar: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayah_en: I will surely fill up Hell with you and whoever follows you from among them, all together.”
Tafseer: I shall assuredly fill Hell with you by way of filling it with your progeny and with whoever of them follows you that is of mankind all together’.

ayah_ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
ayah_en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹Quran˺, nor do I pretend to be someone I am not.
Tafseer: Say ‘I do not ask of you in return for this for delivering the Message to you any reward any fee; nor am I an impostor so as to make up the Qur’ān myself.

ayah_ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayah_en: It is only a reminder to the whole world.
Tafseer: It is only in other words the Qur’ān is only a reminder an admonition for all worlds those of humans jinn and other rational beings but excluding the angels.

ayah_ar: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
ayah_en: And you will certainly know its truth before long.”
Tafseer: And you will assuredly come to know O disbelievers of Mecca its tiding the news of its truth in due time’ that is to say on the Day of Resurrection ‘ilm ‘knowing’ is here being used in the sense of ‘urf ‘experience’; the prefixed lām in la-ta‘lamunna ‘you will assuredly know’ is for an implicit oath in other words what is meant is wa’Llāhi la-ta‘lamunna ‘By God you will assuredly know’.

ayah_ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
ayah_en: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise.
Tafseer: The revelation of the Book the Qur’ān tanzīlu’l-kitābi the subject is from God mina’Llāhi its predicate the Mighty in His kingdom the Wise in His handiwork.

ayah_ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
ayah_en: Indeed, We have sent down the Book to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth, so worship Allah ˹alone˺, being sincerely devoted to Him.
Tafseer: Indeed We have revealed to you O Muhammad (s) the Book with the truth bi’l-haqqi is semantically connected to anzalnā ‘We have revealed’; so worship God devoting your religion purely to Him pure of any idolatry in other words affirming His Oneness.

ayah_ar: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ
ayah_en: Indeed, sincere devotion is due ˹only˺ to Allah.
