Little do you remember! read both verbs either in the second person plural or in the third person plural; the mā preceding both verbs is extra intended for emphasis. The meaning is they believed and remembered only very few things of what the Prophet s did things such as his good acts his kindness to kin and abstinence; yet this will be of no avail to them.

ayah_ar: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayah_en: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds.
Tafseer: Rather it is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

ayah_ar: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
ayah_en: Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name,
Tafseer: And had he namely the Prophet s fabricated any lies against Us by communicating from Us that which We have not said

ayah_ar: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
ayah_en: We would have certainly seized him by his right hand,
Tafseer: We would have assuredly seized him We would have exacted vengeance against him as punishment by the Right Hand by Our strength and power;

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
ayah_en: then severed his aorta,
Tafseer: then We would have assuredly severed his life-artery the aorta of the heart a vein that connects with it and which if severed results in that person’s death

ayah_ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
ayah_en: and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺!
Tafseer: and not one of you ahadin is the subject of mā min being extra used to emphasise the negation; minkum is a circumstantial qualifier referring to ahadin could have defended him hājizīna is the predicate of the preceding mā and it is used in the plural because ahad when employed in a negatory context denotes a plural sense; the suffixed pronoun in ‘anhu refers to the Prophet in other words there is none to prevent Us from punishing him.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayah_en: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺.
Tafseer: And assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is a reminder for the God-fearing.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial,
Tafseer: And assuredly We know that some of you O people are deniers of the Qur’ān and some of you are believers in it.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayah_en: and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers.
Tafseer: And assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is a cause of anguish for the disbelievers when they see the reward of those who affirmed its truth and the punishment of those who denied it.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayah_en: And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth.
Tafseer: And assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is the certain truth.

ayah_ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayah_en: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest.
Tafseer: So glorify exalt as transcendent the Name bi’smi the bā’ bi- is extra of your Lord the Tremendous glory be to Him.

ayah_ar: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ
ayah_en: A challenger has demanded a punishment bound to come
Tafseer: A petitioner petitioned a supplicator supplicated for an impending chastisement

ayah_ar: لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌۭ
ayah_en: for the disbelievers—to be averted by none—
Tafseer: — which in the case of the disbelievers none can avert this was al-Nadr b. al-Hārith who said ‘O God if this be indeed the truth from You … then rain down upon us stones from the heaven’ Q. 832

ayah_ar: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
ayah_en: from Allah, Lord of pathways of ˹heavenly˺ ascent,
Tafseer: from God mina’Llāhi is semantically connected to wāqi‘in ‘impending’ Lord of the Ascensions the ascension routes of the angels which are the heavens.

ayah_ar: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
ayah_en: ˹through which˺ the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit
Tafseer: To Him to the place in the heaven to which His command descends ascend read feminine person ta‘ruju or masculine person ya‘ruju the angels and the Spirit Gabriel in a day fī yawmin is semantically connected to an omitted clause that is to say ‘in a day in which the chastisement befalls them’ on the Day of Resurrection whose span is fifty thousand years from the perspective of the disbeliever on account of the calamities he will encounter in it — but as for the believer it the mentioned day will be easier for him than an obligatory prayer which he performs in this world as stated in hadīth.

ayah_ar: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًۭا جَمِيلًا
ayah_en: So endure ˹this denial, O  Prophet,˺ with beautiful patience.
Tafseer: So be patient — this was revealed before he the Prophet was commanded to fight — with a graceful patience that is one in which there is no anguish.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًۭا
ayah_en: They truly see this ˹Day˺ as impossible,
Tafseer: Lo! they see it that is the chastisement as being far off as never taking place;

ayah_ar: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًۭا
ayah_en: but We see it as inevitable.
Tafseer: while We see it to be near taking place without a doubt.

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
ayah_en: On that Day the sky will be like molten brass
Tafseer: The day when the heaven will be yawma takūnu’l-samā’u is semantically connected to an omitted clause implicitly taken to be yaqa‘u ‘it will take place’ as molten silver

ayah_ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
ayah_en: and the mountains like ˹tufts of˺ wool.
Tafseer: and the mountains will be as flakes of wool in terms of their lightness and their floating about in the wind.

ayah_ar: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًۭا
ayah_en: And no close friend will ask ˹about˺ their friends,
Tafseer: And no friend will inquire about his friend no relative will inquire about his relative each being preoccupied with his own predicament.

ayah_ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
ayah_en: ˹although˺ they will be made to see each other. The wicked will wish to ransom themselves from the punishment of that Day by their children,
Tafseer: They will however be made to see them that is friends will catch sight of one another recognising one another but refraining from speaking to one another the sentence yubassarūnahum is a new independent one. The guilty one will desire the disbeliever will yearn to ransom himself from the chastisement of that day read min ‘adhābi yawmi’dhin or min ‘adhābin yawma’idhin at the price of his children

ayah_ar: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
ayah_en: their spouses, their siblings,
Tafseer: and his companion his wife and his brother

ayah_ar: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
ayah_en: their clan that sheltered them,
Tafseer: and his kin his clan expressed as fasīla because he is a detached part fasl of it that had sheltered him embraced him

ayah_ar: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
ayah_en: and everyone on earth altogether, just to save themselves.
Tafseer: and all who are on earth if it that ransom might then deliver him thumma yunjīhi is a supplement to yaftadī ‘to ransom himself’.

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
ayah_en: But no! There will certainly be a raging Flame
Tafseer: Nay! — a refutation of his wish. Lo! for him it namely the Fire will be the Churning Fire lazā — a name for Hell so called because it churns its flames tatalazzā against the disbelievers

ayah_ar: نَزَّاعَةًۭ لِّلشَّوَىٰ
ayah_en: ripping off scalps.
Tafseer: ripping out the scalp shawā is the plural of shawāt the skin of the head;

ayah_ar: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayah_en: It will summon whoever turned their backs ˹on Allah˺ and turned away ˹from the truth˺,
Tafseer: it will call him who turned his back and ignored faith saying to him ‘To me! to me come hither!’

ayah_ar: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
ayah_en: and gathered and hoarded ˹wealth˺.
Tafseer: and amassed wealth then hoarded keeping it in containers and refraining from paying from it what is God’s due.

ayah_ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
ayah_en: Indeed, humankind was created impatient:
Tafseer: Indeed man was created restless halū‘an is an implied circumstantial qualifier the explanation of which follows

ayah_ar: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًۭا
ayah_en: distressed when touched with evil,
Tafseer: when evil befalls him he is anxious at the point of that evil befalling him

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
ayah_en: and withholding when touched with good—
Tafseer: and when good befalls him he is grudging at the point of that good befalling him that is to say when wealth befalls him he is grudging to give of it what is due to God;

ayah_ar: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
ayah_en: except those who pray,
Tafseer: except those who perform prayers that is the believers

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
ayah_en: consistently performing their prayers;
Tafseer: those who maintain those who regularly observe their prayers

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
ayah_en: and who give the rightful share of their wealth
Tafseer: and in whose wealth there is an acknowledged due namely alms

ayah_ar: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
ayah_en: to the beggar and the poor;
Tafseer: for the beggar and the deprived the latter being the one who refrains from begging and thus becomes deprived

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayah_en: and who ˹firmly˺ believe in the Day of Judgment;
Tafseer: and who affirm the truth of the Day of Judgement of Requital

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
ayah_en: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord—
Tafseer: and who are apprehensive of the chastisement of their Lord —

ayah_ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍۢ
ayah_en: ˹knowing that˺ none should feel secure from their Lord’s punishment—
Tafseer: lo! there is no security from the chastisement of their Lord from its being sent down —

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
ayah_en: and those who guard their chastity
Tafseer: and those who guard their private parts

ayah_ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayah_en: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame,
Tafseer: except from their wives and those whom their right hands own in the way of slavegirls for in that case they are not blameworthy;

ayah_ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
ayah_en: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors.
Tafseer: but whoever seeks beyond that those are the infringers who transgress the bounds of what is lawful stepping into what is unlawful;

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
ayah_en: ˹The faithful are˺ also those who are true to their trusts and covenants;
Tafseer: and those who are keepers faithful guardians of their trusts amānātihim a variant reading has the singular amānatihim that to which they are entrusted of religion and the affairs of this world and their covenant the one taken from them regarding such things

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
ayah_en: and who are honest in their testimony;
Tafseer: and who are forthwith with their testimony bi-shahādatihim a variant reading has the plural bi-shahādātihim ‘their testimonies’ those who offer them and do not withhold them

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
ayah_en: and who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers.
Tafseer: and who preserve their prayers by observing them in their appointed times.

ayah_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ مُّكْرَمُونَ
ayah_en: These will be in Gardens, held in honour.
Tafseer: Those will be in Gardens honoured.

ayah_ar: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
ayah_en: So what is the matter with the disbelievers that they rush ˹head-long˺ towards you ˹O Prophet˺,
Tafseer: So what is wrong with those who disbelieve that they keep staring towards you muhti‘īna is a circumstantial qualifier

ayah_ar: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
ayah_en: from the right and the left, in groups ˹to mock you˺?
Tafseer: to the right and to the left of you in droves? ‘izīna is also a circumstantial qualifier in other words in groups standing in circles one next to the other saying in mockery of the believers ‘Verily if the likes of these are to enter Paradise we shall enter it before them’. God exalted be He says

ayah_ar: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?
Tafseer: Does each one of them hope to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayah_en: But no! Indeed, they ˹already˺ know what We created them from.
Tafseer: Nay! — meant to thwart their hopes of entering Paradise. Indeed We created them as others from what they know from drops of sperm and so one cannot hope for Paradise merely on account of this one hopes for it by being God-fearing.

ayah_ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayah_en: So, I do swear by the Lord of ˹all˺ the points of sunrise and sunset that We are truly capable
Tafseer: For verily fa-lā lā is extra I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the sun the moon and all the stars that We are able

ayah_ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
ayah_en: of replacing them with ˹others˺ better than them, and We cannot be prevented ˹from doing so˺.
Tafseer: to replace them to bring in their place with others better than them and We are not to be outmanoeuvred We will not be frustrated in this.

ayah_ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayah_en: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been threatened with—
Tafseer: So leave them to indulge in their falsehoods and to play in this world of theirs until they encounter that day of theirs in which they are promised chastisement;

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
ayah_en: the Day they will come forth from the graves swiftly, as if racing to an idol ˹for a blessing˺,
Tafseer: the day when they will come forth from the graves hastening to the site of the Gathering as if racing to a standing target nasbin a variant reading has nusubin meaning something that has been erected mansūb such as a flag or a banner

ayah_ar: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
ayah_en: with eyes downcast, utterly covered with disgrace. That is the Day they have ˹always˺ been warned of.
Tafseer: with their eyes humbled abject overcast by abasement shrouded in it. Such is the day which they are promised dhālika is the subject and what follows it is the predicate meaning the Day of Resurrection.

ayah_ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayah_en: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”
Tafseer: Verily We sent Noah to his people saying ‘Warn your people before there come on them — should they not believe — a painful chastisement’ in this world and in the Hereafter.

ayah_ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
ayah_en: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning:
Tafseer: He said ‘O my people I am indeed a plain warner to you one whose warning is plain

ayah_ar: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayah_en: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me.
Tafseer: to tell you that you should worship God and fear Him and obey me

ayah_ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayah_en: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”
Tafseer: that He may forgive you some of your sins min dhunūbikum ‘some of your sins’ min may be taken as extra because submission to God islām expunges everything of sin that was committed previous to it; or it min may be understood as partitive to point out that which is due to those who were already God’s servants and defer you without chastising you until an appointed term the term for death. Indeed when God’s term for your chastisement — should you not believe — comes it cannot be deferred if only you knew’ this you would believe.

ayah_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
ayah_en: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night,
Tafseer: He said ‘My Lord I have summoned my people night and day that is to say continuously without interruption

ayah_ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا
ayah_en: but my calls only made them run farther away.
Tafseer: but my summon has only increased their evasion of faith.

ayah_ar: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا
ayah_en: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly.
Tafseer: And indeed whenever I summoned them so that You might forgive them they put their fingers in their ears in order not to hear what I say and draw their cloaks over themselves they cover their heads with them in order not to catch sight of me and they persist in their disbelief and act in great arrogance disdaining faith.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا
ayah_en: Then I certainly called them openly,
Tafseer: Then indeed I summoned them aloud that is to say at the top of my voice;

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا
ayah_en: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately,
Tafseer: then assuredly I proclaimed to them with my voice and I confided my words to them secretly

ayah_ar: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
ayah_en: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving.
Tafseer: saying “Ask your Lord for forgiveness from idolatry. Assuredly He is ever Forgiving.

ayah_ar: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا
ayah_en: He will shower you with abundant rain,
Tafseer: He will release the heaven the rain — for they had been deprived of it — for you in torrents in plenteous showers

ayah_ar: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا
ayah_en: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers.
Tafseer: and furnish you with wealth and sons and assign to you gardens orchards and assign to you running rivers.

ayah_ar: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا
ayah_en: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah,
Tafseer: What is wrong with you that you do not hope for dignity from God that is to say that you do not hope that God will dignify you by becoming believers

ayah_ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
ayah_en: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺?
Tafseer: when verily He created you in stages? atwār is the plural of tūr which means a state. Thus the sperm-drop is one state the blood clot is another state and so on until the creation of the human being is complete reflecting on the manner of his creation necessarily leads to belief in his Creator.

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا
ayah_en: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other,
Tafseer: Have you not seen how God created seven heavens in layers one on top of the other

ayah_ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا
ayah_en: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp?
Tafseer: and made the moon therein — that is to say within their totality but which is effectively true in the case of the heaven of this world — as a light and made the sun as a lamp? as an illuminating lantern more powerful than the light of the moon.

ayah_ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا
ayah_en: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant.
Tafseer: And God has caused you to grow He has created you from the earth for He created your father Adam from it.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا
ayah_en: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺.
Tafseer: Then He will make you return into it entombed in your graves and bring you forth for the resurrection with a veritable bringing forth.

ayah_ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا
ayah_en: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you
Tafseer: And God has made the earth a flat open expanse for you

ayah_ar: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا
ayah_en: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”
Tafseer: so that you may follow throughout it spacious routes.” ’

ayah_ar: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
ayah_en: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss,
Tafseer: Noah said ‘My Lord they have disobeyed me and followed that is the riffraff and the paupers among them have followed those whose wealth and children namely their leaders who have been blessed with such things read wulduhu or waladuhu ‘whose children’ the first of which is said to be the plural of walad similar in pattern to khasab khushb or in fact it is said to be of the same meaning as walad but an alternative form as in the case of bukhl or bakhal ‘niggardliness’ only add to their loss to their insolence and disbelief.

ayah_ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا
ayah_en: and who have devised a tremendous plot,
Tafseer: And they have devised namely the leaders a mighty plot extremely outrageous by denying Noah and harming him as well as his followers

ayah_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
ayah_en: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwa’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’
Tafseer: and have said to the riffraff “Do not abandon your gods and do not abandon Wadd read Wadd or Wudd nor Suwā‘ nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr” — these being the names of their idols.

ayah_ar: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا
ayah_en: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”
Tafseer: And they have certainly led astray by these gods many people by commanding them to worship them. And do not O God increase the evildoers except in error!’ wa-lā tazidi’l-zālimīna illā dalālan is a supplement to qad adallū ‘they have certainly led astray’ He Noah invoked God against them when it was revealed to him that ‘None of your people will believe except he who has already believed’ Q. 1136.

ayah_ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
ayah_en: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah.
Tafseer: Because of mimmā mā indicates a relative clause their iniquities khatāyāhum a variant reading has khatī’ātihim they were drowned by the Flood then made to enter the Fire with which they were punished underwater after drowning. And they did not find for themselves besides that is to say other than God any helpers to protect them against the chastisement.

ayah_ar: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
ayah_en: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth.
Tafseer: And Noah said ‘My Lord do not leave from among the disbelievers a single dweller upon the earth dayyār means ‘one who inhabits a dwelling dār’ in other words not one.

ayah_ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا
ayah_en: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers.
Tafseer: Assuredly if You leave them they will lead Your servants astray and will beget only disbelieving profligates fājir and kaffār derive respectively from yafjuru and yakfuru he said this on account of the mentioned revelation that had been given to him.

ayah_ar: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
ayah_en: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
Tafseer: My Lord forgive me and my parents — both of whom were believers — and whoever enters my house my dwelling or my place of worship as a believer and believing men and believing women to the Day of Resurrection and do not increase the evildoers except in ruin’ in destruction — and thus they were destroyed.

ayah_ar: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
ayah_en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation.
Tafseer: Say O Muhammad (s) to people ‘It has been revealed to me that is to say I have been informed by way of revelation from God exalted be He that annahu the suffixed pronoun is that of the matter a company of the jinn the jinn of Nasībīn. This was at the time of the morning prayer at Batn Nakhla a location between Mecca and Tā’if — these jinn being those mentioned in God’s saying And when We sent a company of jinn your way…’ Q. 4629 — listened to my recitation then said to their people upon returning to them “We have indeed heard a marvellous Qur’ān whose clarity the richness of its meanings and other aspects one marvels at

ayah_ar: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
ayah_en: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺.
Tafseer: which guides to rectitude to faith and propriety. Therefore we believe in it and we will never after this day associate anyone with our Lord.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
ayah_en: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring,
Tafseer: And we believe that annahu the pronoun in this and in the next two instances is that of the matter — exalted be the majesty of our Lord transcendent is His majesty and magnificence above what is ascribed to Him — He has taken neither spouse nor son.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
ayah_en: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah.
Tafseer: And that the fool among us the ignorant one among us used to utter atrocious lies against God extreme calumny by attributing to Him a spouse and a son.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
ayah_en: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah.
Tafseer: And we thought that an softened that is to say annahu humans and jinn would never utter a lie against God by attributing such things to Him until we discovered their mendacity thereby. God exalted be He says

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
ayah_en: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness.
Tafseer: And that certain individuals of mankind used to seek the protection of certain individuals of the jinn when they stopped over in dangerous places during their journeys — whereat every man would say ‘I seek the protection of the lord of this place against the evil of the insolent ones in it’ — so that they increased them by their seeking their protection in oppressiveness such that they would say ‘We are now lords of jinn and humans!’.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
ayah_en: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺.
Tafseer: And they namely the jinn thought just as you O humans thought that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu God would never raise anyone after his death.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
ayah_en: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars.
Tafseer: The jinn say And we made for the heaven we desired to listen by stealth but we found it filled with mighty guards from among the angels and meteors scorching stars this was at the time of the sending of the Prophet s.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
ayah_en: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them.
Tafseer: And we used to that is to say before his Mission sit in certain places therein to listen in; but anyone listening now will find a meteor lying in wait for him aimed at him ready to strike him.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
ayah_en: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right.
Tafseer: And we do not know by not being able to eavesdrop by stealth whether ill is intended for those who are in the earth or whether their Lord intends for them good.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
ayah_en: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions.
Tafseer: And that among us some have become righteous after having listened to the Qur’ān and some of us are otherwise that is to say a folk who are unrighteous; we are made up of different sects opposing groups some submitters to God and others disbelievers.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
ayah_en: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺.
Tafseer: And we assume that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu we will never be able to elude God in the earth nor will we be able to elude Him by fleeing — we will not be able to escape Him whether we are on earth or fleeing from it in the heavens.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
ayah_en: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged.
Tafseer: And that when we heard the guidance the Qur’ān we believed in it. For whoever believes in his Lord read an implied huwa ‘he’ before fa-lā yakhāfu shall fear neither loss a diminishing of his good deeds nor oppression nor injustice by having his evil deeds increased.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
ayah_en: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance.
Tafseer: And that among us some have submitted to God while some of us are unjust tyrants — on account of their disbelief. So whoever has submitted to God those are the ones who seek right guidance.

ayah_ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا
ayah_en: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”
Tafseer: And as for those are unjust they will be firewood fuel for Hell!” ’ annā annahum and annahu totalling all twelve instances above including innahu ta‘ālā and annā minnā’l-muslimūna and what comes in between them may be read with a kasra sc. innā innahum etc. indicating a new sentence every time or with a fatha sc. annā annahum etc. indicating the statement that will follow as a relative clause.

ayah_ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
ayah_en: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—
Tafseer: God exalted be He says the following about the Meccan disbelievers And it has been revealed to me that if they allaw softened in place of the hardened form its subject having been omitted that is to say annahum law which is a supplement to annahu istama‘a ‘that a company of jinn listened’ adopt the right path the path of submission to God We will give them abundant water to drink plenteous water from the heaven — this was after rain had been withheld from them for seven years —

ayah_ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
ayah_en: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment.
Tafseer: so that We may try them test them therein and so know through knowledge outwardly manifested the nature of their gratitude. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord from the Qur’ān We will admit him naslukhu or read first person yaslukhu ‘He will admit him’ into a tortuous chastisement.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
ayah_en: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him.
Tafseer: And it has been revealed to me that the places of prayer belong to God so do not invoke in them anyone along with God by associating others with Him like the Jews and Christians do who when they enter their churches and temples they ascribe partners to God.

ayah_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
ayah_en: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him.
Tafseer: And that annahu; or innahu as a new sentence the pronoun being that of the matter when the servant of God the Prophet Muhammad (s) rose to invoke Him to worship Him at Batn Nakhla they that is the jinn listening to his recitation were almost upon him in heaps libadan or lubadan the plural of libda or lubda like felt in the way they were heaped on top of one another crowding in their eagerness to listen to the Qur’ān.

ayah_ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
ayah_en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”
Tafseer: He said in response to the disbelievers saying ‘Abandon this affair of yours!’ a variant reading for qāla ‘he said’ has qul ‘Say’ ‘I invoke only my Lord as God and I do not associate anyone with Him’.

ayah_ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
ayah_en: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”
Tafseer: Say ‘I truly have no power to bring you any harm to lead you astray or any guidance’ any good.

ayah_ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
ayah_en: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him.
Tafseer: Say ‘Indeed none shall protect me from God from His chastisement were I to disobey Him and I shall never find besides Him that is other than Him any refuge.

ayah_ar: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
ayah_en: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever.
Tafseer: I have power to bring you only a communication illā balāghan is excepted from the direct object clause of amliku ‘I have power to bring’ that is to say I have power only to communicate the Message to you from God that is on His behalf and His Messages wa-risālātihi is a supplement to balāghan ‘a communication’; what comes between the excepted clause and the clause from which it is excepted is a parenthetical statement intended to emphasise the preclusion of the Prophet’s ‘ability to bring them anything else’. And whoever disobeys God and His Messenger concerning the affirmation of His Oneness and hence does not believe — indeed there will be for him the fire of Hell abiding khālidīna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the person indicated by man ‘whoever’ in lahu ‘for him’ taking into account its plural import; it khālidīna is also an implied circumstantial qualifier in other words they shall enter it with their abiding having been preordained therein forever’.

ayah_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
ayah_en: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower.
Tafseer: Such that when they see hattā is for inceptiveness but also entailing a purposive sense to an implied preceding clause that is to say they persist in their disbelief until they come to see … what they are promised of chastisement they will then know at the moment that it befalls them either on the day of Badr or on the Day of Resurrection who is weaker in supporters and fewer in numbers in assistants is it them or the believers — according to the former reading? Or is it Me or them according to the latter. Some of them said ‘When will this promise be fulfilled?’ whereupon the following was revealed

ayah_ar: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
ayah_en: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it.
Tafseer: Say ‘I do not know if what you are promised of chastisement is near or if my Lord has set a distant length for it an extent and a term which only He knows.

ayah_ar: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
ayah_en: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone,
Tafseer: Knower He is of the Unseen what is hidden from servants and He does not disclose He does not reveal His Unseen to anyone from mankind

ayah_ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
ayah_en: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them
Tafseer: except to a messenger of whom He approves. Then in addition to disclosing to him what He will to disclose of it by way of making it a miracle for him He despatches He appoints and sends forth before him namely the Messenger and behind him watchers angels to preserve him until He has conveyed it to him as part of the entire revelation

ayah_ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
ayah_en: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
Tafseer: so that He God may know by knowledge outwardly manifested that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu they that is the messengers have conveyed the Messages of their Lord the plural person of the verb ablaghū ‘they have conveyed’ takes into account the plural implication of man ‘whom’ and He encompasses all that is with them wa-ahāta bimā ladayhim is a supplement to an implied clause that is to say so He has knowledge of that and keeps count of all things’ ‘adadan ‘count’ is for specification; it is transformed from a direct object sc. ‘adada originally ahsā ‘adada kulli shay’in ‘He keeps count of all things’.

ayah_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
ayah_en: O you wrapped ˹in your clothes˺!
Tafseer: O you enwrapped in your garment! the Prophet al-muzzammil is actually al-mutazammil but the tā’ has been assimilated with the zāy that is to say the one who wraps himself up in his clothes when the Revelation Gabriel comes to him in fear of him because of his awe-inspiring presence.

ayah_ar: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
ayah_en: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—
Tafseer: Stand vigil perform prayer through the night except a little

ayah_ar: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
ayah_en: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less,
Tafseer: a half of it nisfahu substitutes for qalīlan with ‘little’ being little by taking into account the whole night or reduce of it of the half a little up to a third

ayah_ar: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
ayah_en: or a little more—and recite the Quran ˹properly˺ in a measured way.
Tafseer: or add to it up to two thirds aw implies free choice and recite the Qur’ān recite it carefully in a measured tone.

ayah_ar: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا
ayah_en: ˹For˺ We will soon send upon you a weighty revelation.
Tafseer: Verily soon We shall cast on you a weighty an awe-inspiring or stern word a weighty Qur’ān because of the prescriptions imposed in it.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
ayah_en: Indeed, worship in the night is more impactful and suitable for recitation.
Tafseer: Assuredly rising in the night to wake up after having been in sleep is firmer in tread more conducive to establishing harmony between the hearing and the heart for the purpose of comprehending the Qur’ān and more upright in respect to speech clearer for utterance of devotions.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
ayah_en: For during the day you are over-occupied ˹with worldly duties˺.
Tafseer: For assuredly during the day you have extended engagements administering your affairs and you do not have the time to recite Qur’ān.

ayah_ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
ayah_en: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly.
Tafseer: And mention the Name of your Lord that is say bi’smi’Llāhi’l-rahmāni’l-rahīm ‘In the Name of God the Compassionate the Merciful’ to begin your recitation and devote yourself exclusively to Him with complete devotion tabtīlan is the verbal noun from batala used here instead of tabattulan in order to concord with the end-rhyme of the verses for he the Prophet is obliged to devote himself to God.

ayah_ar: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
ayah_en: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs.
Tafseer: He is Lord of the east and the west; there is no god except Him so take Him for a Guardian entrusting your affairs to Him

ayah_ar: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
ayah_en: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say, and depart from them courteously.
Tafseer: and bear patiently what they say that is the disbelievers of Mecca in the way of their maltreatment of you and part with them in a gracious manner without any anguish — this was revealed before the command to fight them.

ayah_ar: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
ayah_en: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while.
Tafseer: And leave Me to deal with the deniers wa’l-mukadhdhibīna is a supplement to the direct object or it is an object of accompaniment; the meaning is ‘I will avail you of them’ they being the doughty leaders of Quraysh those enjoying affluence and respite them a little while — they were killed soon afterwards at Badr.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا
ayah_en: ˹For˺ We certainly have shackles, a ˹raging˺ Fire,
Tafseer: For indeed with Us are heavy fetters ankāl is the plural of nikl heavy shackles and a hell-fire a scorching Fire

ayah_ar: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
ayah_en: choking food, and a painful punishment ˹in store for them˺
Tafseer: and a food that chokes one that causes the throat to choke and this is either zaqqūm cf. Q. 4443 darī‘ cf. Q. 886 ghislīn cf. Q. 6936 or thorns of fire which can neither be vomited nor ingested and a painful chastisement in addition to the punishment mentioned for those who deny the Prophet s

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
ayah_en: on the Day the earth and mountains will shake ˹violently˺, and mountains will be ˹reduced to˺ dunes of shifting sand.
Tafseer: on the day when the earth and the mountains will quake and the mountains will be like heaps of shifting sand mahīl derives from hāla yahīlu; it is actually mahyūl but the damma sound is considered too heavy for the yā’ and is therefore transposed onto the hā’ while the wāw the second of two unvocalised consonants is omitted on account of it being extra and the damma is replaced by a kasra because of its phonetic affinity the letter yā’.

ayah_ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
ayah_en: Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
Tafseer: We have indeed sent to you O people of Mecca a Messenger namely Muhammad (s) to be a witness against you on the Day of Resurrection to any disobedience that you engage in just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger namely Moses peace be upon him.

ayah_ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
ayah_en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a stern grip.
Tafseer: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger so We seized him with a severe seizing.

ayah_ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
ayah_en: If you ˹pagans˺ persist in disbelief, then how will you guard yourselves against ˹the horrors of˺ a Day which will turn children’s hair grey?
Tafseer: So if you disbelieve in this world how will you guard against a day yawman is the direct object of tattaqūna ‘you guard against’ that is against the chastisement thereof by what defence will you defend yourselves against the chastisement of a day that will make the children grey-haired shīb is the plural of ashyab by the severity of its terrors this being the Day of Resurrection the shīn of shīb should actually have a damma but it is given a kasra because of its phonetic affinity with the yā’ — a distressing day is described as being ‘a day that makes the forelocks of children turn grey’ which is usually understood figuratively; but it may be that in the case of this verse it is meant literally —

ayah_ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
ayah_en: It will ˹even˺ cause the sky to split apart. His promise ˹of judgment˺ must be fulfilled.
Tafseer: with the heaven being rent asunder thereon on that Day because of its severity. His promise exalted be He of the coming of that Day shall be fulfilled that is to say it will come to pass without doubt.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
ayah_en: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord.
Tafseer: Indeed these threatening verses are a reminder an admonition for all creatures. Let him who will then choose a way to his Lord a path to Him through faith and obedience.

ayah_ar: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
ayah_en: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Tafseer: Assuredly your Lord knows that you stand vigil less than two thirds of the night or at times a half of it or a third of it if read wa-nisfihi wa-thuluthihi then these constitute a supplement to thuluthay ‘two thirds’; if read wa-nisfahu wa-thuluthahu then a supplement to adnā ‘less than’ — his keeping vigil in the way mentioned is in accordance with what was enjoined on him at the beginning of this sūra — along with a group of those with you wa-tā’ifatun mina’lladhīna ma‘aka constitutes a supplement to the subject of the verb taqūmu ‘you stand vigil’ but it may also constitute although it is not certain a separating clause. The keeping vigil by some of his companions in this way indicates their emulation of him. Some of them could not tell how much of the night they had spent in prayer and how much of it had remained and would therefore keep vigil all night as a precaution; and so they used to keep vigil in this way for a whole year or more with their feet swollen until God alleviated matters for them. He exalted be He says and God keeps measures He keeps count of the night and the day. He knows that an softened in place of the hardened form its subject having been omitted that is to say annahu you will not be able to keep count of it that is the length of the night so that you may perform the vigil at the time in which it is required unless you stay up all night which is hard on you and so He has relented to you making you revert to what is easier. So recite as much as is feasible of the Qur’ān during prayer by performing as much prayer as is feasible. He knows that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu some of you will be sick while others will be travelling in the land seeking the bounty of God seeking of His provision through commerce and otherwise and others will be fighting in the way of God for each of the three groups mentioned the keeping of nightly vigil is hard and so God has alleviated things for them by enjoining on them what is feasible.

ayah_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
ayah_en: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺!
Tafseer: O you enveloped in your mantle the Prophet s al-muddaththir is actually al-mutadaththir but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dāl that is to say the one who is enwrapped in his clothes when the Revelation Gabriel comes down on him

ayah_ar: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
ayah_en: Arise and warn ˹all˺.
Tafseer: arise and warn threaten the people of Mecca with punishment in the Fire should they refuse to believe;

ayah_ar: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
ayah_en: Revere your Lord ˹alone˺.
Tafseer: and magnify your Lord exalt Him above what is ascribed to Him by the idolaters;

ayah_ar: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
ayah_en: Purify your garments.
Tafseer: and purify your clothes from impurity or it means shorten them instead of imitating the way in which the Arabs are wont to let their robes drag behind them out of vanity for perhaps they will be sullied by some impurity;

ayah_ar: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
ayah_en: ˹Continue to˺ shun idols.
Tafseer: and shun all defilement this rijz was explained by the Prophet s to be the graven images; in other words persist in shunning them.

ayah_ar: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
ayah_en: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺.
Tafseer: And do not grant a favour seeking greater gain read tastakthiru as a circumstantial qualifier in other words do not give something in order to demand more in return this stipulation is specific to the Prophet s since he is enjoined to adopt the fairest traits and the noblest of manners;

ayah_ar: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
ayah_en: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord.
Tafseer: and endure patiently for the sake of your Lord all His commands and prohibitions.

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
ayah_en: ˹For˺ when the Trumpet will be sounded,
Tafseer: For when the trumpet is sounded when the trumpet is blown that is the Horn qarn at the second blast

ayah_ar: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
ayah_en: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—
Tafseer: that day that is to say the time of the sounding yawma’idhin is a substitution for the preceding subject and is not declined because it is annexed to something that cannot be declined; the predicate of the subject is the following will be a harsh day idhā is operated by what is indicated by the statement ishtadda’l-amru ‘for when the trumpet is sounded the situation will be terrible’

ayah_ar: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ
ayah_en: far from easy for the disbelievers.
Tafseer: for the disbelievers not at all easy herein is an indication that it will be easy for believers despite its harshness.

ayah_ar: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا
ayah_en: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself,
Tafseer: Leave Me to deal with him whom I created wa-man khalaqtu is a supplement to the direct object or it is an object of accompaniment lonely wahīdan is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the man ‘whom’ or to the pronoun referring to it but omitted from khalaqtu sc. khalaqtuhu alone without family or wealth — this was al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra al-Makhzūmī —

ayah_ar: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا
ayah_en: and granted him abundant wealth,
Tafseer: and then assigned him ample means abundant and continuous generated from his crops livestock and commerce

ayah_ar: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا
ayah_en: and children always by his side,
Tafseer: and sons ten or more present by his side present at social gatherings and whose testimonies are listened to

ayah_ar: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا
ayah_en: and made life very easy for him.
Tafseer: and facilitated extended for him greatly his livelihood duration of life and children.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
ayah_en: Yet he is hungry for more.
Tafseer: Still he is eager that I should give him more.

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا
ayah_en: But no! ˹For˺ he has been truly stubborn with Our revelations.
Tafseer: Nay! I shall not give him more than that. He is indeed stubborn to Our signs to the Qur’ān.

ayah_ar: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
ayah_en: I will make his fate unbearable,
Tafseer: Soon I shall burden him with a trying chastisement; alternatively sa‘ūdan means a mountain of fire which he will be made to ascend and then fall down from forever.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
ayah_en: for he contemplated and determined ˹a degrading label for the Quran˺.
Tafseer: Indeed he pondered what to say about the Qur’ān which he heard from the Prophet s and decided this in his mind.

ayah_ar: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
ayah_en: May he be condemned! How evil was what he determined!
Tafseer: Perish he may he be cursed and chastised how he decided! perish he whatever the nature of his decision may have been.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
ayah_en: May he be condemned even more! How evil was what he determined!
Tafseer: Again perish he how he decided!

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
ayah_en: Then he re-contemplated ˹in frustration˺,
Tafseer: Then he contemplated the faces of his people; or he contemplated with what words he might cast aspersions upon it.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
ayah_en: then frowned and scowled,
Tafseer: Then he frowned he contracted his face and glowered anguished by what he wanted to say and scowled increasing the contracting and the glowering in his face.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
ayah_en: then turned his back ˹on the truth˺ and acted arrogantly,
Tafseer: Then he turned his back to faith in disdain scornful of following the Prophet s

ayah_ar: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
ayah_en: saying, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but magic from the ancients.
Tafseer: and said of what he the Prophet had brought ‘This is nothing but handed-down sorcery learnt from sorcerers;

ayah_ar: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
ayah_en: This is no more than the word of a man.”
Tafseer: this is nothing but the speech of humans’ similar to what they the idolaters had said ‘It is only a human that is teaching him’ Q. 16103.

ayah_ar: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
ayah_en: Soon I will burn him in Hell!
Tafseer: I shall soon admit him into Saqar! — Hell.

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
ayah_en: And what will make you realize what Hell is?
Tafseer: And how would you know what is Saqar? — this interrogative is intended to emphasise its enormity.

ayah_ar: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
ayah_en: It does not let anyone live or die,
Tafseer: It neither spares nor leaves behind anything of flesh or nerve but destroys it all after which he is restored to his former state.

ayah_ar: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ
ayah_en: scorching the skin.
Tafseer: It burns away the flesh scorching the surface of skin.

ayah_ar: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
ayah_en: It is overseen by nineteen ˹keepers˺.
Tafseer: There are nineteen keepers standing over it angels its keepers; a certain disbeliever who was a mighty stalwart said ‘I will avail you seventeen of them if you avail me just two’. God exalted be He says

ayah_ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
ayah_en: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity.
Tafseer: And We have appointed only angels as wardens of the Fire in other words and so they cannot be withstood as these disbelievers are wont to imagine; and We have made their number so only as a stumbling-block a cause for error for those who disbelieve when they then say ‘Why are there nineteen of them?’ so that those who were given the Scripture namely the Jews may be certain of the sincerity of the Prophet s in saying that they are nineteen for this concords with what is in their Scripture; and that those who believe from among the People of the Scripture may increase in faith in affirmation of the truth given that what the Prophet s has said concords with what is in their Scripture and that those given the Scripture and the believers those other than these Jews may not be in doubt concerning the number of these angels and that those in whose hearts there is a sickness an uncertainty those in Medina and the disbelievers in Mecca may say ‘What did God mean by this number as a similitude?’ mathalan they referred to it thus as a mathal on account of it being a curious matter; in terms of syntax it mathalan is a circumstantial qualifier. Thus that is just as the one who rejects this number is led astray and the one who affirms the truth of it is guided God leads astray whom He will and guides whom He will. And none knows the hosts of your Lord namely the angels none knows them in terms of their strength and their assistants except Him. And it that is Saqar is nothing but a reminder for humans.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
ayah_en: But no! By the moon,
Tafseer: Nay kallā denoting a commencement of a new sentence to be understood as alā by the moon!

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
ayah_en: and the night as it retreats,
Tafseer: And by the night when it returns! if read as idhā dabara when it comes back after day a variant reading has idh adbara meaning ‘when it has receded’.

ayah_ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
ayah_en: and the day as it breaks!
Tafseer: And by the dawn when it appears!

ayah_ar: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
ayah_en: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—
Tafseer: Verily it that is Saqar is one of the enormities one of the greatest calamities —

ayah_ar: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ
ayah_en: a warning to humankind,
Tafseer: a warning nadhīran is a circumstantial qualifier referring to ihdā ‘one of’ and it is masculine because it denotes masculine ‘adhāb ‘chastisement’ to all humans;

ayah_ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
ayah_en: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind.
Tafseer: alike to those of you who wish li-man shā’a minkum is a substitution for li’l-bashar ‘to all humans’ to advance towards good or towards Paradise by means of faith or linger behind in evil or in Hell because of their disbelief.

ayah_ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
ayah_en: Every soul will be detained for what it has done,
Tafseer: Every soul is held to ransom by what it earns it is ransomed and requited for its deeds with the Fire

ayah_ar: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayah_en: except the people of the right,
Tafseer: except those of the right hand namely the believers who will be saved from it and who will be

ayah_ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayah_en: who will be in Gardens, asking one another
Tafseer: in gardens questioning one another

ayah_ar: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayah_en: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺:
Tafseer: about the guilty and their predicament; and they will say to them after all those who believed in the One God muwahhidūn are brought out of the Fire

ayah_ar: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
ayah_en: “What has landed you in Hell?”
Tafseer: ‘What has landed you in what has made you enter Saqar?’

ayah_ar: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
ayah_en: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed,
Tafseer: They will say ‘We were not of those who prayed.

ayah_ar: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
ayah_en: nor did we feed the poor.
Tafseer: Nor did we ever feed the needy.

ayah_ar: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
ayah_en: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others,
Tafseer: And we used to delve into falsehood along with those who delved

ayah_ar: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayah_en: and deny the Day of Judgment,
Tafseer: and we used to deny the Day of Judgement the Day of Resurrection and Requital

ayah_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
ayah_en: until the inevitable came to us.”
Tafseer: until finally the inevitable came to us’ — death.

ayah_ar: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
ayah_en: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them.
Tafseer: Thus the intercession of the intercessors from among the angels the prophets and the righteous will not avail them in other words there will be no intercession for them.

ayah_ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
ayah_en: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder,
Tafseer: So what fa-mā the subject is wrong with them lahum the predicate thereof semantically connected to an omitted clause the person of which has been transposed onto it that they turn away mu‘ridīna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the suffixed pronoun in lahum ‘them’ from the Reminder — in other words ‘what has happened to them that they have turned away from admonition’ —

ayah_ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: as if they were spooked zebras
Tafseer: as if they were wild asses

ayah_ar: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
ayah_en: fleeing from a lion?
Tafseer: fleeing from a lion? that is to say fleeing from it with absolute fright.

ayah_ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
ayah_en: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺.
Tafseer: Nay but everyone of them desires to be given unrolled scrolls from God exalted be He enjoining them to follow the Prophet s as they said before ‘And even then we will not believe your ascension until you bring down for us a book that we may read’ Q. 1793.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
ayah_en: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter.
Tafseer: No indeed! kallā a deterrent of what they desire. Rather they do not fear the Hereafter that is the chastisement thereof.

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder.
Tafseer: No indeed! kallā a commencement of a new sentence Assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is a Reminder an admonition.

ayah_ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
ayah_en: So let whoever wills be mindful of it.
Tafseer: So whoever wills shall remember it he shall read it and be admonished by it.

ayah_ar: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
ayah_en: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive.
Tafseer: And they will not remember yadhkurūna or read second person plural tadhkurūna unless God wills it. He is the One worthy of your fear and the One worthy to forgive by forgiving those who fear Him.

ayah_ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
ayah_en: I do swear by the Day of Judgment!
Tafseer: Nay! the lā is extra in both instances I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

ayah_ar: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
ayah_en: And I do swear by the self-reproaching soul!
Tafseer: And nay I swear by the self-reproaching soul the one that reproaches itself even if it should expend great effort in being virtuous the response to the oath has been omitted that is to say la-tub‘athunna ‘you shall indeed be resurrected!’ as indicated by what follows

ayah_ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
ayah_en: Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones?
Tafseer: Does man that is does the disbeliever suppose that We shall not assemble his bones? for the raising from the graves and for the bringing back to life.

ayah_ar: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
ayah_en: Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips.
Tafseer: Yes indeed! We shall assemble them. We are able in addition to assembling them to reshape even his fingers that is to say to restore their bones just as they had been despite their smallness so how much more so are We able to restore the larger ones!

ayah_ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
ayah_en: Still people want to deny what is yet to come,
Tafseer: Nay but man desires to deny li-yafjura the lām is extra and the subjunctive mood is because of an implied preceding an ‘that’ what lies ahead of him namely the Day of Resurrection as is indicated by

ayah_ar: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
ayah_en: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
Tafseer: He asks ‘When is the Day of Resurrection?’ — the question is meant in mockery and denial.

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
ayah_en: But when the sight is stunned,
Tafseer: But when the eyes are dazzled read bariqa or baraqa startled and perplexed upon seeing some of those things which it used to deny;

ayah_ar: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
ayah_en: and the moon is dimmed,
Tafseer: and the moon is eclipsed darkening its light disappearing

ayah_ar: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
ayah_en: and the sun and the moon are brought together,
Tafseer: and the sun and the moon are brought together so that both of them will rise from the west; or it means when the light of both of them disappears — and this will be on the Day of Resurrection —

ayah_ar: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
ayah_en: on that Day one will cry, “Where is the escape?”
Tafseer: on that day man will say ‘Where is the escape?’

ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
ayah_en: But no! There will be no refuge.
Tafseer: No indeed! — a deterrent against seeking to escape — There is no refuge no shelter to seek protection in.

ayah_ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
ayah_en: On that Day all will end up before your Lord.
Tafseer: On that day the recourse will be to your Lord the final recourse of all creatures whereupon they will be reckoned with and requited.

ayah_ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
ayah_en: All will then be informed of what they have sent forth and left behind.
Tafseer: On that day man will be informed of what he has sent ahead and left behind he will be informed of the his first and last deeds.

ayah_ar: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: In fact, people will testify against their own souls,
Tafseer: Rather man has insight into his own soul for his limbs will speak of his deeds the hā’ sc. the tā’ marbūta in basīratun is for hyperbole and so he must be requited

ayah_ar: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
ayah_en: despite the excuses they come up with.
Tafseer: though he should offer his excuses ma‘ādhīr is the plural of ma‘dhira but following a different pattern from the usual ma‘dhira ma‘ādhir that is to say whatever excuse he offers will not be accepted from him.

ayah_ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
ayah_en: Do not rush your tongue trying to memorize ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran.
Tafseer: God exalted be He says to His Prophet Do not move your tongue with it with the Qur’ān before Gabriel is through with reciting it to hasten it fearing to lose it.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
ayah_en: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it.
Tafseer: Assuredly it is for Us to bring it together in your breast and to recite it your reciting of it that is its flowing off your tongue.

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
ayah_en: So once We have recited a revelation ˹through Gabriel˺, follow its recitation ˹closely˺.
Tafseer: So when We recite it to you by means of Gabriel’s recital follow its recitation listen to its recitation thus the Prophet s would listen to it and then repeat it.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
ayah_en: Then it is surely upon Us to make it clear ˹to you˺.
Tafseer: Then it is for Us to explain it by making you comprehend it the connection between this verse and what preceded it is that those verses before imply turning away from God’s signs whereas this one implies applying oneself to them by memorising them.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
ayah_en: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world,
Tafseer: No indeed! kallā is for commencement with the sense of alā Rather you love the transitory life this world both verbs here and below may be read in the second or third person plural

ayah_ar: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
ayah_en: and neglect the Hereafter.
Tafseer: and forsake the Hereafter thus neglecting to work towards attaining bliss in it.

ayah_ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ
ayah_en: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright,
Tafseer: Some faces on that day that is on the Day of Resurrection will be radiant fair and resplendent

ayah_ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: looking at their Lord.
Tafseer: looking upon their Lord in other words they will see God glorified and exalted be He in the Hereafter.

ayah_ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: And ˹other˺ faces will be gloomy,
Tafseer: And other faces on that day will be scowling glowering frowning terribly

ayah_ar: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: anticipating something devastating to befall them.
Tafseer: certain that a spine-crushing calamity will fall on them a great catastrophe one that ‘crushes the spine’ fiqār.

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
ayah_en: But no! ˹Beware of the day˺ when the soul reaches the collar bone ˹as it leaves˺,
Tafseer: No indeed! kallā in the sense of alā When it the soul reaches up to the collar bones

ayah_ar: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ
ayah_en: and it will be said, “Is there any healer ˹who can save this life˺?”
Tafseer: and it is said and those around him the dying one say ‘Where is the enchanter?’ to perform incantations on him and cure him

ayah_ar: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
ayah_en: And the dying person realizes it is ˹their˺ time to depart,
Tafseer: and he suspects he the one whose soul has reached this stage that it is the time of parting the parting with this world

ayah_ar: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
ayah_en: and ˹then˺ their feet are tied together ˹in a shroud˺.
Tafseer: and the shank is intertwined with the other shank that is one of his shanks will be intertwined with his other shank at the moment of death; or it means the distress of parting with this world is intertwined with the distress of the arrival of the Hereafter;

ayah_ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
ayah_en: On that day they will be driven to your Lord ˹alone˺.
Tafseer: on that day to your Lord will be the driving of the souls al-masāq means al-sawq; this indicates the operator of the above idhā ‘when’ the meaning being ‘when the soul reaches the throat it will be driven towards the judgement of its Lord’.

ayah_ar: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
ayah_en: This denier neither believed nor prayed,
Tafseer: For he man neither affirmed the truth nor prayed

ayah_ar: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayah_en: but persisted in denial and turned away,
Tafseer: but he denied the Qur’ān and he turned away from faith

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
ayah_en: then went to their own people, walking boastfully.
Tafseer: then went off to his family swaggering strutting about in self-conceit.

ayah_ar: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
ayah_en: Woe to you, and more woe!
Tafseer: Woe be nearer to you there is a shift from the third to the second person address here; the term awlā is a noun of action with the following lām being explicative in other words ‘what you are averse to is now near to you’ and nearer that is because you are more deserving of it woe than anyone else

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
ayah_en: Again, woe to you, and even more woe!
Tafseer: then may woe be nearer to you and nearer! — repeated for emphasis.

ayah_ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
ayah_en: Do people think they will be left without purpose?
Tafseer: Does man suppose that he is to be left aimless? left to his own devices without being obligated to the prescribed laws let him not suppose that!

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
ayah_en: Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted?
Tafseer: Was he not — that is indeed he was — a drop of emitted semen? read yumnā or tumnā deposited into the womb.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayah_en: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form,
Tafseer: Then it the drop of semen became a clot; then He God created from it man and proportioned him making the parts of his body upright

ayah_ar: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
ayah_en: producing from it both sexes, male and female.
Tafseer: and made of it of the drop of semen that became a blood-clot then an embryo a small mass of flesh the two sexes the two kinds the male and the female at times coming together and at times each being on their own.

ayah_ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
ayah_en: Is such ˹a Creator˺ unable to bring the dead back to life?
Tafseer: Is not such a Doer of all these things able to revive the dead? — the Prophet s would say ‘Yes indeed!’

ayah_ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
ayah_en: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning?
Tafseer: Has there ever been — there has indeed been — for man Adam a period of time forty years in which he was a thing unmentioned? — he was during this period a fashioned in clay and not mentioned; alternatively what is meant by insān ‘man’ is the generic noun and by hīn ‘a period of time’ the period of gestation.

ayah_ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
ayah_en: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see.
Tafseer: Verily We created man the species from a drop of mixed fluid from a mixture that is from the seminal fluid of the man and the ovarian fluid of the woman that have mixed and blended so that We may test him trying him with the moral obligations of religion nabtalīhi is either a new sentence ‘We will test him’ or an implied circumstantial qualifier meaning ‘intending to test him when he is ready’. So We made him for that very reason hearing seeing.

ayah_ar: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
ayah_en: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful.
Tafseer: Verily We have guided him to the way We have pointed out to him the path of guidance by sending messengers to mankind whether he be grateful that is to say whether he be a believer or ungrateful both shākiran and kafūran are circumstantial qualifiers referring to the direct object; in other words We have pointed out to him in both presupposed states whether his gratefulness or his unthankfulness; immā is used to list the ‘states’.

ayah_ar: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
ayah_en: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire.
Tafseer: We have assuredly prepared for the disbelievers chains with which they are dragged through the Fire and fetters around their necks to which the chains will be attached and a hell-fire a fire set ablaze burning fiercely in which they shall be chastised.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
ayah_en: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—
Tafseer: Truly the righteous abrār is the plural of barr or bārr namely the obedient ones will drink from a cup ka’s is a vessel for drinking wine and this wine will be in it; what is meant is that they will drink from ‘wine’ a case where the actuality is referred to by the name of the locus in which it is found; min ‘from is partitive whose mixture that with which it is mixed is camphor;

ayah_ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
ayah_en: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will.
Tafseer: a spring ‘aynan substitutes for kāfūran containing the scent thereof from which the servants of God His friends drink making it gush forth plenteously directing it to wherever they wish of their dwellings.
