ayah_ar: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
ayah_en: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror,
Tafseer: They fulfil their vows pledged in obedience to God and fear a day the evil of which will be widespread.

ayah_ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
ayah_en: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive,
Tafseer: And they give food despite their love of it that is to say despite their love of food and their craving for it to the needy the poor and the orphan who does not have a father and the prisoner meaning the one who has been rightly imprisoned.

ayah_ar: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
ayah_en: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you.
Tafseer: ‘We feed you only for the sake of God seeking His reward. We do not desire any reward from you nor any thanks this contains the reason for the giving of the food. Now do they actually say this or is it that God knows this to be true of them and has thus praised them by mentioning it? The two are different opinions regarding this matter.

ayah_ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
ayah_en: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”
Tafseer: Indeed we fear from our Lord a day of frowning one in which faces scowl in other words a horrid day to observe on account of its severity calamitous’ severe in that respect.

ayah_ar: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
ayah_en: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy,
Tafseer: God has therefore shielded them from the evil of that day and has granted them radiance fairness and resplendence in their faces and joy.

ayah_ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
ayah_en: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk.
Tafseer: And He has rewarded them for their patience for their steadfastness in refraining from disobedience with a Garden into which they are admitted and silk which they are given to wear;

ayah_ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
ayah_en: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold.
Tafseer: reclining muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the implicit verb udkhilūhā ‘they are admitted into it’ therein upon couches arā’ik are beds inside canopies. They will not find lā yarawna is a second circumstantial qualifier therein either sun or bitter cold neither heat nor cold; but it is also said that zamharīr means ‘the moon’ and so in other words it means that it will be bright without any sun or moon.

ayah_ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
ayah_en: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach.
Tafseer: And close dāniyatan is a supplement to the syntactical locus of the clause lā yarawna in other words it is a supplement to the import ghayra rā’īna over them will be its shades its trees and its clusters of fruits will hang low its fruits will brought close so that they are reached by the one standing the one sitting or the one lying down.

ayah_ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
ayah_en: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—
Tafseer: And they will be waited upon from all around them in it with vessels of silver and goblets akwāb are cups without handles of crystal —

ayah_ar: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
ayah_en: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired.
Tafseer: crystal of silver that is they are made of silver which is transparent like crystal — which they that is the ones passing around them in service have measured in a precise measure according to the measure required by the one drinking it neither more nor less which makes for a most delightful drink.

ayah_ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
ayah_en: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger
Tafseer: And they will be given to drink therein a cup wine whose mixture that with which it is mixed is ginger

ayah_ar: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
ayah_en: from a spring there, called Salsabil.
Tafseer: a spring ‘aynan substitutes for zanjabīlan ‘ginger’ therein named Salsabīl meaning that its water is like ginger which the Arabs find very tasteful and which is very palatable for the throat.

ayah_ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
ayah_en: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls.
Tafseer: And they will be waited upon by immortal youths immortally in the form of youths never ageing whom when you see them you will suppose them because of their beauty and the way in which they are scattered about offering service to be scattered pearls strewn from their string or from their shells in which they are fairer than when they the pearls are otherwise not in their shells.

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
ayah_en: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom.
Tafseer: And when you look there that is to say when you begin to look about in Paradise you will see ra’ayta is the response to idhā ‘when’ bliss that is indescribable and a great kingdom vast without limit.

ayah_ar: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
ayah_en: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
Tafseer: Upon them ‘āliyahum is in the accusative as an adverbial clause and constitutes the predicate of a subject that will follow; a variant reading has ‘ālīhim as a subject with what follows as its predicate; the suffixed pronoun -hum denotes those persons to whom the supplement refers will be garments of fine green silk and heavy silk brocade sundus is fine silk and constitutes the outer cushion while istabraq is coarse silk and constitutes the inner lining; either read thiyābu sundusin khudrun wa’stabraqin or thiyābu sundusin khudrin wa’stabraqun or thiyābu sundusin khudrun wa’stabraqun or wa-thiyābu sundusin khudrin wa’stabraqin. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver — elsewhere it is stated ‘of gold’ in order to show that they will be adorned with both types at the same time or separately — and their Lord will give them a pure drink to drink tahūran ‘pure’ is intended as a hyperbolic qualification of its purity and cleanness in contrast to the wine of this world.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
ayah_en: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”
Tafseer: ‘Verily this bliss is a reward for you and your endeavour has been appreciated’.

ayah_ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
ayah_en: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages.
Tafseer: Assuredly We nahnu reiterates the subject of innā ‘assuredly for the purpose of emphasis; alternatively it is a separating pronoun have revealed the Qur’ān to you as a gradual revelation tanzīlan is the predicate of inna ‘assuredly’ in other words We have divided it into parts instead of not revealing it all at once.

ayah_ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
ayah_en: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them.
Tafseer: So submit patiently to your Lord’s decree to you to deliver His Message and do not obey of them that is of the disbelievers any sinner or disbeliever namely ‘Utba b. Rabī‘a and al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra — both of whom said to the Prophet s ‘Abandon this affair of yours!’; it is also possible that what is meant is every sinner or disbeliever in other words ‘Do not obey any of these whichever of the two he may be in what he may summon you to of sin or disbelief’.

ayah_ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
ayah_en: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening,
Tafseer: And mention the Name of your Lord during prayer at dawn and with the declining of the sun that is at dawn fajr noon zuhr and in the afternoon ‘asr;

ayah_ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
ayah_en: and prostrate before Him during part of the night,
Tafseer: and prostrate to Him for a portion of the night that is at after sunset maghrib and at night ‘ishā’ and glorify Him the length of the night perform supererogatory prayers during it as mentioned above for either two thirds a half or a third of it.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
ayah_en: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them.
Tafseer: Assuredly these love the transitory life this world and leave behind them a burdensome day an awful one namely the Day of Resurrection not working towards it.

ayah_ar: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
ayah_en: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others.
Tafseer: We created them and made firm their frames their limbs and their joints and whenever We will We can completely replace them with others like them in terms of their created form in place of them by destroying them tabdīlan ‘completely’ is for emphasis; idhā ‘when’ functions in the sense of in ‘if’ similar to where God says in several places in yasha’ yudhhibkum If He will He can take you away cf. Q. 1419; but because He exalted be He has not willed this it has not happened thus far.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
ayah_en: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord.
Tafseer: This sūra is indeed a reminder an admonition for all creatures. Let him who will then choose a way to his Lord a path through obedience.

ayah_ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
ayah_en: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Tafseer: But you will not tashā’ūna may also be read yashā’ūna ‘they will’ choose a way through obedience unless God wills this. Assuredly God is ever Knower of His creatures Wise in what He does.

ayah_ar: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
ayah_en: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment
Tafseer: He admits whomever He will into His mercy His Paradise namely the believers; and as for the evildoers al-zālimīna is in the accusative because of an implied verb that is to say a‘adda ‘He has prepared’ as explained by what follows He has prepared for them a painful chastisement — these are the disbelievers.

ayah_ar: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
ayah_en: By those ˹winds˺ sent forth successively,
Tafseer: By those sent in succession ‘urfan that is by the winds that follow one another in succession like the mane ‘urf of a horse one part of hair coming after the other ‘urfan is in the accusative because it is a circumstantial qualifier;

ayah_ar: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًۭا
ayah_en: and those blowing violently,
Tafseer: by the raging hurricanes the violent winds;

ayah_ar: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًۭا
ayah_en: and those scattering ˹rainclouds˺ widely!
Tafseer: by the sweeping spreaders by the winds that scatter the rains;

ayah_ar: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًۭا
ayah_en: And ˹by˺ those ˹angels˺ fully distinguishing ˹truth from falsehood˺,
Tafseer: by the decisive discriminators that is by the verses of the Qur’ān which discriminate between truth and falsehood and between what is lawful and what is unlawful;

ayah_ar: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
ayah_en: and those delivering revelation,
Tafseer: by the casters of the remembrance that is by angels that descend with the revelation upon the prophets and messengers casting the revelation onto the various communities of mankind

ayah_ar: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
ayah_en: ending excuses and giving warnings.
Tafseer: to excuse or to warn that is to say in order to excuse or to warn on behalf of God exalted be He a variant reading for nudhran and ‘udhran has nudhuran and ‘udhuran.

ayah_ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
ayah_en: Surely, what you are promised will come to pass.
Tafseer: Surely that which you are promised O disbelievers of Mecca in the way of resurrection and chastisement will befall it will be without any doubt.

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
ayah_en: So when the stars are put out,
Tafseer: So when the stars are obliterated when their light is extinguished

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
ayah_en: and the sky is torn apart,
Tafseer: and when the heaven is rent asunder

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
ayah_en: and the mountains are blown away,
Tafseer: and when the mountains are blown away crushed to pieces and blown in the air

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
ayah_en: and the messengers’ time ˹to testify˺ comes up—
Tafseer: and when the time is set for the testimony of the messengers read uqqitat or wuqqitat that is to say when they are gathered to an appointed time

ayah_ar: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
ayah_en: for which Day has all this been set?
Tafseer: For what day — for a tremendous day — has it been appointed? it has been appointed for witnessing of the messengers against their communities to the effect that they delivered their messages from God.

ayah_ar: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
ayah_en: For the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision!
Tafseer: For the Day of Decision for creatures from this one may infer the response to the clauses beginning with idhā ‘when’ in other words ‘when … the decision will be made for all creatures’.

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
ayah_en: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is?
Tafseer: And how would you know what the Day of Decision is? — emphasising the enormity of its terror.

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day! — a threat of chastisement for them.

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayah_en: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers?
Tafseer: Did We not destroy the ancients for their denial in other words We certainly destroyed them

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayah_en: And We will make the later disbelievers follow them.
Tafseer: then made the latter folk follow them? the latter folk of those who denied such as the disbelievers of Mecca whom We will destroy.

ayah_ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayah_en: This is how We deal with the wicked.
Tafseer: So just as We dealt with those who denied will We deal with the guilty with every individual who will be guilty in the future and destroy them.

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day! — reiterated for emphasis.

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
ayah_en: Did We not create you from a humble fluid,
Tafseer: Did We not create you from a base fluid one that is delicate — and this is semen

ayah_ar: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ
ayah_en: placing it in a secure place
Tafseer: then lodged it in a secure abode that is the womb

ayah_ar: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
ayah_en: until an appointed time?
Tafseer: for a known span? namely the time for delivery.

ayah_ar: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
ayah_en: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so!
Tafseer: Thus We were able to do this; so how excellent able ones We are!

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day!

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
ayah_en: Have We not made the earth a lodging
Tafseer: Have We not made the earth a receptacle kifātan is a verbal noun from kafata meaning damma ‘enclosed’ that is an enclosure

ayah_ar: أَحْيَآءًۭ وَأَمْوَٰتًۭا
ayah_en: for the living and the dead,
Tafseer: for the living on its surface and the dead inside it

ayah_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
ayah_en: and placed upon it towering, firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink?
Tafseer: and set therein soaring mountains and give you sweet water to drink?

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day!

ayah_ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayah_en: ˹The disbelievers will be told,˺ “Proceed into that ˹Fire˺ which you used to deny!
Tafseer: And on the Day of Resurrection it will be said to the deniers Depart to that chastisement which you used to deny!

ayah_ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
ayah_en: Proceed into the shade ˹of smoke˺ which rises in three columns,
Tafseer: Depart to a triple-forked shadow — this is the smoke of Hell which as it rises splits into three parts because of its magnitude —

ayah_ar: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
ayah_en: providing neither coolness nor shelter from the flames.
Tafseer: which is neither shady neither protective unable to shade them from the heat of that Day nor of any avail against nor wards off from them anything of the flame the Fire.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
ayah_en: Indeed, it hurls sparks ˹as big˺ as huge castles,
Tafseer: Indeed it that is the Fire throws up sparks namely those flame that are thrown by it into the air huge like palace edifices in terms of their enormity and vertical extension

ayah_ar: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ
ayah_en: and ˹as dark˺ as black camels.”
Tafseer: as if they were dark yellow camels jimālātun is the plural of jimalatun the plural of jamalun; a variant reading has jimālatun in terms of their shape and colour. In hadīth it is stated ‘The sparks of humans thrown into the air by the Fire are black as pitch qīr’; the Arabs call dark camels sufr ‘yellow’ because a touch of yellow is mixed with their blackish colour and therefore it is said that ‘yellow’ in this verse actually means ‘black’ on account of what has been mentioned; but some say no to this interpretation; sharar is the plural of sharāra; qīr is qār ‘pitch’.

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day!

ayah_ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
ayah_en: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak,
Tafseer: This namely the Day of Resurrection is the day in which they will not utter anything

ayah_ar: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
ayah_en: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses.
Tafseer: nor will they be given permission to offer excuses and so offer excuses fa-ya‘tadhirūna is a supplement to yu’dhanu ‘given permission’ but without being a direct result of it since it belongs within the confines of the general denial of permission in other words ‘there will be no permission hence no excuses’.

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day!

ayah_ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayah_en: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺.
Tafseer: ‘This is the Day of Decision. We have brought you O deniers from this community and the ancients together the ancients from among the deniers before you so that you will all be reckoned with and chastised together;

ayah_ar: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ
ayah_en: So if you have a scheme ˹to save yourselves˺, then use it against Me.”
Tafseer: So if you have any stratagems any ploy to ward off your chastisement try your strategems against Me!’ — put them into effect!

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day!

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayah_en: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs
Tafseer: Truly the God-fearing will be amid shades that is amid clusters of trees since there is no sun therein from whose heat to seek shade and springs issuing forth with water

ayah_ar: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayah_en: and any fruit they desire.
Tafseer: and fruits such as they desire this is meant to point out that eating and drinking in Paradise is done according to their desires in contrast to the case in this world where it is predominantly determined by what people are able to procure. It will also be said to them

ayah_ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayah_en: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
Tafseer: ‘Eat and drink in full enjoyment hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier in other words mutahanni’īna for what you used to do’ in the way of obedience.

ayah_ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayah_en: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers.
Tafseer: Indeed so in the same way that We reward the God-fearing do We reward the virtuous.

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: ˹But˺ woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day!

ayah_ar: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
ayah_en: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while, ˹for˺ you are truly wicked.”
Tafseer: ‘Eat and enjoy — addressing the disbelievers in this world — for a little time at the end of which comes death — this is meant as a threat for them. Indeed you are guilty!’

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day!

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
ayah_en: When it is said to them, “Bow down ˹before Allah,” they do not bow.
Tafseer: For when it is said to them ‘Bow down!’ perform prayer they do not bow down they do not perform prayer.

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day!

ayah_ar: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayah_en: So what message after this ˹Quran˺ would they believe in?
Tafseer: In what discourse then after this namely the Qur’ān will they believe? In other words they cannot believe in any other of God’s Scriptures after having denied this Qur’ān since it comprises that inimitability i‘jāz which none of the others do.

ayah_ar: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayah_en: What are they asking one another about?
Tafseer: About what about what thing are they the people of Quraysh questioning one another?

ayah_ar: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayah_en: About the momentous news,
Tafseer: About the awesome tiding this is the explication of that ‘thing’; the interrogative is meant to emphasise its magnitude — this awesome tiding is the Qur’ān comprising news of the Resurrection and so on which the Prophet s brought —

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
ayah_en: over which they disagree.
Tafseer: concerning which they are at variance for the believers affirm it while the disbelievers repudiate it.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayah_en: But no! They will come to know.
Tafseer: No indeed! — a disavowal — they will come to know what will befall them for their rejection of it.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayah_en: Again, no! They will come to know.
Tafseer: Again no indeed! They will come to know! reiterated for emphasis; thumma is added here to declare that the second threat of chastisement is more severe than the first. God exalted be He then alludes to His power to resurrect saying

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
ayah_en: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺,
Tafseer: Have We not made the earth a cradle a bed like a cradle

ayah_ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
ayah_en: and ˹made˺ the mountains as ˹its˺ pegs,
Tafseer: and the mountains pegs? with which the earth is tied down like tents are tied down with pegs the interrogative is meant as an affirmative.

ayah_ar: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
ayah_en: and created you in pairs,
Tafseer: And created you in pairs? males and females

ayah_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
ayah_en: and made your sleep for rest,
Tafseer: and made your sleep for rest? repose for your bodies

ayah_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
ayah_en: and made the night as a cover,
Tafseer: and made the night a cloak? to cover you with its darkness

ayah_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
ayah_en: and made the day for livelihood,
Tafseer: and made the day for livelihood? a time for seeking livelihood

ayah_ar: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
ayah_en: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺,
Tafseer: and built above you seven mighty ones? seven heavens shidād is the plural of shadīda that is to say strong and sturdy unaffected by the passage of time

ayah_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
ayah_en: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp,
Tafseer: and set a radiant lamp? namely the sun

ayah_ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
ayah_en: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water,
Tafseer: and sent down from the rain-clouds mu‘sirāt the clouds due to give rain similar to the term mu‘sir which denotes a girl nearing menstruation cascading water? pouring forth

ayah_ar: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
ayah_en: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants,
Tafseer: that with it We may bring forth grains such as wheat and plants such as figs

ayah_ar: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
ayah_en: and dense orchards?
Tafseer: and gardens orchards of intertwining foliage? alfāf is the plural of lafīf similar in pattern to sharīf ‘noble’ plural ashrāf.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
ayah_en: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—
Tafseer: Verily the Day of Decision for creatures is the tryst a time fixed for reward and punishment

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayah_en: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds.
Tafseer: the day the Trumpet the Horn is blown yawma yunfakhu fī’l-sūri is either a substitution for or an explication of yawma’l-fasli ‘the Day of Decision’ the blower being Isrāfīl and you come forth from your graves to the site of the Resurrection in droves in diverse groups

ayah_ar: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
ayah_en: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates,
Tafseer: and the heaven is opened read futtihat or futihat sundered for the descent of the angels and becomes as gates it becomes a heaven with gates

ayah_ar: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
ayah_en: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage.
Tafseer: and the mountains are set in motion dislocated from their positions and become as a mirage as fine dust that is to say like it in terms of its levity when in motion.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
ayah_en: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush
Tafseer: Verily Hell lurks in ambush mirsādan in the sense of rāsidatan or mursidatan ‘lying in wait’

ayah_ar: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
ayah_en: as a home for the transgressors,
Tafseer: for the rebellious the disbelievers who will not be able to avoid it it is a resort a retreat for them and so they will enter it

ayah_ar: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
ayah_en: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages.
Tafseer: to remain lābithīna is an implied circumstantial qualifier in other words their remaining therein will be decreed to be therein for ages for endless epochs ahqāb is the plural of huqb

ayah_ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayah_en: There they will not taste any coolness or drink,
Tafseer: tasting in it neither coolness neither sleep something which they will not taste therein nor drink nor anything that is imbibed for the sake of its delightful taste

ayah_ar: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
ayah_en: except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—
Tafseer: except boiling water of extreme temperatures and pus read ghasāqan or ghassāqan which is the vile matter that is emitted by the bodies of the inhabitants of the Fire which is what they will indeed taste. They are given this pair of tortures

ayah_ar: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
ayah_en: a fitting reward.
Tafseer: as a fitting requital one that accords with the nature of their deeds for there is no sin greater than disbelief and no chastisement greater than the Fire.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
ayah_en: For they never expected any reckoning,
Tafseer: Indeed they never feared any reckoning given their rejection of the Resurrection

ayah_ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
ayah_en: and totally rejected Our signs.
Tafseer: and they denied Our signs the Qur’ān mendaciously

ayah_ar: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
ayah_en: And We have everything recorded precisely.
Tafseer: and everything in the way of deeds have We kept count of have We recorded precisely in a Book as individual written records in the Preserved Tablet in order to requite creatures in accordance with them including the record of their denial of the Qur’ān.

ayah_ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
ayah_en: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”
Tafseer: ‘So now taste! — in other words it will be said to them in the Hereafter when the chastisement has befallen them taste now your requital! For We will increase you in nothing but chastisement’ in addition to your due chastisement.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
ayah_en: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—
Tafseer: Truly for the God-fearing there will be a triumph a place of triumph in Paradise

ayah_ar: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
ayah_en: Gardens, vineyards,
Tafseer: gardens orchards hadā’iqa is either a substitution for or an explication of mafāzan ‘a triumph’ and vineyards wa-a‘nāban is a supplement to mafāzan ‘a triumph’

ayah_ar: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
ayah_en: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age,
Tafseer: and buxom maidens kawā‘ib is the plural of kā‘ib of equal age atrāb is the plural of tirb

ayah_ar: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
ayah_en: and full cups ˹of pure wine˺,
Tafseer: and a brimming cup wine filling the vessels in which it is in; in sūrat al-Qitāl it is said and rivers of wine Q. 4715.

ayah_ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
ayah_en: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—
Tafseer: They will not hear in it that is in Paradise when they drink wine and in other situations any vain talk any words of falsehood or lies between one another read kidhāban to mean kadhiban ‘lies’ or kidhdhāban to mean takdhīban ‘lying’ in contrast to what happens in this world when wine is drunk

ayah_ar: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
ayah_en: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord,
Tafseer: this will be a reward from your Lord in other words God has rewarded them with this reward as a gift ‘atā’an substitutes for jazā’an ‘reward’ that is sufficing that is abundant hisāban as meaning ‘abundant’ derives from their saying a‘tānī fa-ahsabanī ‘he gave me so abundantly that I said “that is enough for me”’ hasbī

ayah_ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
ayah_en: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him
Tafseer: from the Lord of the heavens and the earth read rabbi ‘from the Lord of’ or rabbu ‘He is the Lord of’ and all that is between them the Compassionate One likewise read rahmāni or rahmānu or read rahmānu with rabbi for the preceding Whom exalted be He they that is creatures will not be able to address that is to say not one of them will be able to address Him for fear of Him

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
ayah_en: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true.
Tafseer: on the day yawma is the adverbial qualifier for lā yamlikūna ‘they will not be able to’ when the Spirit Gabriel or God’s hosts and the angels stand arrayed saffan is a circumstantial qualifier in other words mustaffīna. They creatures will not speak except him whom the Compassionate One permits to speak and who says what is right from among the believers and the angels as if meaning that they will intercede for he whom He approves of.

ayah_ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayah_en: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord.
Tafseer: That is the True Day whose coming to pass is definite namely the Day of Resurrection. So whoever wishes to let him seek resort with his Lord a return to Him that is to say let him return to God by being obedient to Him so that he may be secure from chastisement in it.

ayah_ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
ayah_en: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
Tafseer: Lo! We have warned you O disbelievers of Mecca of a chastisement that is near the chastisement of the impending Day of Resurrection — for anything that is impending is also near — the day yawma adverbially qualifies ‘adhāban ‘a chastisement’ by describing it when a person when every person will behold what his hands have sent ahead of good and evil and the disbeliever will say ‘O yā is a particle used to call attention to something would that I were dust!’ in other words and not be chastised. He says this when God exalted be He says to the beasts after each of them has retaliated against the other ‘Be dust!’.

ayah_ar: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
ayah_en: By those ˹angels˺ stripping out ˹evil souls˺ harshly,
Tafseer: By those that wrest by the angels who wrest the souls of disbelievers violently;

ayah_ar: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
ayah_en: and those pulling out ˹good souls˺ gently,
Tafseer: by those that draw out by the angels who draw out the souls of believers gently;

ayah_ar: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
ayah_en: and those gliding ˹through heavens˺ swiftly,
Tafseer: by those that glide serenely by the angels who descend from the heavens with His command exalted be He;

ayah_ar: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
ayah_en: and those taking the lead vigorously,
Tafseer: by those that race forward by the angels who race forward to Paradise with the souls of believers;

ayah_ar: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
ayah_en: and those conducting affairs ˹obediently˺!
Tafseer: and by those that direct the affair by the angels who direct the affairs of this world that is to say they descend with the directions for it from God the response to all of these oath clauses has been omitted understood to be something like la-tub‘athunna yā kuffāra Makka ‘you shall certainly be resurrected O disbelievers of Mecca!’ which is also the operator of the following clause

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
ayah_en: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass,
Tafseer: the day when the Tremor quakes that is to say the first blast as a result of which everything will be shaken violently thus it the subject has been described in terms of the effect it produces

ayah_ar: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
ayah_en: followed by a second Blast.
Tafseer: and is followed by the Aftershock the second blast; between the two blasts is a span of forty years the sentence tatba‘uhā’l-rādifatu is a circumstantial qualifier referring to al-rājifa ‘the Tremor’ in other words the ‘day’ can adverbially accommodate both blasts and other events and so for this reason it can also properly function as the adverbial qualifier for the Resurrection that will take place after the second blast;

ayah_ar: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
ayah_en: ˹The deniers’˺ hearts on that Day will be trembling ˹in horror˺,
Tafseer: on that day hearts will be trembling frightened and anxious

ayah_ar: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
ayah_en: with their eyes downcast.
Tafseer: their eyes humbled abject because of the terror that they see.

ayah_ar: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
ayah_en: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state,
Tafseer: They those of the mentioned hearts and eyes will say mockingly and in rejection of the Resurrection ‘Are we indeed read a-innā pronouncing both hamzas or by not pronouncing the second and inserting an alif between them in both cases and in both instances being restored as before? Shall we be restored to life after death al-hāfira is a noun signifying the ‘first part’ of anything from which is derived the expression raja‘a fī hāfiratihi to mean that so and so ‘returned whence he had come’.

ayah_ar: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
ayah_en: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”
Tafseer: What! When we have been decayed bones?’ nakhira a variant reading has nākhira ‘decayed and withered’ will we have life again?

ayah_ar: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”
Tafseer: They will say ‘That return of ours to life then if it were true would be a ruinous return!’.

ayah_ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
ayah_en: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast,
Tafseer: God exalted be He says But it the Aftershock which will be followed by the Resurrection will be only a single blast and so when it is blasted

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
ayah_en: and at once they will be above ground.
Tafseer: behold then they all creatures will be upon the surface of the earth alive after having been dead inside it.

ayah_ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
ayah_en: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺?
Tafseer: Have you O Muhammad (s) received the story of Moses hadīthu Mūsā operates the clause that follows

ayah_ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayah_en: His Lord called him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa,
Tafseer: when his Lord called out to him in the holy valley of Tuwā? — this is the name of the valley it may be read with nunation Tuwan or without — and He said

ayah_ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayah_en: ˹commanding,˺ “Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.
Tafseer: ‘Go to Pharaoh; he has indeed become rebellious he has exceeded all bounds with his disbelief

ayah_ar: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayah_en: And say, ‘Would you ˹be willing to˺ purify yourself,
Tafseer: and say “Would you — I call you to — purify yourself tazakkā a variant reading has tazzakkā where the original second tā’ of tatazakkā has been assimilated with the zāy to purge yourself of idolatry by bearing witness that there is no god but God

ayah_ar: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
ayah_en: and let me guide you to your Lord so that you will be in awe ˹of Him˺?’”
Tafseer: and allow me to guide you to your Lord to show you how to know Him ma‘rifa by way of proofs so that you may have fear of Him?” ’

ayah_ar: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayah_en: Then Moses showed him the great sign,
Tafseer: So he showed him the greatest sign from among His nine signs namely the glowing hand or the slithering staff.

ayah_ar: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
ayah_en: but he denied and disobeyed ˹Allah˺,
Tafseer: But he Pharaoh denied Moses and disobeyed God exalted be He.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayah_en: then turned his back, striving ˹against the truth˺.
Tafseer: Then he turned his back to faith going about in haste throughout the land causing corruption.

ayah_ar: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
ayah_en: Then he summoned ˹his people˺ and called out,
Tafseer: Then he gathered he assembled the sorcerers and his armies and proclaimed

ayah_ar: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayah_en: saying, “I am your lord, the most high!”
Tafseer: and said ‘I am your most high lord!’ above whom is no other lord.

ayah_ar: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
ayah_en: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next.
Tafseer: So God seized him He destroyed him by drowning him as punishment for the latter that is to say these last words of his and for the former that is to say his saying previously ‘I do not know of any god for you other than me’ Q. 2838 — and between the two claims made by Pharaoh was an interval of forty years.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
ayah_en: Surely in this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of ˹Allah˺.
Tafseer: Assuredly in that which is mentioned there is a moral for him who fears God exalted be He.

ayah_ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ayah_en: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it,
Tafseer: Are you read a-antum pronouncing both hamzas or by substituting an alif for the second one not pronouncing it and inserting an alif between the one not pronounced and the former or without this insertion namely you the deniers of the Resurrection harder to create or the heaven which He has built? harder to create banāhā an explication of the manner of its creation.

ayah_ar: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayah_en: raising it high and forming it flawlessly.
Tafseer: He made it rise high — an explication of the manner of its construction; in other words He made its vertical extension high; it is also said that samkahā means ‘its ceiling’ — and levelled it He made it even flawless

ayah_ar: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayah_en: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight.
Tafseer: and darkened its night and brought forth its day He exposed the light of its sun ‘night’ has been annexed to it the heaven because it represents its shade and likewise the ‘sun’ because it represents its light;

ayah_ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
ayah_en: As for the earth, He spread it out as well,
Tafseer: and after that He spread out the earth He made it flat for it had been created before the heaven but without having been spread out;

ayah_ar: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
ayah_en: bringing forth its water and pastures
Tafseer: from it He has brought forth akhraja a circumstantial qualifier with a suppressed preceding qad that is to say mukhrijan ‘bringing forth from it’ its waters by making its springs gush forth and its pastures what cattle graze of trees and herbage and what humans consume of foods and fruits the use of mar‘ā to express this of the earth is figurative

ayah_ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
ayah_en: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—
Tafseer: and has set firm the mountains on the face of the earth so that it stays still

ayah_ar: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
ayah_en: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals.
Tafseer: as a source of sustenance an object denoting reason for an implied verbal clause in other words fa‘ala dhālika mut‘atan or tamtī‘an ‘He did this to provide a source of sustenance’ for you and your flocks an‘ām is the plural of na‘am which are camels cows and sheep.

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayah_en: But, when the Supreme Disaster comes to pass—
Tafseer: So when the Greatest Catastrophe befalls — the second blast —

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
ayah_en: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving,
Tafseer: the day when man will remember yawma yatadhakkaru’l-insānu substitutes for idhā ‘when’ his efforts in the life of the world in the way of good or evil

ayah_ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
ayah_en: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—
Tafseer: and the Hell-fire the consuming Fire is revealed for all to see for every on-looker the response to idhā ‘when’ is what follows

ayah_ar: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
ayah_en: then as for those who transgressed
Tafseer: as for him who was rebellious who disbelieved

ayah_ar: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayah_en: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world,
Tafseer: and preferred the life of this world by pursuing carnal desires

ayah_ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
ayah_en: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home.
Tafseer: Hell-fire will indeed be the abode his abode.

ayah_ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
ayah_en: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires,
Tafseer: But as for him who feared the stance before his Lord his standing before Him and forbade the evil-bidding soul from pursuing desire that leads to perdition as a result of that person’s lusting after carnal desires

ayah_ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
ayah_en: Paradise will certainly be ˹their˺ home.
Tafseer: Paradise will indeed be the abode in sum the response to idhā ‘when’ verse 34 is that the disobedient one will be in the Fire and the obedient one in Paradise.

ayah_ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
ayah_en: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding the Hour, “When will it be?”
Tafseer: They that is the disbelievers of Mecca will ask you about the Hour when will it set in? when will it come to pass and when will it begin?

ayah_ar: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
ayah_en: But it is not for you to tell its time.
Tafseer: What have you to do with the mention of it? in other words you have no knowledge of it in order to mention it.

ayah_ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
ayah_en: That knowledge rests with your Lord ˹alone˺.
Tafseer: With your Lord it belongs ultimately ultimate knowledge of it lies with Him; none other than Him has any knowledge of it.

ayah_ar: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
ayah_en: Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it.
Tafseer: You are only a warner for your warning will only benefit the one who fears it.

ayah_ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayah_en: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning.
Tafseer: The day they see it it will be as if they had only tarried in their graves for an evening or the morning thereof that is to say as if only one evening of a day or its morning the annexation of duhā ‘morning’ to ‘ashiyya ‘evening’ is valid on the basis of their contiguity since both constitute either side of the day; the annexation has also allowed for the word to fall in harmony with the end-rhyme of the verses.

ayah_ar: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayah_en: He frowned and turned ˹his attention˺ away,
Tafseer: He the Prophet frowned glowered with his face and turned away

ayah_ar: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
ayah_en: ˹simply˺ because the blind man came to him ˹interrupting˺.
Tafseer: because the blind man came to him ‘Abd Allāh son of Umm Maktūm who interrupted him while he was busy with those notables of Quryash whose submission to God he was very eager for. The blind man was not aware that he was busy with these and so he called out to him ‘Teach me of what God has taught you’. However the Prophet s went off to his house. He was then reproached for this with what was revealed in this sūra. Afterwards whenever he came to him the Prophet would say to him ‘Greetings to him on whose account God reproached me!’ and would lay down his cloak for him.

ayah_ar: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
ayah_en: You never know ˹O Prophet˺, perhaps he may be purified,
Tafseer: And how would you know? Perhaps he would cleanse himself yazzakkā the original tā’ of yatazakkā has been assimilated with the zāy that is perhaps he would purge himself of sins by what he hears from you

ayah_ar: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
ayah_en: or he may be mindful, benefitting from the reminder.
Tafseer: or be admonished yadhdhakkar the original tā’ of yatadhakkar has been assimilated with the dhāl and so the reminder the admonition heard from you might benefit him a variant reading for tanfa‘uhu has tanfa‘ahu as the response to the optative statement.

ayah_ar: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayah_en: As for the one who was indifferent,
Tafseer: But as for the one who thinks himself self-sufficient through wealth

ayah_ar: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
ayah_en: you gave him your ˹undivided˺ attention,
Tafseer: to him you do attend tasaddā a variant reading has tassaddā where the original second tā’ of tatasaddā has been assimilated with the sād him you accept and turn your attention to;

ayah_ar: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
ayah_en: even though you are not to blame if he would not be purified.
Tafseer: yet it is not your concern if he does not cleanse himself if he does not believe.

ayah_ar: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayah_en: But as for the one who came to you, eager ˹to learn˺,
Tafseer: But as for him who comes to you hurrying yas‘ā is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb jā’a ‘comes’

ayah_ar: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
ayah_en: being in awe ˹of Allah˺,
Tafseer: fearful of God wa-huwa yakhshā is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb yas‘ā ‘hurrying’ — this being the blind man —

ayah_ar: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
ayah_en: you were inattentive to him.
Tafseer: to him you pay no heed talahhā the original second tā’ of tatalahhā has been omitted that is to say from him you are distracted by other things.

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: But no! This ˹revelation˺ is truly a reminder.
Tafseer: No indeed! do not behave like this. Truly it the sūra is or the verses are a reminder an admonition for all creatures —

ayah_ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
ayah_en: So let whoever wills be mindful of it.
Tafseer: so let whoever will remember it preserve it in his memory and thus be admonished by it —

ayah_ar: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
ayah_en: It is ˹written˺ on pages held in honour—
Tafseer: on leaves fī suhufin is the second predicate of innahā ‘truly it’ and what precedes it is a parenthetical statement that are honoured by God

ayah_ar: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
ayah_en: highly esteemed, purified—
Tafseer: elevated in the heavens purified exalted above the touch of devils

ayah_ar: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
ayah_en: by the hands of angel-scribes,
Tafseer: in the hands of scribes who write it down from the Preserved Tablet

ayah_ar: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
ayah_en: honourable and virtuous.
Tafseer: noble pious obedient to God exalted be He these being the angels.

ayah_ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
ayah_en: Condemned are ˹disbelieving˺ humans! How ungrateful they are ˹to Allah˺!
Tafseer: Perish man! accursed be the disbeliever! What has made him ungrateful? an interrogative statement meant as a rebuke — what has driven him to disbelief?

ayah_ar: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
ayah_en: From what substance did He create them?
Tafseer: From what thing has He created him? an interrogative meant as an affirmative which He then explains by saying

ayah_ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
ayah_en: He created them from a sperm-drop, and ordained their development.
Tafseer: From a drop of sperm did He create him then proportion him in stages as a blood-clot then an embryo up to the last stage of his creation.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
ayah_en: Then He makes the way easy for them,
Tafseer: Then He made the way his exit from his mother’s belly easy for him;

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
ayah_en: then causes them to die and be buried.
Tafseer: then He makes him die and buries him He places him in a grave that hides him;

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
ayah_en: Then when He wills, He will resurrect them.
Tafseer: then when He wills He will raise him for the Resurrection.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
ayah_en: But no! They have failed to comply with what He ordered.
Tafseer: No indeed! Verily he has not accomplished he has not done what He his Lord commanded him to do.

ayah_ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
ayah_en: Let people then consider their food:
Tafseer: So let man consider in reflection his source of food how it is determined and procured for him

ayah_ar: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
ayah_en: how We pour down rain in abundance
Tafseer: that We pour down water from the clouds plenteously;

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
ayah_en: and meticulously split the earth open ˹for sprouts˺,
Tafseer: then We split the earth into fissures with vegetation

ayah_ar: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
ayah_en: causing grain to grow in it,
Tafseer: and cause the grains such as wheat and barley to grow therein

ayah_ar: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
ayah_en: as well as grapes and greens,
Tafseer: and vines and herbs qadb is moist qatt

ayah_ar: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
ayah_en: and olives and palm trees,
Tafseer: and olives and date-palms

ayah_ar: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
ayah_en: and dense orchards,
Tafseer: and gardens of dense foliage orchards teeming with trees

ayah_ar: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
ayah_en: and fruit and fodder—
Tafseer: and fruits and pastures abb is what cattle graze; it is also said to be ‘straw’

ayah_ar: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
ayah_en: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals.
Tafseer: as sustenance understand matā‘an as mut‘atan or tamtī‘an as explained above in the previous sūra for you and your flocks also as explained above.

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
ayah_en: Then, when the Deafening Blast comes to pass—
Tafseer: So when the deafening Cry the second blast comes —

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
ayah_en: on that Day every person will flee from their own siblings,
Tafseer: the day when a man will flee from his own brother

ayah_ar: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
ayah_en: and ˹even˺ their mother and father,
Tafseer: and his mother and his father

ayah_ar: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
ayah_en: and ˹even˺ their spouse and children.
Tafseer: and his wife and his sons yawma ‘the day when’ is a substitution for idhā ‘when’ the response to which is indicated by what follows —

ayah_ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
ayah_en: For then everyone will have enough concern of their own.
Tafseer: every person that day will have a matter to preoccupy him a predicament to distract him from the affairs of others in other words every person will be preoccupied with his own self.

ayah_ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright,
Tafseer: On that day some faces will be shining radiant

ayah_ar: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: laughing and rejoicing,
Tafseer: laughing joyous happy — these are the believers.

ayah_ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
ayah_en: while ˹other˺ faces will be dusty,
Tafseer: And some faces on that day will be covered with dust

ayah_ar: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
ayah_en: cast in gloom—
Tafseer: overcast covered with gloom darkness and blackness.

ayah_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
ayah_en: those are the disbelievers, the ˹wicked˺ sinners.
Tafseer: Those the people of this predicament are the disbelievers the profligates those who have combined disbelief with profligacy.

ayah_ar: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
ayah_en: When the sun is put out,
Tafseer: When the sun is folded away enfolded and stripped of its light

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
ayah_en: and when the stars fall down,
Tafseer: and when the stars scatter when they are extinguished and hurtle down towards the earth

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
ayah_en: and when the mountains are blown away,
Tafseer: and when the mountains are set in motion when they are blown away from the face of the earth becoming as scattered dust

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
ayah_en: and when pregnant camels are left untended,
Tafseer: and when the pregnant camels are neglected abandoned without a herdsman or anyone to milk them on account of the matter that has come over them — even though previously no wealth was dearer to them than these pregnant camels;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
ayah_en: and when wild beasts are gathered together,
Tafseer: and when the wild beasts are mustered when they are brought together after being resurrected so that each of them may retaliate against the other before becoming dust;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
ayah_en: and when the seas are set on fire,
Tafseer: and when the seas are set afire read sujirat or sujjirat when they are set alight and become a mass of fire;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
ayah_en: and when the souls ˹and their bodies˺ are paired ˹once more˺,
Tafseer: and when the souls are coupled when they are paired up with their bodies;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
ayah_en: and when baby girls, buried alive, are asked
Tafseer: and when the girl buried-alive the young girl buried alive for fear of shame and impoverishment asks — in rebuke of its slayer —

ayah_ar: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
ayah_en: for what crime they were put to death,
Tafseer: for what sin she was slain sa’alat ‘asks’ a variant reading has su’ilat ‘she is asked’ narrating the address directed to her to which she then responds by saying ‘I was slain without having committed any sin’;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
ayah_en: and when the records ˹of deeds˺ are laid open,
Tafseer: and when the scrolls the scrolls containing the deeds are unrolled read nushirat or nushshirat when they are unfolded and spread out;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
ayah_en: and when the sky is stripped away,
Tafseer: and when the heaven is stripped off torn away from its place just as the skin of a sheep is stripped off;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
ayah_en: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up,
Tafseer: and when the Hell-fire is set ablaze read su‘irat or su‘‘irat when it is set alight;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
ayah_en: and when Paradise is brought near—
Tafseer: and when Paradise is brought near when it is brought close to those who have merited it that they may enter it the response to idhā ‘when’ at the beginning of the sūra and all that has been supplemented thereto is the following

ayah_ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
ayah_en: ˹on that Day˺ each soul will know what ˹deeds˺ it has brought along.
Tafseer: then a soul every soul at the time of the occurrence of the things mentioned which is the Day of Resurrection will know what it has presented of good or evil.

ayah_ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
ayah_en: I do swear by the receding stars
Tafseer: So I swear fa-lā lā is extra by the receding planets

ayah_ar: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
ayah_en: which travel and hide,
Tafseer: the movers the setters that is the five planets Saturn Jupiter Mars Venus and Mercury takhnusu means ‘they sink away’ during their orbit whereas we see stars at the end of their zodiacal course return to the start; taknisu means that they enter their kinās ‘hideaway’ in other words they retreat into their setting-places;

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
ayah_en: and the night as it falls
Tafseer: and by the night as it approaches as it falls with its darkness or it means as it recedes;

ayah_ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
ayah_en: and the day as it breaks!
Tafseer: and by the dawn as it breathes as it extends until it becomes broad daylight

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the Word of ˹Allah delivered by Gabriel,˺ a noble messenger-angel,
Tafseer: truly this Qur’ān is the word of a messenger who is noble in the sight of God exalted be He — this being the messenger Gabriel it qawl ‘word’ has been annexed to him because he descends with it

ayah_ar: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
ayah_en: full of power, held in honour by the Lord of the Throne,
Tafseer: powerful one of mighty powers eminent one of eminent status makīnin is semantically connected ‘inda ‘in the presence of’ in the presence of the Lord of the Throne that is God exalted be He;

ayah_ar: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
ayah_en: obeyed there ˹in heaven˺, and trustworthy.
Tafseer: obeyed there the angels obey him in the heavens trustworthy with the Revelation.

ayah_ar: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
ayah_en: And your fellow man is not insane.
Tafseer: And your companion Muhammad (s) wa-mā sāhibukum a supplement to the clause from innahu ‘truly this is’ up to the last of the oath clauses is not a madman as you claim.

ayah_ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayah_en: And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon,
Tafseer: For verily he Muhammad (s) saw him Gabriel in the form in which he was created on the clear horizon the highest one towards the east;

ayah_ar: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
ayah_en: and he does not withhold ˹what is revealed to him of˺ the unseen.
Tafseer: and he Muhammad (s) is not to be accused of knowing the Unseen what is hidden of the revelation and the tidings of the heaven a variant reading for bi-zanīnin has bi-danīnin meaning that he is not ‘niggardly’ with the Unseen so as to reduce something of it and not disclose it.

ayah_ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: And this ˹Quran˺ is not the word of an outcast devil.
Tafseer: And it that is the Qur’ān is not the word of an accursed satan eavesdropping stealthily.

ayah_ar: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
ayah_en: So what ˹other˺ path would you take?
Tafseer: So where are you going? So what path are you going to follow in repudiating the Qur’ān and turning away from it?

ayah_ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayah_en: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—
Tafseer: It is only a reminder an admonition for all worlds those of mankind and jinn

ayah_ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
ayah_en: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way.
Tafseer: for those of you who li-man shā’a minkum is a substitution for li’l-‘ālamīna ‘for all worlds’ using the same preposition wish to go straight by following the truth;

ayah_ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayah_en: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺, except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of all worlds.
Tafseer: but you will not wish to go straight along the path of truth unless God the Lord of the Worlds of all creatures wills that you should go straight along it.

ayah_ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
ayah_en: When the sky splits open,
Tafseer: When the heaven is split open when it is rent asunder

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
ayah_en: and when the stars fall away,
Tafseer: and when the stars are dispersed when they expire and begin to fall

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
ayah_en: and when the seas burst forth,
Tafseer: and when the seas are burst forth released one upon the other forming one mass of water so that the sweet water mixes with the salty;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
ayah_en: and when the graves spill out,
Tafseer: and when the tombs are overturned when their earth above them is dug up and its dead are raised the response to idhā ‘when’ and all that is supplemented thereto is the following

ayah_ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
ayah_en: ˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind.
Tafseer: a soul every soul will know at the time of the occurrence of the things mentioned which is the Day of Resurrection what it has sent ahead in the way of deeds and what it has left behind of these and did not do.

ayah_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayah_en: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous,
Tafseer: O disbelieving man! What has deceived you with regard to your generous Lord? so that you have disobeyed Him

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
ayah_en: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design,
Tafseer: Who created you when you were not then made you upright in your created form with sound limbs then proportioned you read fa-‘adalak or fa-‘addalak making you symmetrical in shape with well-proportioned parts so that no hand or leg is longer than the other

ayah_ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayah_en: moulding you in whatever form He willed?
Tafseer: assembling you in whatever mā is a relative form He will?

ayah_ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayah_en: But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment,
Tafseer: No indeed! — a deterrent against letting oneself be misled by the generosity of God exalted be He. Rather you that is disbelievers of Mecca deny Judgement requital for deeds;

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
ayah_en: while you are certainly observed by vigilant,
Tafseer: Yet lo! there are above you watchers from among the angels over your deeds

ayah_ar: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
ayah_en: honourable angels, recording ˹everything˺.
Tafseer: noble in God’s sight writers of these deeds

ayah_ar: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
ayah_en: They know whatever you do.
Tafseer: who know whatever you do all of it.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss,
Tafseer: Indeed the pious the believers who are sincere in their faith shall be amid bliss in Paradise

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: and the wicked will be in Hell,
Tafseer: and indeed the profligates the disbelievers shall be in Hell-fire a scorching fire

ayah_ar: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayah_en: burning in it on Judgment Day,
Tafseer: entering it to suffer its heat on the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital

ayah_ar: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
ayah_en: and they will have no escape from it.
Tafseer: and they shall not be absent from it they shall not be taken out of it.

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayah_en: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is?
Tafseer: And what would show you what would inform you what the Day of Judgement is?

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayah_en: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is?
Tafseer: Again what would show you what the Day of Judgement is? — repeated to emphasise its enormity.

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
ayah_en: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺.
Tafseer: It is a day read yawmu when no soul will be of any avail any use to another soul and the absolute command on that day will be God’s there will be no power of command for anyone other than Him thereat in other words none has been given the power to mediate thereupon in contrast to situations in this world.

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
ayah_en: Woe to the defrauders!
Tafseer: Woe waylun a term entailing chastisement; or it is the name of a valley in Hell to the defrauders

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
ayah_en: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people,
Tafseer: those who when they take measure from people demand it in full the measure;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
ayah_en: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers.
Tafseer: but who when they measure for them or weigh for them they cause them loss they diminish for them the measure or the weight.

ayah_ar: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
ayah_en: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected
Tafseer: Do such individuals not know for certain alā indicates an interrogative of rebuke that they will be resurrected

ayah_ar: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: for a tremendous Day—
Tafseer: for an awful day that is to say on it and this is the Day of Resurrection

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayah_en: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds?
Tafseer: a day when yawma is a substitution for the syntactical locus of li-yawmin ‘to an awful day’ and as such is in the accusative because of the verb mab‘ūthūna ‘will be resurrected’ mankind will rise from their graves before the Lord of the Worlds? the Lord of all creatures for His affair His reckoning and His requital.

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
ayah_en: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjin ˹in the depths of Hell˺—
Tafseer: Nay! verily the record of the profligates that is to say the record of the deeds of the disbelievers is in Sijjīn — this is said to be a book containing the record of all the deeds of the devils and the disbelievers; but it is also said to be a location in the lowermost part of the seventh earth the place of Satan and his hosts.

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
ayah_en: and what will make you realize what Sijjin is?—
Tafseer: And what would tell you what Sijjīn is? what the book of Sijjīn is.

ayah_ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
ayah_en: a fate ˹already˺ sealed.
Tafseer: It is a sealed book.

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayah_en: Woe on that Day to the deniers—
Tafseer: Woe to the deniers on that day

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayah_en: those who deny Judgment Day!
Tafseer: who deny the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital alladhīna yukadhdhibūna bi-yawmi’l-dīn either a substitution for or an explication of al-mukadhdhibīna ‘the deniers’;

ayah_ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayah_en: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor.
Tafseer: and none deny it but every sinful the form athīm is hyperbolic transgressor overstepping the bounds.

ayah_ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayah_en: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”
Tafseer: When Our signs of the Qur’ān are recited to him he says ‘Mere fables asātīr of the ancients!’ mere tales that were written down sutirat in ancient times asātīr is the plural of ustūra or istāra.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayah_en: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit!
Tafseer: No indeed! — a deterrent and a warning against saying such things. Rather there has slayed engulfed their hearts covering them like rust that which they earned of acts of disobedience.

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
ayah_en: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day.
Tafseer: Nay! verily they on that day the Day of Resurrection will be screened off from their Lord and so they will not see Him.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayah_en: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell,
Tafseer: Then they will be exposed to Hell-fire then they will enter the scorching Fire;

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayah_en: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”
Tafseer: then it will be said to them ‘This that is the chastisement is that which you used to deny!’

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
ayah_en: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—
Tafseer: Nay! verily the record of the pious that is the record of the deeds of the believers who were sincere in their faith is in ‘Illiyyūn — this is said to be the book containing all the good deeds of the angels and the believers from among the two heavy ones sc. mankind and jinn; but it is also said to be a place below the Throne in the seventh heaven;

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
ayah_en: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—
Tafseer: and what will tell you what will inform you what ‘Illiyyūn is? what the book of ‘Illiyyūn is.

ayah_ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
ayah_en: a fate ˹already˺ sealed,
Tafseer: It is a sealed book

ayah_ar: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayah_en: witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺.
Tafseer: witnessed by those brought near from among the angels.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
ayah_en: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss,
Tafseer: Assuredly the pious will be amid bliss in Paradise

ayah_ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayah_en: ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around.
Tafseer: upon couches upon beds beneath canopies gazing at the bliss which they have been given.

ayah_ar: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayah_en: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight.
Tafseer: You will perceive in their faces the radiancy of bliss the splendour and beauty of blissfulness

ayah_ar: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
ayah_en: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine,
Tafseer: as they are given to drink a nectar a wine free of any impurities that is sealed in its vessel none other than them breaking its seal

ayah_ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
ayah_en: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺.
Tafseer: whose seal is musk that is whose final sip is followed by an emanating scent of musk — so for such bliss let the viers vie let them desire to apply themselves to obedience of God —

ayah_ar: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
ayah_en: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnim—
Tafseer: and whose mixture that is to say that with which it is mixed is of Tasnīm which is explained by His following words

ayah_ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayah_en: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink.
Tafseer: a spring ‘aynan is in the accusative because of an implicit prefatory amdahu ‘I extol this spring’ from which those brought near will drink yashrabu bihā should be yashrabu minhā or it may be that bihā is used because yashrabu is meant to imply the sense of yaltadhdhu bihā ‘in which they delight’.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayah_en: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers,
Tafseer: Verily the guilty like Abū Jahl and his ilk used to laugh at the believers such as ‘Ammār b. Yāsir and Bilāl the Ethiopian and those like them in mockery of them;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
ayah_en: wink to one another whenever they passed by,
Tafseer: and when they the believers passed them by they would wink at one another the guilty beckoned with their eyebrows and eyelids towards the believers in mockery;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
ayah_en: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people.
Tafseer: and when they returned to their folks they would return blithely fākihīna a variant reading has fakihīna rejoicing in their disparaging mention of the believers;

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
ayah_en: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”
Tafseer: and when they see them that is the believers they say ‘Lo! these men are astray!’ on account of their belief in Muhammad (s).

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
ayah_en: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers.
Tafseer: God exalted be He says Yet they that is the disbelievers were not sent as watchers over them over the believers to preserve them or to keep a record of their deeds and thus guide them back to what is best for them.

ayah_ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayah_en: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers,
Tafseer: So today that is the Day of Resurrection the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers

ayah_ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayah_en: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on.
Tafseer: upon couches in Paradise gazing out from their dwellings at the disbelievers while they are being tortured; and they will laugh at them just as they the disbelievers had laughed at them in the world.

ayah_ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayah_en: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”
Tafseer: Have the disbelievers been requited for what they used to do? Yes indeed!

ayah_ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
ayah_en: When the sky bursts open,
Tafseer: When the heaven is rent asunder

ayah_ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayah_en: obeying its Lord as it must,
Tafseer: and heeds gives ear to and in rending itself asunder obeys its Lord as it should that is as its duty is to heed and obey

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
ayah_en: and when the earth is flattened out,
Tafseer: and when the earth is stretched out when its width is increased just as a piece of leather is stretched so that no edifice or mountain remains upon it

ayah_ar: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
ayah_en: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty,
Tafseer: and casts out all that is in it of the dead onto its surface and empties itself thereof

ayah_ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayah_en: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺.
Tafseer: and heeds and in this respect gives ear to and obeys its Lord as it should all of this will be on the Day of Resurrection the response to idhā ‘when’ and to all that is supplemented thereto has been omitted; but it is indicated by what follows it and is implied to be something like laqiya’l-insānu ‘amalahu ‘man will encounter his deeds’.

ayah_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
ayah_en: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences.
Tafseer: O man! Verily you are labouring exerting your efforts toward the encounter with your Lord that is death laboriously and you will encounter it that is you will encounter your mentioned good or evil deeds on the Day of Resurrection.

ayah_ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
ayah_en: As for those who are given their record in their right hand,
Tafseer: Then as for him who is given his book the record of his deeds in his right hand — and this is the believer —

ayah_ar: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
ayah_en: they will have an easy reckoning,
Tafseer: he will receive an easy reckoning which simply entails the presentation of his deeds to him as in the hadīth of the two Sahīhs of Bukhārī and Muslim — in which there is also a hadīth saying ‘He who is reckoned with at length will be destined for perdition’ — and after this presentation of his deeds to the believer he will be excused

ayah_ar: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
ayah_en: and will return to their people joyfully.
Tafseer: and return to his family in Paradise joyful because of it.

ayah_ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
ayah_en: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs,
