Tafseer: But as for him who is given his book from behind his back — and this is the disbeliever whose right hand is chained to his neck and whose left hand by which he is given the book is placed behind his back

ayah_ar: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
ayah_en: they will cry for ˹instant˺ destruction,
Tafseer: he will pray upon seeing what is in it for annihilation he will invoke destruction against himself by saying yā thabūrāh ‘O annihilation of mine!’

ayah_ar: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
ayah_en: and will burn in the blazing Fire.
Tafseer: and he will enter the Blaze an intense fire a variant reading for yaslā ‘he will enter’ has yusallā ‘he will be admitted’.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
ayah_en: For they used to be prideful among their people,
Tafseer: Indeed among his folk his clan in the world he used to be joyful wanton lusting after his desires;

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
ayah_en: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺.
Tafseer: indeed he thought that an softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted that is to say annahu he would never return to his Lord.

ayah_ar: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
ayah_en: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them.
Tafseer: Nay! he will return to Him; indeed his Lord is ever Seer of him knowing that he would return to Him.

ayah_ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
ayah_en: So, I do swear by the twilight!
Tafseer: So I swear fa-lā lā is extra by the twilight al-shafaq the reddishness visible in the horizon after the sunset

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
ayah_en: And by the night and whatever it envelops!
Tafseer: and by the night and what it envelops what it brings together of creatures and otherwise that have entered into it

ayah_ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
ayah_en: And by the moon when it waxes full!
Tafseer: and by the moon when it is at the full and its light is complete and this happens during the nights of the full moon

ayah_ar: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
ayah_en: You will certainly pass from one state to another.
Tafseer: you will surely journey tarkabunna is actually tarkabūnanna but the nūn of the indicative has been omitted because of two identical letters following one another and the wāw is omitted because of two unvocalised consonants coming together from stage to stage state after state namely death then life then what comes afterwards of the states at the Resurrection.

ayah_ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayah_en: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe,
Tafseer: So what is wrong with them that is the disbelievers that they do not have faith that is to say what is there to prevent them from embracing faith; or what argument do they have for neglecting it despite the existence of proofs for it

ayah_ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
ayah_en: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺?
Tafseer: and what is wrong with them that when the Qur’ān is recited to them they do not prostrate? they do not submit by believing in it given its inimitability?

ayah_ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
ayah_en: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial.
Tafseer: Nay but the disbelievers deny resurrection and other matters

ayah_ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
ayah_en: But Allah knows best whatever they hide.
Tafseer: and God knows best what they are amassing accumulating in their scrolls in the way of disbelief denial and evil deeds.

ayah_ar: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayah_en: So give them good news of a painful punishment.
Tafseer: So give them good tidings inform them of a painful chastisement

ayah_ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
ayah_en: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward.
Tafseer: except those who believe and perform righteous deeds theirs will be an unfailing reward one that is unending undiminished and not given to them in expectance of anything in return.

ayah_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
ayah_en: By the sky full of constellations,
Tafseer: By the heaven of the constellations the twelve constellations of the planets — as explained in sūrat al-Furqān Q. 2561;

ayah_ar: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
ayah_en: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺,
Tafseer: and by the promised day the Day of Resurrection;

ayah_ar: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
ayah_en: and the witness and what is witnessed!
Tafseer: and by the witness Friday and the witnessed the day of ‘Arafa — that is how these three elements have been explained in hadīth for the first one is ‘promised’ the second one is ‘a witness’ that testifies to deeds performed in it while the third is ‘witnessed’ by mankind and angels the introductory particle of the response to the oath has been omitted but is implied to be laqad ‘verily’ sc. laqad qutila ashābu’l-ukhdūd

ayah_ar: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
ayah_en: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—
Tafseer: perish accursed be the men of the ditch! the pit in the ground

ayah_ar: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
ayah_en: the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—
Tafseer: of the fire al-nāri is an inclusive substitution of it al-ukhdūdi ‘of the ditch’ abounding in fuel by which it was fuelled

ayah_ar: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
ayah_en: when they sat around it,
Tafseer: when they sat by it around the edge of the ditch on chairs

ayah_ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
ayah_en: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers,
Tafseer: and they themselves to what they did to those who believed in God in the way of torturing them by hurling them into the fire when they did not recant their faith were witnesses they were themselves present thereat. It is reported in a hadīth that God saved the believers who had been thrown into the fire by taking their souls before they fell into it and that the fire then rose up and burnt all those sitting around it.

ayah_ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
ayah_en: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—
Tafseer: And all that they were vindicative towards them of was that they believed in God the Mighty in His kingdom the Praised

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
ayah_en: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things.
Tafseer: to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and God is Witness to all things in other words all that the disbelievers disavowed of the believers was their faith.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
ayah_en: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning.
Tafseer: Indeed those who persecute believing men and believing women by having them burnt then do not repent there will be for them the chastisement of Hell in return for their disbelief and there will also be for them the chastisement of burning that is to say the chastisement for their having had the believers burnt in the Hereafter; but it is also said that there is this chastisement for them in this world as when the fire rose up and burnt them as mentioned above.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
ayah_en: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph.
Tafseer: Indeed those who believe and perform righteous deeds for them there will be gardens underneath which rivers flow that is the supreme triumph.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayah_en: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe.
Tafseer: Assuredly your Lord’s assault against the disbelievers is severe as severe as He will it to be.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
ayah_en: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺.
Tafseer: Assuredly it is He Who originates creation and restores and is never thwarted in what He wills

ayah_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
ayah_en: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—
Tafseer: and He is the Forgiving to sinning believers the Loving the One Who shows love to His friends through His acts of generosity

ayah_ar: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
ayah_en: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious,
Tafseer: Lord of the Throne its Creator and Possessor the Glorious read nominative al-majīdu the One deserving of the perfect attributes of sublimity

ayah_ar: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
ayah_en: Doer of whatever He wills.
Tafseer: Doer of what He desires nothing able to thwart Him.

ayah_ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
ayah_en: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—
Tafseer: Have you O Muhammad (s) received the story of the hosts

ayah_ar: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
ayah_en: ˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd?
Tafseer: Pharaoh and Thamūd? Fir‘awna wa-Thamūda substitutes for al-junūdi — the mention of ‘Pharaoh’ suffices to also include his followers; their ‘story’ is that they were destroyed for their disbelief and this is meant as a warning for those who deny the Prophet s and the Qur’ān that they may be admonished thereby.

ayah_ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
ayah_en: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial.
Tafseer: Nay but the disbelievers are engrossed in denial of the mentioned;

ayah_ar: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
ayah_en: But Allah encompasses them from all sides.
Tafseer: and God is behind them All-Encompassing — they have no protector against Him.

ayah_ar: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
ayah_en: In fact, this is a glorious Quran,
Tafseer: Nay but it is a glorious a magnificent Qur’ān

ayah_ar: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
ayah_en: ˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet.
Tafseer: in a tablet suspended above the seventh heaven preserved read mahfūzin from all devils and from having any of its contents altered; it is a high as the distance between the earth and the heaven and as wide as the distance between the east and the west made of white pearls — as stated by Ibn ‘Abbās may God be pleased with both him and his father ‘Abbās

ayah_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
ayah_en: By the heaven and the nightly star!
Tafseer: By the heaven and the night-visitor! al-tāriq actually denotes any thing that comes by night including stars because they come out at night.

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
ayah_en: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is?
Tafseer: And what will tell you what the night-visitor is? mā’l-tāriq is a subject and predicate standing as the second object of the verb adrā ‘tell’; and what comes after the first mā ‘what’ is the predicate thereof of this first mā — this statement emphasises the magnificence of the ‘night-visitor’ which is explained in what follows. It is

ayah_ar: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
ayah_en: ˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness.
Tafseer: The piercing the brilliant because of its piercing the darkness with its light star! meaning the constellation Pleiades; or it refers to all stars the response to the oath follows

ayah_ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
ayah_en: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺.
Tafseer: Over every soul there is a keeper if read la-mā then mā is extra and in is softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted that is to say innahu; the lām is a particle for separation; if read lammā then in is for negation and lammā means illā ‘except that’ — the watcher is an angel that keeps a record of its deeds both the good and the evil.

ayah_ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
ayah_en: Let people then consider what they were created from!
Tafseer: So let man consider by way of reflection from what he was created from what thing

ayah_ar: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
ayah_en: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid,
Tafseer: the response is He was created from a gushing fluid gushing forth from the man and the woman into the womb

ayah_ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
ayah_en: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage.
Tafseer: issuing from between the loins of the man and the breast-bones of the woman.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
ayah_en: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺
Tafseer: Assuredly He exalted be He is able to bring him back to resurrect man after his death; and so when he reflects on his origins he will realise that the One who was able to do this is also able to resurrect him

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
ayah_en: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed.
Tafseer: on the day when all secrets the hidden convictions and intentions of the hearts are inspected when they are examined and revealed

ayah_ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
ayah_en: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper.
Tafseer: whereat he the one who denies resurrection will have neither strength to defend himself against chastisement nor any helper to avert it from him.

ayah_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
ayah_en: By the sky with its recurring cycles,
Tafseer: By the heaven of returns of the rain that returns time and again

ayah_ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
ayah_en: and the earth with its sprouting plants!
Tafseer: and by the earth of fissures splitting with the growth of vegetation

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
ayah_en: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word,
Tafseer: assuredly it the Qur’ān is a decisive word distinguishing between truth and falsehood

ayah_ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
ayah_en: and is not to be taken lightly.
Tafseer: and it is not a jest frivolity or falsehood.

ayah_ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
ayah_en: They are certainly devising ˹evil˺ plans,
Tafseer: Indeed they that is the disbelievers are devising a plot they are preparing plots against the Prophet s

ayah_ar: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
ayah_en: but I too am planning.
Tafseer: and I too am devising a plot drawing them by degrees towards destruction from whence they know not.

ayah_ar: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
ayah_en: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while.
Tafseer: So respite O Muhammad (s) the disbelievers; grant them respite reiterated as an emphasis one enhanced by the use of a different form mahhil amhil that is to say put them off for a little ruwaydā is a verbal noun emphasising the import of the operator and is the diminutive form of rūd or irwad with shortening of final consonant ruwaydan ruwaydā. Surely enough God exalted be He seized them at Badr and abrogated the dispensation of ‘granting respite’ by the ‘sword’ verse in other words by the command to fight and struggle.

ayah_ar: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
ayah_en: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,
Tafseer: Glorify the Name of your Lord that is exalt your Lord above what does not befit Him ism in isma rabbika ‘the Name of your Lord’ is extra the Most High an adjective qualifying rabbika ‘your Lord’

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayah_en: Who created and ˹perfectly˺ fashioned ˹all˺,
Tafseer: Who created and proportioned His creature making it of well-proportioned parts without irregularities

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
ayah_en: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly,
Tafseer: and Who determined what He wants and guided to what He had determined of good or evil

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
ayah_en: and Who brings forth ˹green˺ pasture,
Tafseer: and Who brought forth the pasture Who caused herbage to grow

ayah_ar: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
ayah_en: then reduces it to withered chaff.
Tafseer: then made it after verdancy blackened stubble desiccated broken chaff.

ayah_ar: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
ayah_en: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O  Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺,
Tafseer: We will have you recite the Qur’ān so that you will not forget what you recite

ayah_ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
ayah_en: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden.
Tafseer: except what God may will that you forget by abrogating its recitation and its ruling — the Prophet s used to recite aloud while Gabriel recited fearing to forget and so it is as though it was said to him ‘Do not hasten in it; you will not forget and so do not weary yourself by reciting it aloud’; assuredly He exalted be He knows what is overt of words and deeds and what is hidden of both of these.

ayah_ar: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayah_en: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease.
Tafseer: And We will ease your way to the easy way the uncomplicated Law namely Islam.

ayah_ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayah_en: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺.
Tafseer: So remind admonish by the Qur’ān in case the reminder should be of benefit to the one whom you might remind the one mentioned in the following verse ‘he who fears will be reminded’ in other words even if it might not be of benefit for it is of benefit to some but of no benefit to others.

ayah_ar: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
ayah_en: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺.
Tafseer: He who fears God exalted be He will be reminded by it as in the verse So admonish by the Qur’ān him who fears My threat Q. 5045;

ayah_ar: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
ayah_en: But it will be shunned by the most wretched,
Tafseer: but the wretched one al-ashqā means al-shaqī that is to say the disbeliever will shun it that is the reminder in other words he will leave it aside not looking at it

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayah_en: who will burn in the greatest Fire,
Tafseer: he who will be roasted in the greater Fire the Fire of the Hereafter the lesser fire being that of this world;

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ayah_en: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die.
Tafseer: then he will neither die therein and find rest nor live a enjoyable life.

ayah_ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayah_en: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves,
Tafseer: Successful winner indeed is he who purifies himself who cleanses himself by means of his adherence to faith

ayah_ar: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
ayah_en: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray.
Tafseer: and mentions the Name of his Lord saying Allāhu akbar ‘God is Great’ and prays the five prayers — and such are the concerns of one working towards the Hereafter concerns which the Meccan disbelievers shun.

ayah_ar: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayah_en: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world,
Tafseer: Nay but you prefer or read yu’thirūna ‘they prefer’ the life of this world to the Hereafter

ayah_ar: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
ayah_en: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting.
Tafseer: whereas the Hereafter and the Paradise it entails is better and more lasting.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayah_en: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—
Tafseer: Truly this the success of those who purify themselves and the Hereafter being better is in the former scrolls the ones revealed before the Qur’ān

ayah_ar: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayah_en: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
Tafseer: the scrolls of Abraham and Moses the ten scrolls of Abraham and the Torah of Moses.

ayah_ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
ayah_en: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺?
Tafseer: Has there — there has indeed — come to you the tiding of the Enveloper? the Resurrection so called because it ‘envelops’ creatures with its terrors.

ayah_ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
ayah_en: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast,
Tafseer: Some faces on that day — they faces are used to represent the individuals in both instances — will be humbled abject

ayah_ar: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
ayah_en: ˹totally˺ overburdened, exhausted,
Tafseer: toiling weary tired and exhausted from the chains and fetters

ayah_ar: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
ayah_en: burning in a scorching Fire,
Tafseer: roasting read taslā or tuslā in a scorching fire

ayah_ar: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
ayah_en: left to drink from a scalding spring.
Tafseer: made to drink from a boiling spring one of extremely hot temperatures.

ayah_ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
ayah_en: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub,
Tafseer: They will have no food except cactus darī‘ — a type of thorn plant which no animal grazes on because of its vileness —

ayah_ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
ayah_en: neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger.
Tafseer: neither nourishing nor availing against hunger.

ayah_ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
ayah_en: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss,
Tafseer: Other faces on that day will be delicate fair

ayah_ar: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
ayah_en: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving,
Tafseer: pleased by their efforts in the life of the world expended in obedience pleased in the Hereafter upon seeing the reward thereof;

ayah_ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
ayah_en: in an elevated Garden,
Tafseer: in a lofty Garden lofty in a physical as well as an abstract sense

ayah_ar: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
ayah_en: where no idle talk will be heard.
Tafseer: in which they will not hear read lā yusma‘u ‘will not be heard’ or lā tasma‘u ‘they will not hear’ any vanity any inane soul speaking drivel;

ayah_ar: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
ayah_en: In it will be a running spring,
Tafseer: therein is a running spring of water meaning ‘springs’;

ayah_ar: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
ayah_en: along with thrones raised high,
Tafseer: therein are lofty couches lofty in terms of their essence their size and physical location

ayah_ar: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
ayah_en: and cups set at hand,
Tafseer: and goblets vessels without handles set around the edges of the springs prepared for them to drink with

ayah_ar: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
ayah_en: and ˹fine˺ cushions lined up,
Tafseer: and cushions arrayed one next to the other against which they may lean

ayah_ar: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
ayah_en: and ˹splendid˺ carpets spread out.
Tafseer: and carpets rugs of velvet-hair spread out.

ayah_ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
ayah_en: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created;
Tafseer: Will they the Meccan disbelievers not consider by way of reflection the camels how they are created?

ayah_ar: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
ayah_en: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺;
Tafseer: And the heaven how it was raised?

ayah_ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
ayah_en: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up;
Tafseer: And the mountains how they were set?

ayah_ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
ayah_en: and the earth—how it was levelled out?
Tafseer: And the earth how it was laid out flat? and thus infer from this the power of God exalted be He and His Oneness? The commencing with the mention of camels is because they are closer in contact with it the earth than any other animal. As for His words sutihat ‘laid out flat’ this on a literal reading suggests that the earth is flat which is the opinion of most of the scholars of the revealed Law and not a sphere as astronomers ahl al-hay’a have it even if this latter does not contradict any of the pillars of the Law.

ayah_ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
ayah_en: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O  Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind.
Tafseer: So remind them of God’s graces and the proofs affirming His Oneness. For you are only an admonisher;

ayah_ar: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
ayah_en: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺.
Tafseer: you are not a taskmaster over them a variant reading for musaytir has musaytir that is to say not one who has been given authority over them — this was revealed before the command to struggle against the disbelievers.

ayah_ar: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
ayah_en: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief,
Tafseer: But he who turns away he who rejects faith and disbelieves in the Qur’ān

ayah_ar: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
ayah_en: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment.
Tafseer: God will chastise him with the greater chastisement the chastisement of the Hereafter the lesser chastisement being that of this world that of being killed or taken captive.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
ayah_en: Surely to Us is their return,
Tafseer: Truly to Us will be their return their coming back after death

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
ayah_en: then surely with Us is their reckoning.
Tafseer: then truly with Us will lie their reckoning their requital which We will never abandon.

ayah_ar: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
ayah_en: By the dawn,
Tafseer: By the dawn that is to say by the dawn of each day

ayah_ar: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
ayah_en: and the ten nights,
Tafseer: and by the ten nights the first ten nights of Dhū’l-Hijja

ayah_ar: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
ayah_en: and the even and the odd,
Tafseer: and by the even the pair and the odd read watr or witr two alternative forms the single

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
ayah_en: and the night when it passes!
Tafseer: and by the night in motion falling or receding

ayah_ar: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
ayah_en: Is all this ˹not˺ a sufficient oath for those who have sense?
Tafseer: Is there in that oath an oath for one of sense? one of intellect the response to the oath has been omitted that is to say it is to be understood as something like la-tu‘adhdhabunna yā kuffāra Makka ‘you will assuredly be chastised O disbelievers of Mecca!’.

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayah_en: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with ’Ȃd—
Tafseer: Have you not seen do you not know O Muhammad (s) how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād

ayah_ar: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
ayah_en: ˹the people˺ of Iram—with ˹their˺ great stature,
Tafseer: Iram — these were the former people of ‘Ād Irama is an explicative supplement or a substitution and it is treated as a diptote because it is a proper noun and feminine — of the towering ones that is to say the tall ones — the tallest one among them would reach four hundred cubits —

ayah_ar: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
ayah_en: unmatched in any other land;
Tafseer: the like of which was not created in the land in terms of their power of assault and strength

ayah_ar: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
ayah_en: and Thamûd who carved ˹their homes into˺ the rocks in the ˹Stone˺ Valley;
Tafseer: and Thamūd who hollowed hewed the rocks sakhr is the plural of sakhra in the valley the Wādī al-Qurā rocks which they used as dwellings

ayah_ar: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
ayah_en: and the Pharaoh of mighty structures?
Tafseer: and Pharaoh the one of the tent-pegs he used to fasten four pegs and tie to these the hands and feet of those whom he tortured —

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
ayah_en: They all transgressed throughout the land,
Tafseer: those who were rebellious became tyrannical in the land

ayah_ar: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
ayah_en: spreading much corruption there.
Tafseer: and caused much corruption therein? by way of slaying and otherwise.

ayah_ar: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
ayah_en: So your Lord unleashed on them a scourge of punishment.
Tafseer: So your Lord poured on them a scourge of chastisement.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
ayah_en: ˹For˺ your Lord is truly vigilant.
Tafseer: Assuredly your Lord is ever on the watch watching over the deeds of servants nothing of which escapes Him that He may then requite them for these deeds.

ayah_ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
ayah_en: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”
Tafseer: And as for man the disbeliever whenever his Lord tests him and honours him with wealth and other things and is gracious to him he says ‘My Lord has honoured me’.

ayah_ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
ayah_en: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”
Tafseer: But when he tests him and restricts his provision for him he says ‘My Lord has humiliated me’.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
ayah_en: Absolutely not! In fact, you are not ˹even˺ gracious to the orphan,
Tafseer: No indeed! — a disavowal of this notion in other words honour is not about wealth nor is there any humiliation in poverty rather it has to do with obedience and disobedience respectively; but the disbelievers of Mecca unmindful of this. Rather they do not honour the orphan they do not treat him with kindness despite their wealth or it means that they do not give him what is his due from an inheritance

ayah_ar: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
ayah_en: nor do you urge one another to feed the poor.
Tafseer: and they do not urge neither themselves nor others the feeding of the needy;

ayah_ar: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
ayah_en: And you devour ˹others’˺ inheritance greedily,
Tafseer: and they devour inheritance turāth means mīrāth greedily lamman that is to say voraciously when they appropriate lammuhum the women’s and the young ones’ share of the inheritance together with their own share of it or to their own wealth;

ayah_ar: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
ayah_en: and love wealth fervently.
Tafseer: and they love wealth with abounding love that is to say greatly and so they do not expend any of it a variant reading in the case of all four verbs has the second person plural.

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
ayah_en: Enough! When the earth is entirely crushed over and over,
Tafseer: No indeed! — a deterrent for them from such conduct. When the earth is pulverised repeatedly when it is shaken until every edifice has collapsed and is destroyed

ayah_ar: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
ayah_en: and your Lord comes ˹to judge˺ with angels, rank upon rank,
Tafseer: and your Lord that is to say His command and the angels arrive rank on rank saffan saffan is a circumstantial qualifier meaning ‘standing in rows’ or ‘made up of many ranks’

ayah_ar: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayah_en: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then?
Tafseer: and Hell on that day is brought near pulled by seventy thousand sets of reins each set of reins pulled by the hands of seventy thousand angels as it groans and seethes in fury; on that day yawma’idhin is a substitution for idhā ‘when’ the response to which is the following man that is to say the disbeliever will remember his prodigal conduct in it but how will remembering avail him now? the interrogative is meant as a denial in other words his remembering that will not be of any use to him.

ayah_ar: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
ayah_en: They will cry, “I wish I had sent forth ˹something good˺ for my ˹true˺ life.”
Tafseer: He will say as he remembers ‘O yā is for calling attention to something would that I had sent ahead good deeds and faith for my life!’ for a good life in the Hereafter or it means ‘during my life’ in the world.

ayah_ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
ayah_en: On that Day He will punish ˹them˺ severely, like no other,
Tafseer: Then on that day none shall mete out read yu‘adhdhibu His God’s chastisement that is to say He shall not delegate it to any other;

ayah_ar: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
ayah_en: and bind ˹them˺ tightly, like no other.
Tafseer: and likewise none shall bind read yūthiqu His bind a variant reading has yu‘adhdhabu ‘none shall be chastised’ and yūthaqu ‘none shall be bound’ so that the suffixed pronoun of ‘adhābahu and wathāqahu refers to the chastisement and the binds of the disbeliever the meaning then being ‘none shall be chastised as he shall and none shall be bound as he shall be bound’.

ayah_ar: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
ayah_en: ˹Allah will say to the righteous,˺ “O tranquil soul!
Tafseer: ‘O soul at peace! the one secure namely the believing one.

ayah_ar: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
ayah_en: Return to your Lord, well pleased ˹with Him˺ and well pleasing ˹to Him˺.
Tafseer: Return — this is said to it upon death — to your Lord that is to say return to His command and to His will pleased with the reward pleasing in God’s sight with your deeds; in other words return O soul combining both descriptions both of which are circumstantial qualifiers. And it will be said to it at the Resurrection

ayah_ar: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
ayah_en: So join My servants,
Tafseer: Then enter among My righteous servants!

ayah_ar: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
ayah_en: and enter My Paradise.”
Tafseer: And enter My Paradise!’ with them.

ayah_ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
ayah_en: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—
Tafseer: I swear lā is extra by this land of Mecca

ayah_ar: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
ayah_en: even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—
Tafseer: and you O Muhammad (s) have free disposal of sanction for this land in that you will be given permission to fight in it — and indeed God fulfilled this promise to him on the day of the Conquest of Mecca thus this is a parenthetical statement intervening between that by which the oath has been sworn and that which is a supplement thereto.

ayah_ar: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
ayah_en: and by every parent and ˹their˺ child!
Tafseer: And by the begetter that is Adam and that which he begat that is his descendants mā ‘that which’ actually means man ‘whom’.

ayah_ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
ayah_en: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle.
Tafseer: We certainly created man al-insān the generic noun in travail in a state of toil and hardship struggling with the tribulations of this world and the calamities of the Hereafter.

ayah_ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
ayah_en: Do they think that no one has power over them,
Tafseer: Does he suppose does the strong man of Quraysh namely Abū’l-Ashadd b. Kalada presume on account of his strength that an softened in place of the hardened form its subject omitted that is to say annahu no one will have power over him? Yet God has power over him.

ayah_ar: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
ayah_en: boasting, “I have wasted enormous wealth!”?
Tafseer: He says ‘I have exhausted in enmity of Muhammad (s) vast wealth!’ great wealth piles and piles of it.

ayah_ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
ayah_en: Do they think that no one sees them?
Tafseer: Does he suppose that an in other words annahu no one has seen him? with regard to what he has expended to know the quantity thereof; God knows the quantity thereof; but it is not in reality that much so as to be considered a great amount and in any case He will requite him for his evil conduct.

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
ayah_en: Have We not given them two eyes,
Tafseer: Have We not given an interrogative meant as an affirmative in other words ‘We have certainly given’ him two eyes

ayah_ar: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
ayah_en: a tongue, and two lips;
Tafseer: and a tongue and two lips

ayah_ar: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
ayah_en: and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺?
Tafseer: and guided him to the two paths? did We not point out to him the path of good and that of evil?

ayah_ar: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
ayah_en: If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺!
Tafseer: Yet why does he not assault the obstacle? why does he not surmount it?

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
ayah_en: And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is?
Tafseer: And what will show you what will make known to you what the obstacle is? that he is to surmount — intended to emphasise its enormity this statement is a parenthetical one. He explains the way to surmount it by saying

ayah_ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
ayah_en: It is to free a slave,
Tafseer: the freeing of a slave from bondage

ayah_ar: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
ayah_en: or to give food in times of famine
Tafseer: or to give food on a day of hunger

ayah_ar: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
ayah_en: to an orphaned relative
Tafseer: to an orphan near of kin maqraba means qarāba

ayah_ar: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
ayah_en: or to a poor person in distress,
Tafseer: or a needy person in misery matraba literally means ‘clinging to the dust turāb’ because of his poverty; a variant reading has two verbal nouns in place of the two verbs fakka ‘he freed’ and at‘ama ‘he fed’ the first being in a genitive construction fakku raqabatin ‘the freeing of a slave’ and the second with nunation it‘āmun ‘to give food’ in which case there is an implied iqtihāmu before al-‘aqaba of which the said reading becomes the explication;

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
ayah_en: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion.
Tafseer: while being thumma kāna is a supplement to iqtahama ‘he assaulted’; thumma is for the ordering of things to be mentioned in other words what is meant is that at the point of the assault he was one of those who believe and enjoin one another to steadfastness in pursuing obedience and in refraining from disobedience and enjoin one another to compassion marhama means rahma towards creatures.

ayah_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
ayah_en: These are the people of the right.
Tafseer: Those the ones described by the said attributes are the ones of the right side al-maymana means al-yamīn.

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
ayah_en: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left.
Tafseer: But those who disbelieve in Our signs they are the ones of the left side al-mash’ama means al-shimāl.

ayah_ar: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
ayah_en: The Fire will be sealed over them.
Tafseer: Over them will be an enclosing Fire read mu’sada or mūsada closed on top of them.

ayah_ar: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
ayah_en: By the sun and its brightness,
Tafseer: By the sun and her morning light

ayah_ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
ayah_en: and the moon as it follows it,
Tafseer: and by the moon when it follows her rising after she has set

ayah_ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
ayah_en: and the day as it unveils it,
Tafseer: and by the day when it reveals her as it rises high

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
ayah_en: and the night as it conceals it!
Tafseer: and by the night when it enshrouds her covering her up with its darkness idhā ‘when’ in all three instances is an absolute adverbial operated by the verbal action of the oath.

ayah_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
ayah_en: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it,
Tafseer: By the heaven and the One Who built it

ayah_ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
ayah_en: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it!
Tafseer: and by the earth and the One Who spread it laid out flat.

ayah_ar: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
ayah_en: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it,
Tafseer: and by the soul that is to say by all souls and the One Who proportioned it in its created form mā in all three instances relates to the verbal action or functions as man ‘the one who’

ayah_ar: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
ayah_en: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it!
Tafseer: and inspired to discern its vices and piety He pointed out to it the path of good and that of evil the placing of taqwā ‘piety’ second takes into account the rhyme endings of the verses; the response to the oath is the following

ayah_ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
ayah_en: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul,
Tafseer: Successful indeed qad the lām of laqad ‘indeed’ has been omitted from it for the sake of brevity will be the one who purifies it purges it of sins

ayah_ar: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
ayah_en: and doomed is the one who corrupts it!
Tafseer: and he will indeed have failed he who eclipses it he who obscures it with acts of disobedience dassāhā is actually dassasahā but the second sīn has been replaced with an alif for phonetic ease.

ayah_ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
ayah_en: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance,
Tafseer: Thamūd denied their messenger Sālih because of their rebellious nature

ayah_ar: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
ayah_en: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺.
Tafseer: when the most wretched of them whose name was Qudār was dispatched when he hastened in order to hamstring the she-camel with their approval.

ayah_ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
ayah_en: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”
Tafseer: But then the messenger of God Sālih said to them ‘This is the she-camel of God so let her have her drink!’ her drink on her day — one day was hers the next theirs.

ayah_ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayah_en: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground.
Tafseer: But they denied him with regard to his saying this as being a command from God — which if they contravened would immediately result in chastisement being sent down on them — then hamstrung her they slew it in order to appropriate her share of the drinking water. So their Lord closed in on them the chastisement because of their sin and meted it equally among them that is the closing in on them in other words He subsumed them all by it so that not one of them escaped.

ayah_ar: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
ayah_en: He has no fear of consequences.
Tafseer: And He does not read wa-lā or fa-lā fear the consequence of it.

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
ayah_en: By the night when it covers,
Tafseer: By the night as it enshrouds with its darkness all that is between the heaven and the earth

ayah_ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
ayah_en: and the day when it shines!
Tafseer: and by the day as it unveils as it is revealed and becomes manifest idhā ‘as’ in both instances is an absolute adverbial operated by the verbal action of the oath

ayah_ar: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
ayah_en: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female!
Tafseer: and by the One Who mā either functions as man ‘the One Who’ or it is related to a verbal action created the male and the female Adam and Eve or every male and female — the hermaphrodite although problematic for us is in fact either male or female according to God and therefore a person actually commits perjury if he speaks with one thinking that because he has sworn not to speak with a male or a female; he may do so with a hermaphrodite.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
ayah_en: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse.
Tafseer: Assuredly your efforts your deeds are dissimilar with some working towards Paradise by means of obedience while others in effect are working towards the Fire through acts of disobedience.

ayah_ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
ayah_en: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺,
Tafseer: As for him who gives what is due to God and is fearful of God

ayah_ar: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayah_en: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward,
Tafseer: and affirms the truth of the best word that is the truth of ‘there is no god but God’ in both places here and below verse 9

ayah_ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayah_en: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease.
Tafseer: We shall surely ease his way to the abode of ease to Paradise.

ayah_ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayah_en: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺,
Tafseer: But as for him who is niggardly with what is due to God and deems himself self-sufficient without need for His reward 929 and denies the best word

ayah_ar: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayah_en: and ˹staunchly˺ denies the finest reward,
Tafseer: and denies the best word

ayah_ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
ayah_en: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship.
Tafseer: We shall surely ease his way We shall pave for him the way to hardship to the Fire;

ayah_ar: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
ayah_en: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺.
Tafseer: And his wealth shall not mā is or negation avail him when he perishes in the Fire.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
ayah_en: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance.
Tafseer: Truly with Us lies all guidance the pointing out of the path of guidance from that of error so that Our command may be followed by adhering to the former manner of conduct and that Our prohibition may also be heeded by refraining from falling into the latter manner of conduct.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayah_en: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next.
Tafseer: And truly to Us belong the Hereafter and the first life that is to say that of this world and so whoever seeks either of the two from anyone other than Us has erred.

ayah_ar: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
ayah_en: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire,
Tafseer: So I have warned you of I have threatened you O people of Mecca with a raging fire talazzā ‘raging’ one of the two original tā’ letters of tatalazzā has been omitted; a variant reading retains it tatalazzā that is ‘one that is flaming’

ayah_ar: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
ayah_en: in which none will burn except the most wretched—
Tafseer: which none shall enter but the wretched one al-ashqā means al-shaqī

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayah_en: who deny and turn away.
Tafseer: he who denies the Prophet and turns away from faith — this delimiting of those who deserve to enter this fire constitutes an interpretation of His saying But He forgives other than that to whomever He will Q. 448 which in turn suggests that what is meant is that entry into the Fire which will be everlasting.

ayah_ar: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
ayah_en: But the righteous will be spared from it—
Tafseer: The God-fearing one al-atqā means al-taqī shall be spared it he will be removed far away from it

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
ayah_en: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves,
Tafseer: he who gives his wealth to purify himself offering it as a means of self purification before God exalted be He by making this payment for the sake of God exalted be He and not for show or the sake of reputation so that he or the offering stands purified in the sight of God. This verse was revealed regarding the truthful one al-siddīq Abū Bakr may God be pleased with him when he purchased Bilāl the Ethiopian who was being tortured on account of his faith and then freed him whereat the disbelievers said ‘He only did this in return for a favour which he must have owed him’ and so the following was revealed

ayah_ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
ayah_en: not in return for someone’s favours,
Tafseer: and no one has any favour outstanding with him that must be requited;

ayah_ar: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayah_en: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High.
Tafseer: but he did this only seeking the pleasure of his Lord the Most High that is to say only seeking to secure God’s reward;

ayah_ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
ayah_en: They will certainly be pleased.
Tafseer: and verily soon he shall himself be pleased with the reward he will be given in Paradise. The verse applies equally to anyone who may do as he Abū Bakr did may God be pleased with him and such a person will thereby be removed far from the Fire and rewarded.

ayah_ar: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
ayah_en: By the morning sunlight,
Tafseer: By the forenoon that is to say the first part of the day or all of it

ayah_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
ayah_en: and the night when it falls still!
Tafseer: and by the night when it is still — or sajā can mean ‘when it envelops all in its darkness’.

ayah_ar: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
ayah_en: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺.
Tafseer: Your Lord has neither forsaken you He has not abandoned you O Muhammad (s) nor does He hate you this was revealed when after the revelation had not come to him for fifteen days the disbelievers said ‘His Lord has parted with him and hates him’.

ayah_ar: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayah_en: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one.
Tafseer: And verily the Hereafter shall be better for you by virtue of the honours awaiting you thereat than the first life this world.

ayah_ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
ayah_en: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased.
Tafseer: And verily your Lord shall give you in the Hereafter of good things a bounteous gift and you shall be satisfied with it — and so the Prophet s said ‘In that case I shall not be satisfied if a single person from among my community remains in the Fire’ the response to the oath terminates here with two affirmations and two negations.

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
ayah_en: Did He not find you as an orphan then sheltered you?
Tafseer: Did He not find you an orphan an interrogative meant as an affirmative in other words He did indeed find you an orphan having lost your father before you were born or shortly thereafter and shelter you? by having your uncle Abū Tālib embrace you as part of his household.

ayah_ar: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
ayah_en: Did He not find you unguided then guided you?
Tafseer: And did He not find you erring from the revealed Law which you now follow and guided you? that is and then guided you to it.

ayah_ar: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
ayah_en: And did He not find you needy then satisfied your needs?
Tafseer: And did He not find you needy poor and enrich you? and made you content with the spoils and other things which He gave you — in a hadīth it is stated ‘Wealth comes not from the proliferation of transient worldly goods but wealth comes from the contentedness of the soul’.

ayah_ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
ayah_en: So do not oppress the orphan,
Tafseer: So as for the orphan do not oppress him by appropriating his wealth or otherwise

ayah_ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
ayah_en: nor repulse the beggar.
Tafseer: and as for the beggar do not drive him away do not repel him on account of his poverty

ayah_ar: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
ayah_en: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord.
Tafseer: and as for your Lord’s grace to you by way of prophethood and otherwise proclaim it make it known. The omission in certain instances of the suffixed pronoun referring to the Prophet s from the end of the verbs is intended to sustain the end-rhyme of the verses.

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
ayah_en: Have We not uplifted your heart for you ˹O Prophet˺,
Tafseer: Did We not expand an interrogative meant as an affirmative in other words ‘We did indeed expand’ your breast for you O Muhammad (s) by means of prophethood and otherwise

ayah_ar: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
ayah_en: relieved you of the burden
Tafseer: and relieve you of your burden

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
ayah_en: which weighed so heavily on your back,
Tafseer: that which weighed down your back? — this is similar to where God says that God may forgive you what is past of your sin Q. 482.

ayah_ar: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
ayah_en: and elevated your renown for you?
Tafseer: Did We not exalt your mention? For you are mentioned where I God am mentioned in the call announcing the time for prayer adhān in the second call to perform the prayer iqāma in the witnessing ‘there is no god but God Muhammad is His Messenger’ tashahhud in the Friday sermon and in other instances.

ayah_ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayah_en: So, surely with hardship comes ease.
Tafseer: For truly with hardship comes ease.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
ayah_en: Surely with ˹that˺ hardship comes ˹more˺ ease.
Tafseer: Truly with hardship comes ease the Prophet s suffered much hardship at the hands of the disbelievers but then he enjoyed ease when he was assisted to victory by God over them.

ayah_ar: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
ayah_en: So once you have fulfilled ˹your duty˺, strive ˹in devotion˺,
Tafseer: So when you are finished from performing prayer toil exert yourself in supplication to God

ayah_ar: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
ayah_en: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope.
Tafseer: and seek devote yourself humbly to your Lord.

ayah_ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
ayah_en: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺,
Tafseer: By the fig and the olive that is the two edible foods — or these denote the names of two mountains in Syria on which these two foods grow —

ayah_ar: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
ayah_en: and Mount Sinai,
Tafseer: and by the Mount Sinai the mountain on which God exalted be He spoke to Moses sīnīn means ‘the one blessed’ or ‘the fair one with fruitful trees’

ayah_ar: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
ayah_en: and this secure city ˹of Mecca˺!
Tafseer: and by this secure land Mecca as people were secure in it in the time of pagandom and are still secure in it in Islam.

ayah_ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
ayah_en: Indeed, We created humans in the best form.
Tafseer: Verily We created man al-insān the generic in the best of forms in the best proportioning of his shape.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
ayah_en: But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺,
Tafseer: Then in the case of certain individuals of his species We reduced him to the lowest of the low — a metaphor for old age and weakness at which point a believer’s deeds are fewer than when he was young; but he will still have his reward as God exalted be He says

ayah_ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayah_en: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward.
Tafseer: except those who believe and perform righteous deeds for they shall have an unfailing reward one unending — in a hadīth it is stated ‘When a believer reaches that stage of old age which prevents him from performing good deeds then what he used to do is recorded in his favour instead’.

ayah_ar: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayah_en: Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment?
Tafseer: So what makes you deny O disbeliever thereafter — after the mention of man being created in the best of forms and his being reduced to the vilest of age all of which indicates the power of God to resurrect — the Judgement? the Requital that will be preceded by the Resurrection and the Reckoning. In other words what makes you disbelieve in all this? Nothing does!

ayah_ar: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
ayah_en: Is Allah not the most just of all judges?
Tafseer: Is not God the fairest of all judges? the most just of all judges. His passing judgement by means of the process of requital is one such example. In a hadīth it is stated ‘Whoever recites sūrat wa’l-tīni ‘By the fig’ to the end of it let him then say “Yes Indeed! And I am of those who bear witness to this!” ’

ayah_ar: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
ayah_en: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—
Tafseer: Recite bring recitation into existence beginning with In the Name of your Lord Who created all creatures;

ayah_ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
ayah_en: created humans from a clinging clot.
Tafseer: created man al-insān the generic from a blood-clot ‘alaq is the plural of ‘alaqa which is a small quantity of congealing blood.

ayah_ar: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
ayah_en: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous,
Tafseer: Recite reiterating the first one and your Lord is the Most Generous having no counterpart in terms of His generosity wa-rabbuka’l-akram is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb iqra’ ‘recite’

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
ayah_en: Who taught by the pen—
Tafseer: Who taught the art of script by the pen — the first to write with it was the prophet Enoch Idrīs peace be upon him —

ayah_ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
ayah_en: taught humanity what they knew not.
Tafseer: taught man al-insān the generic what he did not know before he was taught in the way of guidance the art of writing crafts and so on.

ayah_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
ayah_en: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds
Tafseer: Nay but verily man is wont to be rebellious

ayah_ar: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
ayah_en: once they think they are self-sufficient.
Tafseer: when he sees it that is to say his own soul to be self-sufficient in terms of wealth — this was revealed regarding Abū Jahl ra’ā ‘sees’ means to see mentally; istaghnā ‘self-sufficient’ is the second direct object; an ra’āhu ‘when he sees it’ is an object denoting reason.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
ayah_en: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺.
Tafseer: Surely to your Lord O man is the return — meant as a threat for him — and so He will requite the rebellious one with what he deserves.

ayah_ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
ayah_en: Have you seen the man who prevents
Tafseer: Have you seen a-ra’ayta in all three instances here and below is an exclamation of wonder him namely Abū Jahl who forbids

ayah_ar: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
ayah_en: a servant ˹of Ours˺ from praying?
Tafseer: a servant namely Muhammad (s) when he prays?

ayah_ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
ayah_en: What if this ˹servant˺ is ˹rightly˺ guided,
Tafseer: Have you considered what if he the one forbidden should be upon a path of guidance

ayah_ar: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
ayah_en: or encourages righteousness?
Tafseer: or aw is for division be bidding others to fear of God?

ayah_ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayah_en: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away?
Tafseer: Have you considered what if he the one forbidding the Prophet should be denying God’s guidance and turning away? from faith.

ayah_ar: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
ayah_en: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺?
Tafseer: Is he not aware that God sees? what has issued from him that is to say He does indeed know it and will requite him for it. In other words ‘Marvel O you being addressed at the way in which he forbids prayer and at the fact that the one being forbidden is actually the one upon guidance bidding to fear of God while the one forbidding is a denier disregarding faith’.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
ayah_en: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—
Tafseer: No indeed! — a repudiation of him — Assuredly if la-in the lām is for oaths he does not desist from the disbelief that he is upon We shall seize him by the forelock We shall drag him to the Fire by his forelock

ayah_ar: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
ayah_en: a lying, sinful forelock.
Tafseer: a lying iniquitous forelock! nāsiyatin an indefinite noun substituting for a definite — the description of this forelock in such terms is meant figuratively and what is actually meant is that individual.

ayah_ar: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
ayah_en: So let him call his associates.
Tafseer: Let him then call upon the henchmen of his council the members of his council nādin — a place of assembly where people gather to talk. He Abū Jahl had said to the Prophet s in reproof having forbidden him from prayer ‘You are well aware that there is none in this town who has recourse to as large a council of men as I do. Verily I shall fill this entire valley with mature steeds and young men in battle against you if you so wish!’

ayah_ar: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
ayah_en: We will call the wardens of Hell.
Tafseer: We shall call the Zabāniya the grim stern angels to destroy him as stated in the hadīth ‘Had he called his council of henchmen together the Zabāniya would have seized him right before his own eyes!’.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
ayah_en: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺.
Tafseer: No indeed! — a repudiation of him — Do not obey him O Muhammad (s) and abandon prayer and prostrate yourself perform prayer to God and draw near to Him through obedience to Him.

ayah_ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayah_en: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory.
Tafseer: Lo! We revealed it that is the Qur’ān in its entirety sending it down from the Preserved Tablet to the heaven of this world on the Night of Ordainment that is the Night of great eminence.

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayah_en: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is?
Tafseer: And what will show you what will make known to you O Muhammad (s) what the Night of Ordainment is? — intended to emphasise its great status and to provoke marvel at it.

ayah_ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
ayah_en: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months.
Tafseer: The Night of Ordainment is better than a thousand months in which there is no Night of Ordainment for a righteous deed on that Night is better than one performed for a thousand months without it.

ayah_ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
ayah_en: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter.
Tafseer: The angels and the Spirit namely Gabriel descend tanazzalu one of the two original tā’ letters of tatanazzalu has been omitted in it on that night by the leave of their Lord by His command with every command that God has decreed from that year to the following one min is causative functioning as bi ‘with’.

ayah_ar: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
ayah_en: It is all peace until the break of dawn.
Tafseer: It is peaceful salāmun hiya a predicate preceding the subject until the rising of the dawn read matla‘ or matli‘ until the time it rises it is peaceful because of the numerous salutations of peace salām spoken in it by the angels who every time they come across a believing man or believing woman bid him peace.

ayah_ar: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayah_en: The disbelievers from the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist ˹from disbelief˺ until the clear proof came to them:
Tafseer: The disbelievers from among min explicative the People of the Scripture and the idolaters that is the idol-worshippers wa’l-mushrikīna is a supplement to ahl ‘the People of’ were not going to leave off munfakkīna is the predicate of yakun ‘were’ that is to say they were not going to abandon their ways until the clear proof namely Muhammad (s) should come to them that is until it came to them;

ayah_ar: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
ayah_en: a messenger from Allah, reciting scrolls of ˹utmost˺ purity,
Tafseer: a messenger from God rasūlun mina’Llāhi substitutes for al-bayyinatu ‘the clear proof’ namely the Prophet s reciting pages purified of all falsehood

ayah_ar: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
ayah_en: containing upright commandments.
Tafseer: wherein are upright precepts written rulings that are upright that is to say one who recites what contains all that and that is the Qur’ān. Thus some of them believed in it while others disbelieved.

ayah_ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayah_en: It was not until this clear proof came to the People of the Book that they became divided ˹about his prophethood˺—
Tafseer: And those who were given the Scripture did not become divided regarding belief in him the Prophet s except after the clear proof had come to them namely the Prophet s — or the Qur’ān which he brought as his miracle. Before his s arrival they had all agreed to believe in him when he would come; then those who disbelieved in him from among them became envious of him.

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
ayah_en: even though they were only commanded to worship Allah ˹alone˺ with sincere devotion to Him in all uprightness, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. That is the upright Way.
Tafseer: And they were only commanded in their Scripture the Torah and the Gospel to worship God illā li-ya‘budū means illā an ya‘budū an having been omitted and the lām added devoting religion purely to Him free of any idolatry as hanīfs upright in following the religion of Abraham and the religion of Muhammad (s) when he would come — so how is it that they disbelieved in him? and to establish prayer and pay the alms. That is the upright religion the upright creed.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayah_en: Indeed, those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there forever. They are the worst of ˹all˺ beings.
Tafseer: Truly the disbelievers from among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters shall be in the fire of Hell to abide therein khālidīna an implied circumstantial qualifier in other words it will be decreed for them by God exalted be He to abide therein — those are the worst of creatures.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayah_en: Indeed, those who believe and do good—they are the best of ˹all˺ beings.
Tafseer: Truly those who believe and perform righteous deeds — they are the best of creatures al-bariyya means al-khalīqa.

ayah_ar: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
ayah_en: Their reward with their Lord will be Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is ˹only˺ for those in awe of their Lord.
Tafseer: Their reward with their Lord will be Gardens of Eden as a residence underneath which rivers flow wherein they shall abide forever. God is pleased with them because of their obedience of Him and they are pleased with Him because of His reward. That is the reward for him who fears his Lord for him who fears His punishment and hence desists from disobeying Him exalted be He.

ayah_ar: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
ayah_en: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking,
Tafseer: When earth is shaken when it is rocked for the rising of the Hour with its final quake with its most violent rocking one that befits its magnitude

ayah_ar: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
ayah_en: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents,
Tafseer: and the earth brings forth its burdens its hidden treasures and its dead casting them onto its surface

ayah_ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
ayah_en: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—
Tafseer: and man the disbeliever in resurrection says ‘What is wrong with it?’ — in denial of that situation.

ayah_ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
ayah_en: on that Day the earth will recount everything,
Tafseer: On that day yawma’idhin substitutes for and is the response to idhā ‘when’ it shall relate its chronicles it shall inform of the good and evil deeds committed in it

ayah_ar: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
ayah_en: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺.
Tafseer: for its Lord will have inspired it that is He will have commanded her to do this — in a hadīth it is stated ‘It the earth shall testify to every single deed committed by every servant and handmaiden upon its surface’.

ayah_ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
ayah_en: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds.
Tafseer: On that day mankind shall issue forth they will depart from the site of the Reckoning in separate groups divided up so that those taking it their book by the right hand will go to Paradise while those taking it by the left hand will go to the Fire to be shown their deeds that is the requital for them in either Paradise or the Fire.

ayah_ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayah_en: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.
Tafseer: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good shall see it he shall see its reward

ayah_ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayah_en: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
Tafseer: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil shall see it he shall see its requital.

ayah_ar: وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
ayah_en: ’ By the galloping, panting horses,
Tafseer: By the chargers the steeds that charge in attack and snort with a snorting — this being the name of the sound which they emit from inside them when they charge;

ayah_ar: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا
ayah_en: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺,
Tafseer: by the strikers the steeds that strike fire by way of sparks with their hoofs when they gallop across rocky terrain by night;

ayah_ar: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا
ayah_en: launching raids at dawn,
Tafseer: by the dawn-raiders the steeds that make raids against the enemy at dawn at the hands of their riders

ayah_ar: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا
ayah_en: stirring up ˹clouds of˺ dust,
Tafseer: raising stirring up therein in the place of their charge or at that time of dawn a trail of dust by the power of their movement

ayah_ar: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
ayah_en: and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines!
Tafseer: cleaving therewith with the dust a host of the enemy that is to say cutting right into their centre! the verb is supplemented to the noun in the above instances because it serves to explain the verbal action in other words wa’llātī ‘adawna fa-awrayna fa-agharna ‘by those that charge then strike sparks then raid’.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ
ayah_en: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—
Tafseer: Verily man the disbeliever is ungrateful to his Lord thankless denying the reality of His graces exalted be He

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ
ayah_en: and they certainly attest to this—
Tafseer: and verily to that ingratitude of his he is a witness bearing witness against himself to his own actions.

ayah_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayah_en: and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains.
Tafseer: And verily in the love of wealth he is avid and is therefore niggardly with it.

ayah_ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
ayah_en: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out,
Tafseer: Does he not know that when that which is in the graves in the way of the dead is strewn when it is turned over and brought out that is to say that when they are raised

ayah_ar: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayah_en: and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—
Tafseer: and that which is in the breasts the hearts of disbelief or faith is obtained when it is revealed and examined

ayah_ar: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
ayah_en: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day.
Tafseer: on that day their Lord will indeed be Aware of them Knower of them and will requite them for their disbelief the pronoun reverts to the plural because of the collective import of the term ‘man’; this sentence indicates the direct object of the verb ya‘lamu ‘does he not know’ that is to say ‘We will requite him at the time mentioned’; khabīrun ‘Aware’ is semantically connected to yawma’idhin ‘on that day’ even though in fact God is ever Aware because that is the Day of Requital.

ayah_ar: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayah_en: The Striking Disaster!
Tafseer: The Clattering Blow the Resurrection that will make hearts clatter by its terrors.

ayah_ar: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayah_en: What is the Striking Disaster?
Tafseer: What is the Clattering Blow? — intended to emphasise its awesomeness mā’l-qāri‘a both of these elements constitute a subject and a predicate and together the predicate of the first al-qāri‘a.

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayah_en: And what will make you realize what the Striking Disaster is?
Tafseer: And what will show you what will make known to you what the Clattering Blow is? — additional emphasis of its awesomeness the first mā is a subject and what follows it is its predicate; the second mā and its predicate also function together as the second direct object of the verb adrā ‘show’.

ayah_ar: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
ayah_en: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths,
Tafseer: The day yawma that which renders it accusative is the verb indicated by al-qāri‘a in other words by the implied taqra‘u ‘it clatters’ mankind will be like scattered moths like a throng of scattered locusts surging into each other in confusion until they are summoned to the Reckoning

ayah_ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
ayah_en: and the mountains will be like carded wool.
Tafseer: and the mountains will be like tufts of wool like carded wool in terms of the lightness with which it floats in the air until it comes to settle upon the earth.

ayah_ar: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayah_en: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺,
Tafseer: Then as for him whose scales weigh heavy in that his good deeds outweigh his misdeeds

ayah_ar: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
ayah_en: they will be in a life of bliss.
Tafseer: he will enjoy a pleasant life in Paradise that is to say a pleasing one for he will be pleased with it that is it will be pleasing to him;

ayah_ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayah_en: And as for those whose scale is light,
Tafseer: but as for him whose scales weigh light in that his evil deeds outweigh his good ones

ayah_ar: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
ayah_en: their home will be the abyss.
Tafseer: his home will be the Abyss.

ayah_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
ayah_en: And what will make you realize what that is?
Tafseer: And what will show you what it is? that is to say what the Abyss is.

ayah_ar: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
ayah_en: ˹It is˺ a scorching Fire.
Tafseer: It is A scorching fire of extremely hot temperature the hā’ of hiya is for consonantal quiescence and is retained when reciting without a subsequent pause or with; some omit it when reciting without a pause.

ayah_ar: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
ayah_en: Competition for more ˹gains˺ diverts you ˹from Allah˺,
Tafseer: Rivalry in worldly things mutual vainglory about wealth children and men distracts you preoccupies you diverting you from obedience to God

ayah_ar: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
ayah_en: until you end up in ˹your˺ graves.
Tafseer: until you visit the graves either in that you have died and then been buried in them or it means to the extent that you actually count the dead as a something to rival one another by.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayah_en: But no! You will soon come to know.
Tafseer: No indeed! — a disavowal. You will come to know!

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayah_en: Again, no! You will soon come to know.
Tafseer: Again no indeed! You will come to know the evil consequences of your mutual vainglory at the moment of the extraction of the soul then you will come to know in the grave.

ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayah_en: Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺.
Tafseer: No indeed! — verily — Were you to know with certain knowledge the consequences of your vainglory you would not preoccupy yourselves with it for

ayah_ar: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
ayah_en: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire.
Tafseer: you would surely see hell-fire the Fire la-tarawunna’l-jahīma this is the response to an omitted oath; the third consonant of the root of the verb r-’-y together with the second have been omitted and its vowel has been transposed onto the rā’.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayah_en: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
Tafseer: Again you will surely see it — repeated for emphasis — with the eye of certainty ‘ayna is a verbal noun as both ra’ā and ‘āyana have the same meaning.

ayah_ar: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayah_en: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures.
Tafseer: Then on that day the day you see it you will assuredly be questioned la-tus’alunna the nūn of the indicative has been omitted because of one nūn coming after the other; likewise omitted is the wāw indicating the plural person of the verb because of two unvocalised consonants coming together about the comforts of the world the health leisure security food drink and other things which one enjoys in this world.

ayah_ar: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
ayah_en: By the ˹passage of˺ time!
Tafseer: By Time! — or it ‘asr can mean the period from the declining of the sun to sunset or it may denote the afternoon prayer.

ayah_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
ayah_en: Surely humanity is in ˹grave˺ loss,
Tafseer: Verily man al-insān the generic is in a state of loss in all his bargaining

ayah_ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
ayah_en: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance.
Tafseer: except those who believe and perform righteous deeds they are not in a state of loss and enjoin one another to follow the truth faith and enjoin one another to patience in maintaining obedience and in refraining from acts of disobedience.

ayah_ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
ayah_en: Woe to every backbiter, slanderer,
Tafseer: Woe waylun an expression implying chastisement to every backbiter who is a slanderer frequently engaging in backbiting and slander that is to say defamation — this was revealed regarding those who slandered the Prophet s and the believers the likes of Umayya b. Khalaf al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra and others —

ayah_ar: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
ayah_en: who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺,
Tafseer: who amasses read jama‘a or jamma‘a wealth and counts it over keeping count of it and stores it aside as a provision against the unforeseeable calamities of time.

ayah_ar: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
ayah_en: thinking that their wealth will make them immortal!
